The best part of the house is the great library they have put together. Lots of interesting books. The area is quiet and a bit off the centre but there are tram stops nearby.

One of the best AirBnBs we’ve stayed at! The apartment was clean, well stocked with coffee, tea, and snacks. The hosts had thought of everything from toothbrushes to extra pillows to a sewing kit. They even had toys set up for our baby. I really can’t say enough about their warm, helpful welcome and great space. Wish we had more than one night to stay!

The apartment is beautiful, well furnished and well located (close to public transportation). The host is friendly, providing all the information needed to reach the apartment easily. Everything was absolutely perfect.
Great space! Check in/out was seamless and the hosts responded quickly to all messages.

Lovely apartment and super central to explore Zurich. Very close to the lake which is a fantastic amenity during the summer. Arrival and departure all very seamless with everything as promised. Whilst there is plenty of parking watch out for stay limits of between one and two hours, but in any event the tram is literally just outside the door. Would definitely recommend staying here.

Great apartment right in downtown Zurich: 15 min walk from the HB, and an easy pleasant walk to all the highlights in downtown. The street is very quiet but is super close to major shopping and restaurants, restaurant at Hotel Bourbon is highly recommended. Great contemporary food! The apartment has an alcove with the best and a bedroom. Both beds are queen size. The sofa bed in the living room can sleep another 2 people. Terrace has an amazing view of the city. Dimi was very responsive and easy to deal with. Getting to the airport (family of 4) coat us 40 CHF. Surprisingly cheap.

Dimi’s place is great! Big enough for the four of us, me husband and two kids with complete amenities. Just bring your toiletries and food plus condiments to cook if you’ll use the kitchen. I was able to wash clothes as well for the kids. The place is within the old town area but in a more private part. There was a bike tournament when we went there so roads are closed. We had to walk around to look for the place and it was a bit of an uphill walk. So it was a challenge since we had 3 big luggages and it was raining. Overall, the place is just a few mins walk around town and around 10-15mins to Zurich Central Station. Dimi was responsive and a great host too. 😉

As the other reviewers said, Sigrid and her family are very welcoming! She is very motherly and is a fun host. I enjoyed going on trips with her, cooking with her, and exchanging stories. Sigrid's English is also very good, so you will definitely have a good time here. I stayed here for one month as a visiting student @ ETH, and it is roughly a 15-20 minute walk to the university. The location isn't completely central, you won't walk out to be surrounded by bars and restaurants, but with public transportation it is quite easy to get around. The rooms and apartment are clean and comfortable, and all the facilities are clean. Thanks for your hospitality, Sigrid and Pauli!
Jun was very nice and it was clean, but the house was full of huge spiders, both the bedroom and the bathroom. I have a phobia so sleeping was near impossible

Great place, clean and bright. The host was extremely responsive. The park across the street seems to be a meet up for people to drink/smoke so it might not be the most family friendly park. The place was great and easy to get to.

Jun was an amazing host. She accommodated every request, even if I had to change the check in time last minute because my plane was late. Communication was very quick, and the place was very comfortable and tidy. Would really recommend if you need a place to visit Zurich!

We enjoyed our stay at Juns place! It's just like 2 minutes from the train station which is the next stop from Zurich main station. Trains are comming every couple of minutes. Jun was communicating well and also gave us some hints for our stay in Zurich. The room was nice and clean and definitely enough space for 2 people. In the bathroom there were many useful supplies provided. The only thing we think could be improved was the fact that the weekend was really hot and there was no aircon or fan for us to cool down during the night.
Good location next to the Oerlikon station and very responsive host. Nice apartment and good value. Thanks for a great stay!

A comfortable and stylish room in a very nice house. Very well organised so guests in different rooms don’t get in each other’s way, but there is also a nice dining area if you are staying with a few people and want to socialise. Rossana was extremely responsive when I asked for anything. The house is located near the end of a few tram/bus routes but you can get into the centre of town in about 30 mins. There are also several supermarkets and many other shops nearby.
Nice place, clean and near to the center.

I stayed at Peter's place for a week with my dog. The apartment is ideally located, directly by the Tram Station 5/6 and the Buss 33 that bring you to the middle of the city and the lake in only a few stops. The apartment was clean and has a good feel, perfect for 1-2 people. Peter and Engin are very friendly, helpful and offer a service that is hotel-like with all the little details. The best part about the apartment was the garden space which is very nice and makes for a nice summer evening experience. I would definitely go back there. Loved it! Thank you so much for your great hospitality!

It is a great place to be. Very nice and cozy room to stay also for a longer period. Near to all important places in Zurich. Great neighbourhood. The host is very kind, answers fast and will help you in a fantastic manner. I really recommend this host and place. Also for a longer stay. Thank you.

Ferrat is very hospitable and thoughtful, I truly felt as if I was at my own home. He went out of his way to make sure that I had the best Airbnb experience. Everything about my stay was excellent. He arranged his plans so he could offer me his help weather it was for my check out or even giving me tips about my travels. The apartment is very nice and in a perfect location.

Very nice apartment in a pleasant neighbourhood. Not super close tot the city centre, but still walkable and enough options. Sylvia responded, was very friendly and clear and contacted me proactively. For Zürich, nice price quality balance.

You can’t beat the location and value for Old Town! The studio was clean and bright and we loved having the kitchen to cook one night for dinner. It’s located across from a park, but the street is very quiet at night. We did the Old Town walking tour from Viator and learned so many fun facts about the area. Thanks Tania :)
Unfortunately our stay was cut short due the US Travel Ban but the accommodation was I'm the city center and very clean. I would recommend staying with Tania

Perfect! Everything I needed. Comfortable bed, all the amenities needed and plenty of space for yoga practice. Great location. Easy and fast communication with Tania. I definitely recommend staying here.

We rented a room at Peter & Engin's place for our start in Zürich. They were very helpful and forthcoming to our needs. The house and shared areas were cleaned daily. Our room was big enough for a couple. The kitchen is a bit small but it has everything you need for cooking your own meals. They even bought a new microwave during our stay. Regarding the location, stores are just a few steps away next to a tram stop. The tram connection takes you to the main train station. You can also walk to nearby hill / forest for a great view of the city. Very good stay!

Lovely room, very clean and spacious. Looked very similar to the pictures and was very easy to access as it was central to Zürich city centre. However, as the walls were very thin we could often hear people in and around the building throughout the night inc. a man who continued to tell loudly for hours. Despite this, the overall stay was lovely and would definitely recommend :)
Good apartments in the center of Zurich city and very pleasant host! Thanks you

The host was very welcoming and gave us a good rundown of the neighborhood. The room itself is not that big in size, but is decently cozy and very clean. Pretty good location as well. The only downside was the side 'bed', which wasn't very comfortable. Overall we had a great stay!

This is a lovely building situated in the financial district with easy access to streetcars and the train station. The apartment is small but had everything we needed. The bed was comfortable, the bathroom was a good size, the shower was great, there was a kitchenette with a refrigerator and stovetop. We loved being able to keep the windows open. The floor fan was very much appreciated.
Tania is amazing and she is the perfect host. I highly recommend her!

Tania's flat is the better place to be in Zurich. Very well located, spacious, net , nice and modern decoration, with all the usefull and home appliances you need . Plenty of natural light , only one block distance to the lake. I strongly recommend Tania's place!! Virginia Lee
Really lovely place in Zurich. Very central. I had a small room and my own shower, but the toilet was next door shared with 3 rooms. No big deal. I would definitely stay here again for convenience.
Good hotel for affordable price. Great experience but the only downside was that the mattress was a bit hard and uncomfortable
My stay here was short but so perfect! By far the best location and a clean room. Check in was easy and women at the front helped me out with train times and directions. (:

Great location and reception. Staff very friendly and helpful. Room was very clean, spotless and well-presented. The bed was very comfortable and I had a good nights sleep. It was a surprise that the toilet facilities was outside my room but wasn't that much of hardship as they were super clean! The only negative was that the hotel had problems with their hot water that day so I didn't get to have a hot shower...but even still I cannot deduct a star as they were very apologetic and informed me if the problem beforehand. I was able to use an iron which the staff at hotel provided and bought to my room promptly. All in all a great overnight stay and would definately return.

The location of the hotel is fantastic, you could not ask for a better spot. The place was extremely clean and check-in is super easy, the host was great at giving recommendations as well. One thing to keep in mind however is the place does not have a fan or air-conditioning and would be difficult to sleep in during a hot night in summer. Overall I had a fantastic stay and recommend you pick this place!

I had a great stay in Platzhirsch while in Zürich for a whole week. Lora welcomed me really well and was always very responsive and helpful. The room is as described. The only thing I didn’t notice in the room description was the toilet being outside of the room. Maybe that could be clearer in the description, but honestly it wasn’t a big deal. The shared toilet is just outside of the room and it was always clean and easy to access. The shower that’s inside of the room is amazing. There are a lot of good restaurants around the hotel. A great Japanese restaurant on the first floor. The hotel is 4 min walking to the closest tram stop and less than 10 min from the main station. I really enjoyed my stay in Zurich and I was happy with my choice for this room.

Nice apartment but unfortunately it didn’t match the photographs - completely different flooring and furniture - and Dimi didn’t seem particularly concerned about the difference. Said that it had just been renovated but it really didn’t feel like the same apartment. Would have preferred a more honest response to our concerns.

I stayed with my family (my spouse and 2 children) at Dimiter's apartment for 4 nights this December. It was a wonderful stay in every way - great apartment, great location and a great host. The apartment is spacious and well fitted for family needs. The location is perfect - pleasant neighborhood with eating and shopping places, proximity to the city center and connectivity by trams really close to the apartment. And Dimiter makes for a great host - very communicative, proactive and prompt in providing support. I will come back to his apartment any time I am in the city again.
Platzhirsch is a nice and comfortable place to stay for your time in Zürich. It is conveniently located to explore the surroundings, get to ETH, catch a tram/train.

Nice apartment convenient for a short stay in Zurich. It may not have its own toilet but the shared toilet was clean. The apartment was spotless and comfortable. The location is good, not far from the central station and in the heart of the city.
Right in the center, everything is walkable, cute and lively old town. Room has some smell but I let window opened all the time and used the fan provided so it was better.

Had a great stay! Staff was friendly and helpful. To note, it’s important to read through the other reviews and description, the bathroom for this room is separated from the room itself, it’s in the hallway, but I was told I would be the only guest using it (it’s locked and accessible with your key card). The location is perfect, near restaurants and shops, plus a convenience store a few steps away!

My stay in Zurich was wonderful. This place was in the center of old town so walkable to many cool spots and restaurants. The only problem I had was with the sink in the room that had a problem with the drain.
Stayed here a second time because I enjoyed the first stay! Great location, nice room for good value, helpful and proactive communication. Highly recommend!

it's the best location. close to the Hbh, 10min walking. The room is lovely, though need to share the toilet on the floor, there is shower in the room. and in the restaurant of the owner you can even get discount.
Good stay , but the host provide a little more essentials like hand wash soap and cooking oil It was mentioned in description but not present

Great place! I have been traveling through Switzerland for over a week and this was the best place that I got!! Great location, spotless clean, great communication and paid parking as well! Stephanie was always reachable and responsive! Worth each penny!

The apartment was fabulous, very clean and new, well located in the center of Zúrich and walking distance to public transport. After a long day enjoying the city it was great to get back to the apartment as it felt like your house. And Tania was a great host!! I totally recomend it for a short stay with your couple or friend in the city!!

I stayed with my family at Tania's place. This looked exactly like what was shown in the photograph. Very clean and tidy. Also this place is near to most of the places like Zurich lake, Lindenhof Hill, St. Peter Kirche, main station etc. We truly enjoyed our stay and want to come back.

Although we never met Tania, but the communication was good and everything was well in place. The check in was effortless. The apartment was clean and had everything which was needed. definitely a good place to stay in Zurich.

The apartment is immaculately clean, bigger than expected, and perfectly located. We stayed for a week during a work trip and the apartment had everything that we needed for a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

Very nice and elegant apartment in a very good area in the old city. Stylish in a minimalist manner. The apartment itself is very nice and clean and is perfect for a short stay in a nice, quiet and yet convenient area of the city. I really like this apartment. Unfortunately there is no private washing machine, otherwise I would definitely consider longer stays. All of that said I would certainly will be coming back and staying here for a few days if the place is available.
The apartment was clean and nice with a great location. The only downside was that you could hear the nighbours though the walls. It was quiet at night however :)
The apartment was spacious and comfortable and close to the downtown which is easily accessible by walking or tram
Flat is in a good location and quite spacious, but the place was not clean. We contacted host and she resolved it. However the WIFI was not working the whole time we were there.

Michal is a really kind, laid back but very knowledgeable and patient uber host. I really enjoyed our brief conversation; he has a warm spirit to him that, for me, is crucial to solid hospitality. The room is exactly as pictured (immaculately clean, nice comfortable bed, very functional desk with reliable WIFI, in a perfectly located sector of Zurich. 100% recommend and will stay there again next time I'm in the city.
We loved our stay ! Everything went great; the flat is clean and big Thanks a lot!

Tanya is a very good host.The house is very clean and comfortable.She is Responds quickly to messages.The area is the very quiet and very close to center.Check in was easy. Thank for your hosting us an see you next time

It was a wonderful stay at Tania’s place. It is walkable distance to Zurich center and the lake. Instructions are accurate and easy to follow. We enjoyed our stay. Finally, thank you Tania for hosting us at your place.

Very good host; was very responsive and addressed a couple of issues quickly, including giving us some tips on where to pickup a few things on a Sunday. Excellent Location - a short walk to the tram station, and to the lake. Being summer, and not having AC (apparently a Zurich/Switzerland thing), we had to crack open the windows to get the air moving and to cool down the place - which also let mosquitoes and bugs into the apartment, something to keep in mind. More importantly, the open windows also let in the sounds of the trains - light sleepers will definitely be affected.

Our host was great and very accommodating. Location is in a quiet part of town and get to live like you’re a native. We didn’t learn about the public tram system until the last couple of days but very useful. The stop is only 1 minute walk from the apartment and the only tram that goes there is number 7, which goes directly into the middle of Zurich and Zurich main train station. Felt like a safe neighborhood and clean apartment.
It was one of the best airbnb i’ve stayed, the place was perfect and the hosts were really kind and the attention was unbeatable, hope we can come back someday!

Sofia was a great host. To my surprise, I was not able to communicate with her upon my arrival because of issues with my phone, but she was very accommodating and friendly. The room was very nice, safe and in a great location.

Super location and reasonable price! No elevator, be aware if you have a big suitcase, you must climb up. However, on the check-out date Sofia’s partner helped me to bring it down, very nice and thanks a lot!

Unbeatable location Clean and accurate to description Its a 2 floor walk up without elevator so please keep in mind if you have heavy luggages Also the shower water pressure is a bit low but nothing to worry about All in all it was a good stay, great central location and walkable to all sights and will gladly come back Thank you

Tania’s place was absolutely wonderful! The tram is just around the corner of the building, the place was sparkling clean, spacious, and comfortable. As mentioned in the description, there is no coffee, tea, snacks or shampoo/conditioner but there is a grocery store around 5 mins by foot. Would definitely recommend this place :)

I had a great time in Zurich. Ruth is very helpful and kind,she is very careful and quick with the answers, always willing to help! The apartment is really clean and well located, very convenient to go from Zurich main station and other train stations, and a short walk away to bus and tram stations also. She allowed me to use her refrigerator and kitchen, just like in my own home. Check in was super easy,same as the check out.

We had a lovely weekend in this beautifully furnished flat directly in the hub of Zurich life with gorgeous views of the lake from the apartment windows. The property was spotlessly clean with everything we needed and the check-in process could not have been easier with our own access via a password without the need to meet a host. The only two issues we encountered were the noise from outside the windows as it is located on a very busy street full of bars, on a Friday and Saturday the volume continued until around 2-3am, and it was also extremely hot in the apartment, often to points of discomfort.
I would recommend staying here. Plenty of space for 6 adults. Right in town and parking nearby. Communication was quick and easy. The place was clean and quiet.

James is a wonderful host. He was professional and helpful. This house was better than described. Amazing walkable location. And actually we thought from the pictures only one double bedroom but there are two and a loft. The common area great for our family to spend time together when we got home late and we're still getting used to the time change. Thank you James!!

The place is nice just near the center of the city you can get there in tram. The host was kind and let us do the check out an 1 hour later. The only issue we had were the spiders, there were spiderwebs everywhere I understand that special when it’s cold spiders are everywhere but I would recommend clean the webs.
Ruth was the nicest host and makes you feel right at home!

Amazing place in the center of Zurich! Stayed for 6 days and the apartment was everything we wanted. 3 bedrooms with 2 full baths and 1 half bath. Full kitchen. Washer and dryer which were huge as we could do laundry before moving onto the rest of a 12 day trip. Air conditioners in every room. 2 hair dryers. Keypads to get into building door and apartment door so it’s as easy as it gets. There are steps as there are 3 levels within the apartment but they are small and easy to manage. Location is unbeatable and can walk to everything. Host is responsive and provides all info early. Would stay here every time we are back in Zurich!

Beautiful home- it was bigger than we anticipated. Sadly we didn’t get to utilize the pool due to the rainy weather all week. The short walk to the tram was very convenient. With a baby, the only slight negative was the creaky floor and stairs in the main hallway, but the house overall is pretty kid friendly. We loved our stay!

The location of this place is great, close to public transport and close to the city. However, there are too many house rules and the house is not very clean (it did not get cleaned a single time in the 6 weeks I was staying there, except for the room which got cleaned once at the start of my stay). Most importantly though, the bed is not good. It is a double bedframe but only has a single and very thin mattress and the duvet doesn't fit the cover. If you open the window it is quite noisy because of the traffic, but with the window closed it is quiet. I would not recommend this for a long stay, as I found it hard to get proper sleep with the bed.

I booked Fabio’s Apartment for a whole week to look for an apartment in Zürich. The location is perfect, close to the centre and everything you need is close by. Fabio was very flexible concerning the check-in, and also the check-out. I found a place after only a few days and he was kind enough to agree to a refund since I left early. Concerning the rooms, there are actually two, both are quite spacious; however one of them is facing a busy road and you have noise throught the night if the windows are open. The bathroom was super clean as was the living room, not too tidy, since nobody lives in the apartment permanently. All in all it was a good experience and I can recommend the room for a weekend trip to Zürich!

Fabio was willing to help from the beginning, and the communication with him was perfect. The place can not be closer to the park of Irchel where the university is located, and it is 1 min far from a well communicated tram and bus stop. Even if the street is pretty noisy, my room was located towards a quiet garden at rhe back, so it was very quiet and convenient to rest at night, which is a vital point for me. The living room is not cozy, but the room has good light. I recommend the house for stays of weeks or some months.

The Apartment is very well equipped, I didn't miss anything. I also had an early check-in to facilitate my move which was very much appreciated. The Apartment was clean (cleaning person came 3 days before) and tidy. Fabio also provides a mini website with all the instructions and things you should know, that is very helpful. I recommend this host.

It has been a nice stay in Zurich and a positive experience living in Sofia's apartment. It is tiny, true, but a comfortable base right in the city centre, a few minutes away from the main station. The apartment is in a very quiet and characteristic part of the city, just in front of the Lindenhof gardens. Two rooms, one en-suite, guarantee privacy and comfort. Every shop you need is just few steps away as well as the main university departments. The apartment is old as the building and the furniture may look a little oudated. However, being tidy and dry, is absolutely funtional and I heve never felt the need of something more updated. Just a note : some guests can be untidy and should be reminded to pay respect to the host who is offering the service.
My one-month stay at Sofia's apartment was a fantastic experience. She is very responsive and always ready to help. The location is also perfect.

The place was absolutely stunning and was located in such a beautiful district--extremely clean and walking distance to convenient tram stops and numerous nearby restaurants. The neighborhood is quiet and peaceful if you are looking to relax...and the bars/clubs are just minutes away if you are searching for nightlife. Unfortunately, we were not able to meet Tania in person, but she definitely made sure all of our needs were taken care of. This will not be my only visit to Zurich for sure...and hopefully, this apartment will be available the next time we travel there. Thanks Tania!!

Tania's flat was great! Great location, laundry unit was a huge plus. Only one flight up and near the tram stop. Walking distance from nice parks and good morning runs. Spacious apartment. Tania was also great at communicating and getting into the flat was easy.

My family and I stayed at Tania's place during a business trip to the city and we loved it! The location is perfect and only a couple of blocks away from the lake. Which is great for night walks and the large park was a great place for our son to play in. The apartment is extremely clean, has everything you need, including an iron and ironing board which came in handy. Beds were comfortable and the shower pressure is extremely strong! Parking could also be found nearby during our entire 4-night stay. I purchased Tagesbewillung online from the city of Zurich which allows you to park in any of the blue zones within the city, and there are several near the apartment. Overall i would definitely recommend this place and would stay here in the future!
Host is really nice and helpful and easy to communicate. We were a little late to arrive but the host waited us. My friend said that she had a nice sleep there.

I'm not sure that it's possible to find a better place to stay in the heart of Zurich. Maria's place is spacious by Zurich standards, in a comfortable neighborhood with plenty of cafes and restaurants and parks within a few blocks. Two bedrooms, a huge kitchen, a cute little patio, and lots of nice Chilean and Swiss touches throughout. Considering how pricey Zurich is, Maria's place was mind-blowingly inexpensive. There's a tram right outside the door that can take you wherever, but we barely used it -- Zurich is compact, and you can walk anywhere. The 10-minute walk from the train station is uphill, so if you have a lot of luggage, you might prefer a cab, but it's a great stroll without baggage. :) I can't recommend this place enough! Just do it.

The apartment was clean, modern, and in a central location. We had trouble with the laundry machine (the breaker was off, so it didn't turn on), but they were quick to come fix it. We stayed with a 1 yr old and they had a pack and play for us. There is a grocery store just right around the corner and other shops and restaurants within walking distance. Apartment has portable AC unit, so it's not the best but we only had one day in Sep that was hot (low 80's). I'd stay there again in a heart beat!

This is a beautiful spacious apartment in the center of Zurich's shopping district. It was only a 15-minute walk to see New Year's Eve fireworks on the lake. James answered my emails very quickly and even anticipated some.
The apartment is perfect. We enjoyed our stay. Perfect location in Zurich and an extremely short walk to the main train station and all other trams! We will definitely be back!

This Airbnb location is not what the renter represents. We have a disabled child and the elivator does not reach the room location. They say they have air conditioning but they are simple air units that do not cool the rooms in the summer. Three units for 7 rooms. We found the host James to be very dishonest.
Wonderful location next to the main station with stunning views of the cityscape. Check in was easy and convenient
The stay was nice but the BNB wasn’t cleaned and the host tried to make me switch to a different location. It was pretty concerning because we weren’t sure if we would have a place to stay or not.
We stayed here before and love the space. Location is great, James is very responsive-we will definitely be back and will always hope to stay here!
Great place in the heart of zurich close by the lake. Tania is very responsive and always helpful 24/7 great hospitality. Will come back anytime...thanks a lot

Easy and quick to communicate with Tania. The place was not difficult to find. However there is no air-conditioning in the very hot days of over 30 degree. We could hardly sleep with just two small fans while all the windows have to be closed because of lots of flied in bugs.
Tania is very responsive and accommodating. The location is in the center but in a very quiet neighborhood so it is very nice!

The apartment is fine. Very good location, overall clean, good amenities. However, the host is unresponsive on AirBNB messaging, and it was a bit of a challenge getting in. If you just need a place to stay in Zurich, I would recommend it, but it won't blow you away.

Stephanie is a n awesome host. She responded to all my questions promptly. The description of the apartment is accurately but take note that this apartment is at the top floor. Although, there is an elevator but there is a part of staircase to the apartment. If you have many luggage, might need to re-consider. Suitable for family and friends.

Enjoyed my stay at this apartment. The apartment is around 5 minutes walk to Oerlikon train station and also near to the tram station. Lift works wonderful and speedy as ours was on the 4th floor. The room we got was a delightful surprise too! We enjoyed our stay and hope to come back again soon.
Great location and apartment. The flat is huge and comfortable.

Tania is very kind landlord. She gave me an early check-in when she knew that I arrived early in the morning. The house is clean and tidy. It is very close to the tram station. It takes only 15 minutes to Zurich main station. Highly recommend this house.

An amazing location! Down the block from tram stop and grocery store. On the other side - a few blocks from lake and Corbusier pavilion. Glad it had a lift (tiny but functional) up to our floor. Loved the shutters. Able to get complete blackout for sleeping in! :-) Appreciated the washer / dryer - bring your own detergent. In terms of noise- it was fairly quiet. Baby is super sound sensitive and she never woke from street or noise transference from another unit. Another thing I noticed - not sure if it is how Swiss places are made, but - each room threshold would be a few inches difference, which makes it a perfect tripping height as you walk between rooms. Small matter overall. Would totally stay here again!

The flat is a wonderful and well-maintained two bedroom place. All the amenities you need. Decent kitchen if you choose to eat in a bit to save money. Very quiet area with quiet well lit during the day and dark shades at night. Hyesook was very nice and easy to get in touch with. We had a great time and recommend it to everybody coming to Zurich.

The apartment looked great on the web site and we were guided by all the positive reviews. However, when we got there, the apartment exceeded our expectations. It was spacious, bright, warm, and each room was well equipped. We felt very welcome and comfortable. The apartment building is also beautiful. The location is fantastic – just a few minutes’ walk from the main train station. Communication with Hyesook and her family was amazingly efficient and they were eager to be of further assistance (what to do) once we arrived. As you settle in, you notice little touches that have been added to make you feel at home – we’ll let you discover those for yourself. We highly recommend this apartment.

Me and my girlfriend stayed here for ~1 month when we first relocated to Zurich. The apartment was lovely. The location is fantastic. Plus Tania always responded within a few mins to any requests or inquiries. The only thing I would warn future guests about is if you are moving to Switzerland to stay, the local kreisburos(government registration offices) can be a bit odd about registering you with an air bnb booking. I observed this not only myself, but with a lot of other people who started in my new batch in work. This is more something for airbnb to resolve with the Swiss authorities than anything specific to this property. Thanks a lot for having me Tania and I would certainly stay again or put up my family if they come to visit.

I spent 2 nights in Tania's apartment and loved it. Close to the water and easy walking distance to the centre of Zurich. The apartment itself is very welcoming - spacious, light, well equipped and quiet, and Tania is easily contactable and very helpful. I would recommend this to anyone travelling to Zurich for a short stop over or a longer stay. Fabulous. Thank you so much Tania.
Super apartment, close to the station! Clean, well equipped and Hyesook is a perfect host! Hope to come back soon!
The place is spacious, comfortable and convenient just as the listing. The Host was very responsive.

Everything was just perfect during our stay. The kitchen is really well equipped, the washer/dryer worked wonderfully. We enjoyed warm evenings sitting on the terrace. The beds were very comfortable. The bathroom is in great shape and very clean. And there was plenty of space for all 4 guests. The location is excellent- just a 5 minute walk to the main train station, plenty of grocery stores, bakeries, restaurants within 1-3 minutes walk and the main part of downtown just 7 minutes walk. Our host was excellent- she provided lots of advice on things to do, places to go and responded to our questions (via the airbnb app) very quickly. I highly recommend this apartment!
Had a great time booking with Dimi, very responsive and helpful. The apartment was exactly as advertised and I would recommend it to anyone.

Stayed here a second time after our travel plans changed last minute. It's so comfortable and homey. I love the location, really easy being so close to the train station. I love the classic apartment details like the high ceilings and tiles entry way. It has a really nice extra deep tub to soak in. The bests are the most comfortable beds. I would honestly come back to Zurich just to be able to stay in this apartment. So comfortable!
Spacious, clean, quiet apartment 5 minutes walk to the lake. Excellent tram service and a good supermarket nearby. Demi was excellent at communicating.

Great location, clean, and nicely equipped (really appreciated the N espresso machine). The two bedrooms go to the back, so very quiet notwithstanding the proximity to public transport. Check-in was easy, the host Tania was very responsive. Would definitely chose this place again.

Great location, close to railway station, groceries, lakes. The living room by the street side is bit noisy, especially the place directly below the window open till after midnight. Those people talk loud. However, the two bedrooms (2+1) on the other side is quiet and comfortable. The place is clean and organized well.

Tania’s apartment was clean, bright, and spacious with a very convenient location for seeing Zürich. My husband and I stayed for 10 days, making a few side trips to see other parts of Europe. We were glad to find that the kitchen was well equipped and that the washer and dryer worked as well. We were somewhat disappointed that the bathroom did not include toiletries, not even hand soap, and that we were only provided with one towel each for a 10 day stay- the only other towels were only available for a fee. We found that the large bed was not that comfortable for us, so we ended up sleeping separately (but comfortably) on the pullout couch and single bed. Ultimately, we were happy with our stay. Thank you Tania for hosting!
Excellent location: easy and rapid to centre of Zurich. The rooms are quite, but the saloon can be quite noisy as the apartment is just over a restaurant

This was amazing. Location is A+. Apartment is quite roomy and easily accessible. The elevator is quite small, we could barely fit a buggy in this. But that's the only negative point I can think of. We loved the apartment.

Perfect apartment just steps away from public transportation, great restaurants and shopping! Bus/tram stop is less than 2min walking distance making traveling and getting around so easy. Tania was an excellent host. Check in/check out was a breeze and she was so kind and responsive. The apartment was spotless and had everything we needed for a comfortable 10 day stay. This was the perfect place to stay in while in Zurich and the only place I would stay in Switzerland!

This place could not be in a better location. It's right next to the bus and the train station, so it's perfect for those jumping on tours and stuff like that. The space is very spacious and comfortable. Hyesook was super nice and helpful if we had any questions. The only negatives we could think of would be the bedroom closest to the train station can hear the trains running all night, but the other bedroom was completely quiet. Not a huge deal at all, but it's more for awareness of people aren't used to that noise. Additionally, it's on the 4th floor, and you need to climb spiraling steps. Again, not a big deal for us, just more for awareness if you want to stay here. Overall, the place was wonderful, and we'd recommend others to stay as well!

We had a great stay at Hyesook’s place. Even though we arrived very late we were met by her daughter and check-in and check-out were both very easy. There are lots of great amenities including a Nespresso machine. The bedrooms are comfortable and quiet. The main space is really nicely decorated and fun to hang out in. Hyesook was also very accommodating when due to some unforeseen circumstances we needed to extend our stay by two nights at short notice. All in all highly recommend!
Very nice place in the heart of Zurich near train station. Host Heysook was wonderful and very easy to communicate with. I recommend this place if staying in downtown Zurich.

Hyesook's place is great for our stay in Zurich. The apartment is close to the Zurich train station and there are a lot of restaurants around. There are also two grocery stores nearby to get some necessities. Highly recommend this place when you're in Zurich.

Definitely one of the best Airbnb experiences. Ruth's house is located in central Zurich and everything is within the reach via either walking or tram (tram station is about 3 min walking). Her house was spacious yet cozy. The experience felt like real Swiss experience which we enjoyed. Ruth had been a great host as she is very responsive of our needs and did the she could do to provide the best experience for us. Highly recommended for sure!

We loved our stay in this apartment. Located in a beautiful old building, the rooms were spotlessly clean, quiet, spacious and comfortable. Hyesook was proactive and quick to respond to our queries and her daughter welcomed us at the apartment and showed us through. Located close to the city centre and to the train station this place is a gem. We highly recommend this apartment.
We had a pleasant stay at Lukasz's place. It is convenient from the apartment to reach any attraction in the city of Zurich. Quiet and safe neighbourhood.

It was far better than I expected. The room was big, well-designed, comfortable, and fully-equipped. The host was fast responding for everything and considerately prepared more than we could have thought of. There is a train station and a bunch of supermarkets nearby, with one that opens until late night. It was a bit far from city center — checking the train timetable before leaving the apartment should save a lot of waiting time.

Trudi is a truly amazing host. She genuinely cares that every person who stays in her place has a wonderful experience of the city and the house. The breakfast is so healthy and delicious. The rooms are adorable - really living in a historical house, but without lacking anything. The only thing I regret is that I had to leave so soon! Thank you Trudi!
Fantastic apartment, full of everything you need, the only downside was it was quite noisy at night being by so many bars and restaurants

Everything was perfect except no AC(there was some kind of fan, but I find it very noisy and not useful) , so I had to open the window during night, which was quite noisy (bars in the street). In all other aspects - it was perfect(flat itself, location, check in) and of course city ❤️
It's still my favorite place to stay in Zürich. It's always a pleasure to come back to Karen and Jakob. It was my 4th stay at Karens Apartment and not the last one for sure.
You will got as described. The place is in a good neighbourhood environment, clean and warm with a free wifi. Jung Soo is a good host, highly recommended..

Lorenzo's place is small yet quaint, and perfect for our 3 day visit in Zurich. It was clean, and had most things that you would need. The bed was comfy, the wifi worked great and it was an easy 5 min walk to the bus. It was a 15 bus ride into the centre and very easy to navigate. We did not meet Lorenzo but the communication was great, check-in was easy and he responded quick to questions during our stay. I would recommend Lorenzo's place, it is perfect for a couple.

I've stayed for a week in this calm apartment, it's cool and cozy. The kitchenette has most of the equipment you may need, the Wi-Fi is portable and you can take it to wherever you go and avoid paying for your cellphone's roaming! and the apartment is rather in a good location if you go to the city center by public transportation, however by walk it's a bit far. The only problem was about the neighbor who had a child and was crying in the mornings, and they use to watch TV loudly! All in all, I highly recommend it...
I had a great stay at Lea's - she and her flat mate are super nice, communication was easy and the place is very central in Zurich. Would definitely stay there again!

I stayed in one of the rooms for 15 nights, it was really pleasant! The two other rooms were also occupied but the guests were really silent and friendly. Kitchen has every equipment that you would need to make some meals or breakfast. The internet connection was really great and fast, so if you want to work from here it is really great! Lea was really nice and friendly! Thanks for everything!

Beautiful apartment in an amazing location - really couldn't have been better for access to the city (we used the tram one day, walked it the next), local shops and the lake. It has everything you could wish for and all really good quality and spotlessly clean. We loved Zurich and honestly can't wait to come back. Would recommend 100% without hesitation. Thank you!

Great stay, the location is in good distance to Oerlikon train station where you get easily and quickly to all spots in Zurich. The place is quiet. The host has been super friendly, reliable and reacting fast to my requests. Thanks Jung Soo!

Dominique's place is superb. There is a lake with pretty view just 2 minutes walk, so does the tram stops. The place is clean with complete cooking utensils. The neighborhood is interesting with a lot of options for food, coffee, and bakery. The only catch is the check-in procedure is a bit confusing since we do not know at first which floor/unit is Dominique's. Once settled, everything is absolutely splendid! Definitely will go back to Dominique's if I had the opportunity to travel to Zurich again.

Highly recommended! William's place is awesome: conveniently located with a great view and comfortable atmosphere. A similarly priced room at the Marriott across the street would be upwards of $300 so it is an amazing deal! Though we didn't get to spend much time with him, we could tell that William is a really great and sincere guy. Stay here and you will not regret it!
Comfortable, spacious and quiet apartment. Very close to the tram and in walkable distance to the centre. Not far at all from the beautiful lake. The host, Dominique, is good at communicating :)
Great apartment. Dominique was very communicative and responsive. It was an easy walk/bus ride to everything we wanted to see. The neighborhood was quiet and safe. We’d stay here again.

I have nothing but the highest praise for Dominique and his flat in the Seefeld neighborhood of Zurich. The location is perfect--extremely quiet and yet only a block off of the lake and a block away from a tram stop, easily walkable to the opera, the Bellevue tram stop, and the top of the lake and the old city. The flat was ideal for our family of 4, with comfortable beds, a sizeable kitchen, and a thoughtfully designed bathroom. We took advantage of the laundry facilities in the basement, as we had been traveling for a week by the time we arrived in Zurich, and that was a huge advantage. The apartment was spotless when we checked in. Dominique communicated better than my own family members as we were planning the trip! All in all, I could not have asked for better.

The location is very good. You're just off of a metro line and Zurich HB is 10 minutes by train. The space itself is also beautiful with a super comfy bed. Cristian is super responsive and will help with anything you need!

We really enjoyed our stay at Beata's flat! It was comfortable, clean and had everything we needed for a long weekend in Zurich. The flat is within easy walking distance of the centre of town, and also very close to loads of public transport, supermarkets and great restaurants/bars. Beata's mum was lovely and helpful when we checked in. We would definitely stay again :) Thanks!

The apartment is located in a nice area of Zürich: it had a lot of great terraces and restaurants. We walked a lot, and the citycenter was about a 30 minute walk. You could also go there by public transport. The apartment itself is bigger than it looks on the photos. However, it's a bit outdated: for example the couch has a lot of stains on it, and it's covered with a blanket. Furthermore, the apartment smells like cigarettes smoke. As none smokers, we didn't appreciate that. An upside of the apartment is that it offers a free parking space! Great for people who travel by car. All in all, we would recommend this place, but don't set your hopes to high, price/quality wise it's ok!

We felt very well during our more than two weeks stay in Thomas his apartment. It has a very modern feel, very clean, every room is correspondingly fully equipped. Good wifi, comfortable bed, fantastic sofa… Thomas is a great host, welcomed us at the apartment, showed and explained us everything. A wine, cheese and some cold cuts offer by Thomas made a great welcome arrival after a long journey. We would definitely like to stay here again .

Perfect place for your stay in Zurich. After almost 3 weeks there, all I can say is fully recommended. Great location, with close bus and tram connections, and also Oerlikon station. The apartment (and the room) is spacious, fully equipped and clean. Daniel and the other flatmates were very nice, and they try to make their guests feel at home. Upon my arrival, they even gave me a tour to know the neighborhood.

Apartment itself is quite nice, located under 15 min walking from the train station. Place is clean, spacious, located on the first floor. Fast reliable WiFi. The windows are facing the street with 4 bars basically under the windows. Bar customers create a lot of noise even on week days and at night. The noise is quite disturbing even with closed windows. The place itself was very nice, but it is REALLY noisy and the noise did not stop until 04.00 in the early morning!! It is very difficult to sleep. Please know that the apartment is located in the red-light district of Zurich. We did not know this until we arrived. The place is well equipped and Jacqueline is a lovely person.
Great apartment in very convenient location which was accessible to both the train station and central Zurich

Sarah's loft flat was literally right in the heart of the old town, with its cobbled streets and traditional architecture. The loft was small and cosy, and had absolutely everything necessary for a comfortable stay. Although I didn't get to meet Sarah, we kept in touch through messaging and she was very responsive. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone wishing to stay in Zurich!

Thank you so much Tania for the wonderful hospitality. The property was very cozy, perfectly equiped and in a very quite area. The problem we had with our modem was repaired very fast. Again thank you for everything. We will definately visit you again.

Pricy appartement - more expensive than most hotels, but quite close to the city center and the interior is cosy and nice. Communication and check-in/out is very easy. Convenient spot to stay in whilst in Zurich.

We stay for 4 nights together with my wife and our 10 years old daughter. It fit nicely for the 3 of us. We enjoy watching Netflix and cooking during our free time. Washing machine is in working condition with built in dryer. Toilet is clean too. Location is good with tram station nearby. The only few downside is we have to carry our 3 luggage and climb up the stair but is only 1 level up, so not a huge problem for us. I suggest to have a pair of scissors in the kitchen. Thank you

My mistake was not to read previous reviews properly. This air bnb would be great for anyone coming to Zürich for fun and spending time out enjoying all the central attractions. Location is fab. Communication with hosts very good and they kindly let us check in early. But for us it wasn’t great. We needed a good nights sleep but the room (and it is a room with an ensuite rather than an apartment) was boiling hot , even with a fan as it’s at the top of the building in the eaves. Open the windows and half of Zürich seemed to be outside in the square partying. My teenage son would have loved it probably. So overall not a bad place but just didn’t suit us. Maybe better in the winter when cooler.

Cannot emphasize what an awesome location this is for exploring the city. You are close to the lake, right in old town and can virtually walk to all the major sites/train station to get other places. The only downside was how hot it was in the unit which made it difficult to sleep at night but Zurich usually doesn’t experience weather so hot in the summer so people don’t really have AC. You definitely get your money’s worth here!

The best thing about this apartment is location. It is superb. Right in the middle of the old town, close to everything. The place is very small, but has everything you need. However, if you are sensitive to noise, this is not for you. The windows look into the courtyard with restaurants and a night club and you can’t close the windows because it is super hot and stuffy inside. Other than that, it a good place to stay.
We had a very comfortable stay. The apartment was clean and in a convenient location. Tania was very responsive to any messages. We would stay again!

Flat was really great, though it was not in the center but the area was well connected and easy to reach everywhere, and the surroundings also had everything, supermarket, restaurants… etc Place was clean and we enjoyed our stay

Great appartment with nice central location. Quick and efficient reactions from Tania. Quiet surrounding. Nice terrace on the roof, while it was cold enough to enjoy it)) I would love to stay here again in the future

Chris and Christiana were very nice and allowed me to check in early. The location is fantastic and convenient, so if you're someone who just needs a bed and shower between Zurich excursions, this is a good place for you. The listing is very basic, no kitchen, and some inconveniences with trash and dishes. I was visiting for work, so needed to spend a decent amount of time in the property to do work. Wifi gave me some issues while working at the table, and a lot of the lights didn't work, so it wasn't ideal for my situation. But the privacy was nice, and playing some white noise on my phone helped drown out any external noise.

Great location. In the middle of the city, very close to everything. Everything is walkable, even the Central train station is 17 minutes walk. Tiny space however anything we need was there. Clean well equipped place. Easy and flexible check in/out. Definitely recommend the place.
Location of our stay was perfect, easy to get around and right by the river. For a short stay, this apartment was great however a little dusty.

Really lovely hosts and good place to stay for a few nights. Perfectly central in the Old town which was perfect for all Christmas market wonderings. Beautiful winter vibes! In general, Zurich was very expensive, so this place matched the price of surrounding spots. However, I still had a good stay. So overall happy!

Deborah was an excellent host to us. I visited Zurich with 3 other friends and we all had an excellent experience. Starting with her written out directions from the airport to her apartment via train. She was also very thoughtful to welcome us with some fruits and chocolate. Apartment was very clean especially the bathroom and kitchen. We had 2 beds and they were comfortable. Neighborhood was quiet at night. I'd definitely stay at her place again if I should visit Zurich in the future. Thank you Deborah

The apartment is spacious, well-furnished and very clean. Location-wise, it's about 15 mins away by tram from Zurich HB (central train station). The neighbourhood is peaceful and there's a large grocery store nearby. Our host - Deborah - is thoughtful and caring which made our stay very relaxing and stress-free.

The place is perfect for business or tourist/family stay. Tram/bus station 12mins from city center is right next to the flat and the location itself is suitable for walks and beautiful view over the city and it's surroundings. We had beautiful evenings on the terrace with the view over the city. The only little disadvantage for those who likes the full silence during the night is the near tram line. The owner is kind and responsive in communication. The flat is fully equipped and is in very good condition.

We had a great stay at Petra's home. It is in a quiet street but very near public transport, supermarket and everything else we needed. While check-in went with a key in a lockbox, Petra also met us personally on the day of arrival and departure -- something which not many hosts do and gave the stay a more personal touch :) The apartment itself had all the amenities we needed, including a cosy living room and enough toys for our daughter to play with. Recommended!

Petra was a very kind and attentive host. She allowed us to check in early and always responded clearly and quickly. The house is very nice, comfortable, cozy, and spacious. Using Zurich's excellent public transportation, it is very easy and quick to reach the location. There are markets nearby as well. My parents and I really enjoyed the experience and we thank Petra for welcoming us so warmly!

Rakhal is an excellent host—always available and highly responsive. The flat offers a fantastic view, which you can enjoy from the terrace. Situated in a residential area, it is very quiet, yet well-connected by public transportation with direct trams and buses to the city center. Additionally, grocery stores are within walking distance. I would definitely book it again!

Lara's Loft is indeed a cozy place for a longer stay nearby downtown Zurich. The Tram stations are within a stone's throw away, which is very useful for ppl traveling without a car. The apartment is clean, bright and very tastefully furnished. Book it, you won't regret!

Thierry's house was absolutely gorgeous! My husband and I were traveling with my parents, and my sibling, and one of her friends so 6 of us in total. The one bed doesn't have as much privacy, but works absolutely perfectly for families/groups of friends/etc. The master bedroom is absolutely gorgeous, and the house overall could not have been cleaner or more tidy!

Actually, I quiet surprise that it is not a three bed rooms apartment, it only have one bedroom, one bed in the common area and one bed near the stairs. Besides, the cleanliness of the kitchen and dining room can be improved a little bit. However, the bath room is perfect, clean and large. The location is also convenient and the host is really nice.

Michael's place was perfect. His place is easy to find. Laura, his associate, welcomed us when we arrived. She was very accommodating and even let us borrow her converters when we realized the ones we had didn't work. Good walking distance to old town. Overall a very pleasant stay. One thing I will say, is there are a lot of steps to get everything up so keep that in mind if you have heavy luggage. Otherwise, I recommend this place to anyone who wants a relaxing visit to Zurich.

Thierry was a fabulous host and nothing was too much trouble. The apartment was perfect for our family (of 6 - 4 teens) and the proximity to the city via Tram was brilliant. It was clean, modern and a good size for a large family. Would have no hesitation in returning in the future.

Great place for couples or two friends. Small space but it gets the job done. Only a few minute walk to the train, plenty of bars, restaurants and entertainment. Shopping is close by as well. Very clean.

Michael’s place was very clean and cosy. As it is on the top floor, it gets a bit hot in the summertime. The windows and fan provide good air circulation, but the street outside is noisy. Not a problem if you are a heavy sleeper like I am!

Very centrally located and well priced! The bedrooms were very small - I’d consider maybe 4 people would be comfortable here… we had 6 and the living space was ample but the sleeping arrangements were small and cramped. Overall I’d recommend!

We loved staying in this cozy apartment! The location can’t be beat - next to many great bars and restaurants in a cute part of town. Michael gave great suggestions for specific places to eat and drink. Communication and checking in was quick. Easy to take the train/tram to the airport. We wish we had more time here!

Great place but the outside can be extremely loud at night. Two nights there people were legitimately screaming at 4am. Presumably they were hammered, but I can’t think of a time I’ve been hammered and screaming at 4am. Maybe I’m not doing it right. Anyway, that’s my only complaint. It kept us up.

The space was lovely, super clean and smelled good! The only small issue we had was with locking the door, but I sent Michael a message about it and he responded immediately with a tip. We fixed the issue quickly. Great communication! Would stay again.

We arrived slightly early( about 1.5 hours) I think the miscommunication was on my end I thought the place would be ready but their idea was just for us to drop the luggage therefore the place wasn’t in a clean state. They did allow us to leave the luggage but we wanted to be able to freshen up after the flight and the bathrooms were still dirty etc. we left for 5 hours came back and it was clean. Location is great…very close to the train station and old town… also with a grocery store nearby (Coop) Overall would recommend this place. Couch was stained and not comfortable. The leather chaise was nice. Only stayed one night so can’t comment on kitchen amenities Very spacious bathrooms.

This was a great place. It was close to town and the train station. It was around a lot of great restaurants. The apartment was clean and fully stocked for cooking if you wanted to stay in. We enjoyed our stay here.

We spent 1 week at Campell’s Mansion. The studio was beautiful, very modern and the view from the windows is stunning. The stairs to get to the 3rd floor can be a bit challenging if you have suitcases but once you are at the top of the house it is very satisfying! Even if you are in the owner’s house, it still feels private. It is very quiet and the neighborhood is quite lovely. We loved the breakfast: champagne, homemade tart, and local cheese...

I have stayed at Duri’s place three times now for work trips. The location for me is ideal, walking distance from the main train station, the old city and the University. The check in is always seamless. The apartment is perfect for a single business traveler. I will certainly be staying at Duri’s the next time I’m in Zürich.
Great apartment convenient to many activities and public transport. Laundry facilities were available when we needed them. Very clean apartment, the neighbors were all very quiet. Great experience!

Excellent place to stay! A very modern and updated space which is so refreshing to be in. The hosts have not cut corners on any details. For the price and its easy access to the city center, you can’t beat it! I will return next time if it’s available

We had a very nice stay at Tania's place. This home is clean and spacious and very close to public transit (or you can walk ~20 mins to the city center/near the train). The kitchen is fully stocked with cooking supplies like pots and pans, but there is no oil or seasoning so if you plan to cook you need to buy those things for yourself. Overall, a great stay!

The flat is awsome. It's sparkling clean, close to the center and in a very nice neighborhood. There is supermarket around the corner and many bars and restaurants. I completely recommend Tania's flat for your stay in Zürich

Nice cozy apartment in very good location. Tram and Train station at 1 min walk. Bahnhofstrass and Lake Zurich are walking distance. Apartment is well furnished with well equipped kitchen. One thing to note is that parking is difficult in this area. There r not parking on same street. You may have to go around and park in back streets. Good thing is that for overnight parking you can park in white spots (8pm to 9am). But the challenge is getting the parking. Parking garages are a bit far. You don't need a car for moving around within Zurich. I was driving from Geneva so had the car for the night.

Gecy’s apartment was spotless and amazing! Even though she didn’t speak English we were able to translate everything and she was very kind! The room itself is spacious and comfortable! Would recommend to anyone :)

Spacious and clean, even the dishes were sparkling. Location for value was great. There is noise from upstairs (mostly kids, so it’s acceptable) but they quiet down after 10pm. The tiny elevator was much appreciated after long days of walking. Would gladly stay again.
Really cute place, could’ve used some extra pillows, but otherwise great. The location is perfect, however if you keep the windows open it is a bit loud and bright!

The apartment is very clean and comfortable. It is located in a super quiet residential neighbourhood, very close to public transport (tram and suburban railways). Internet connection works flawlessly. For those who forget or just don't realise that AC sockets in Switzerland are not compatible with most of the usual plugs, an AC adapter is provided. Check-in is fully automatic, so I didn't have the chance to meet the landlady, Ms. Gabi, in person. However I spoke to her on the phone and has always been extremely kind and helpful. It was a great pleasure to stay in Gabi's apartment.

Would really recommend Norell’s flat to anyone looking for somewhere to stay in Zürich. The flat is absolutely beautiful, and very well equipped with everything you would need, including a coffee machine ! It’s also conveniently located - it takes about 30 minutes to get to the airport, and it’s also walkable to the city centre (about a 20 minute walk). Norell was also a very helpful and communicative host. We had a really lovely stay here.
Gabi’s place is great. Very clean. Nice quiet neighborhood. Close to train station and only 1 stop from the airport. Gabi is a great host. Very responsive

We had a great stay at Gabi's place! it is a lovely neighbourhood, super clean room and flat, straightforward check-in. It is very close to tram lines and Oerlikon station, so we could get everywhere we wanted to be quickly, whilst having the bestof a peaceful neighbourhood in which to stay. The garden with Wisteria around the corner is beautiful (MFO park), wort checking out. We will be back if back in Zurich! Thanks Gabi 😊 R&T

Solid and good quality apartment in a wonderful area of Zurich. Quiet neighborhood. Close to the lake (5-10min walking distance). Spacious apartment. Well equipped and simply decorated. Apartment is directly above a simple Swiss restaurant; this is an advantage if you do not want to cook yourself. However, can be a disadvantage if you are sensitive to noisy restaurant guests.
Wonderfully place, great value and close to the tram line! I would stay again

Great flat to stay, clean and tidy, quick response, I especially love the balcony, sit there and hear and see the waterfall. It is really close to the botanic park. However we didn’t have time to go there. I hope next time I can stay here again and visit the park.

A lovely apartment in a nice part of town with local amenities and easy access to transport links or walking into the city centre. Worked really well turning the lounge area with the sofa bed into a second bedroom.

5min driver from ZURICH HB. 10min walk from Zurich HB. beautiful apartment facing the park. Spacious apartment. easy check in- check out. lots of restaurants and convenience stores are just around the corner. we were on 3rd floor. it had lift too and easy access. very functional; nothing fancy but the apartment had homely vibe and we loved it.
Perfect little studio apartment for 1 person, maybe 2. Very central to old town Zürich, shopping and dining. The bed is comfortable and the view is fantastic.

This B&B has the perfect location in the middle of the old town. The appartement is tiny but fits very well for 2 persons. The only pain point was the curtains didn't block out the light as they were orange and made the room very bright and the view from the window was beautiful and straight down to the river, which could bring too many lights in the morning. Otherwise, the appartement was perfect!

Chris’s place location is perfect, heart of Zurich, near many good restaurants and markets, 10 mim walk to the Hauptbahnhof (central station) and right in front of the Limmat River (beautiful view). Inside it has everything you need but no kitchen sink, the only sink is in the bathroom.
Perfect Location in the center of Zürich. Super easy Check-in and Check-out!

Had a wonderful stay in Chris' place - excellent location in the heart of downtown Zurich, literally minutes walk from all the major tourist attractions and Zurich's main train station. Very clean and has large windows with a beautiful view of the river!!

The location of this stay is incredible, you can’t ask for better. It is centrally located in the old city and no more than a 2 minute walk to a tram stop. The view is great and one that I’d recommend. The only thing I would have asked for was a cleaner place when we arrived. We could tell it hadn’t been dusted and there was hair in the drain from the last person.

Chris' place is wonderful. The location is perfect with an incredible view. Steps away from shops, restaurants, bars, sights, the tram and more. Check-in and out was super easy as well and Chris was very communicative. The only thing to note is that since this is in the heart of everything and right on the water, there is a bit of outside noise you'll have to deal with during the day and through the night. Didn't really bother us since we're used to it (from NYC) but if you're a light sleeper, keep that in mind.
The apartment was clean and comfortable. The location was convenient. Our hosts were accommodating and helpful. We very much enjoyed our stay.
Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and the host was very friendly and helpful.

The location and space of the apartment is extremely good - 15 min walk to the main station and within 5 minutes you're on the main street with access to tons of bars and restaurants. Apartment is very big for sleeping 2 people. Our stay was great but we were there during Sechseläuten which meant the bells at the church next door went off quite early for a long time. If you don't like early (8am) wake ups or are a light sleeper it can be noisy as you're on a street near to bars and by a nice public area. Being on the top floor did mean the noise was less obtrusive, but still audible. Overall a great stay and would heavily recommend if you don't mind the bells.

Nice view from the unit however the place is very small, no kitchen just the electric stove and you need to wash the dishes in the sink. Not responsive host - the code to enter the building was not provided and had to follow up twice to get it. Once in the unit, needed help with the heater and messaged host twice with no response. Would not recommend this place.

The view from our place of the river and local cathedrals was beautiful. The city is quite walkable, however if you’re going a little further or don’t care to walk a tram stop is right out front. It’s a room with a bathroom as described. That’s all we needed as we were off to adventures every day. Bern, Junfrau, Interlaken and Lucerne.

This was definitely our favorite AiBnb that we have stayed in at Zurich! The view is really wonderful-- and truly immerses you in the charm of Switzerland. I loved seeing the waterfront, parks, observatory -- all from the comfort of the bedroom! Restaurants, grocery, and transit were all conveniently located! Everything was clean and comfortable!! We highly recommend and hope to book again on our next trip to Zurich!!

To be honest, not our favorite Airbnb we’ve stayed at. There was no paper with WiFi information and the password on the back of the router was incorrect. There was no shampoo, conditioner, or shower gel either. I didn’t like it that the apartment also has insect traps all over it. However the location was great.

Tania's apartment was in the perfect location! Very walkable through charming old town Zurich. The style was clean and minimalistic. Obtaining access was easy and seamless. The only area to improve would be providing simple amenities such as soap for guests. Thank you for our stay!

I couldn't have been more pleased with this apartment! It was clean, modern and well appointed. My favorite things were the big windows, the slide-down screen on the front-right window, and the roll-down sunshade on the back windows. These items helped keep the apartment at a pleasant temperature even on hot days. Location: It was in a quiet little neighborhood that happened, as if by magic, to be close to everything. Things I'll remember: the park across the street! It was wonderful! Kids and parents would appear there throughout the day and workmates would arrive to have lunch and a game of table tennis. Nothing loud, but with the window open, you couldn't help but smile.

Tania’s flat is spacious, clean, and in the perfect area of Zürich’s old town. We had everything we needed for our weekend stay and everything we wanted to see was within walking distance. Our favourite thing to do was to explore and wander around the area’s many alleyways. Tania was an excellent host and ensured we were well taken care of during our stay. We would be happy to spend another vacation here when we return to Zürich one day!

Simply one of the best apartments i stayed in. Its vintage but the appeal is in the classic design and space. I enjoyed exploring zurich from the apartment. It is very close walking distance to the stations and ammenities!
Great place, clean and well kept, awesome central location. The host was polite and easy to communicate with.

We had a great stay! Dimi was very kind, attentive, and proactive throughout our visit. The apartment was exactly as shown in the pictures — very comfortable for the four of us. The location is excellent, just a short walk from the station, which made it easy for us to explore other cities in Switzerland. Highly recommended!
Well, worth the money and a very good Location nice and quiet
Very pleasant stay at Lizzie's place with the curious and nice dog ;) Also she made our stay more comfortable becauae we could leave our stuff after check-out. Very appreciable

Five people stayed here for two nights. I recommend it for larger groups, like perhaps 3 couples. It's a good location, slightly out of the centre of the city but extremely close to the lake and to trams and shops and restaurants. The neighbourhood is stylish... but then again, everything in Zurich is pretty up-market. We felt very comfortable here - one nice feature is the large dining table where we could all eat and discuss things. The kitchen is wonderful, too. The bedrooms are huge and comfortable. There's a lift and the access and communication with host was good.

Sandra’s place was adorable and perfect for a stay in Zurich. She left clear directions and notes to explain how the AirBnb works and was there to answer any question! The room was cozy and the WiFi / Ethernet adapter worked very quickly! The only slightly negative point is that there is no lock on the bedroom door and you can’t keep the main door key with you. As a solo woman traveler this made me a bit nervous, but the area was safe so it was acceptable. Overall I would recommend Sandra’s place as a cozy and clean stay in Zurich! :)

This place is fantastic and we loved it! It is very connected to city center and available via tram to travel everywhere. Coop is nearby and convenient. Host Tania is a great host. We enjoyed our stay here and would like to come again!! The only thing which we mention to host as well was that the website of airbnb display two baths but in apartment we got one bath and one toilet which is incovenient for 8 people. we managed by adjusting wake up time, some got up very early and some got up once they were done. The house is pleasant and clean. The office staff is friendly and helpful. Highly recommended! Thanks again for everything.

We enjoyed our stay in this apartment and were so grateful that Tania could store our luggage before check in. The place was beautiful and much bigger than we expected. It was a great location right next to the tram so it was super easy to get around. There were many beautiful sights all within walking distance too. The beds were super comfortable and we liked that the toilet was separate from the tub/shower. The windows were excellent quality keeping out the street noises very effectively. We highly recommend this place.

I enjoyed drinking coffee in the garden and reading in the room. I hiked to the highest point in Zürich and walked to Coop for meals every day. It is a beautiful home and perfect location. The train and tram are so close you can get anywhere! I was in Zürich finishing some work from studying abroad in Italy, and this was the best place to get everything done. The Ethernet works extremely well and the room and desk were perfect. Despite how hot the weather was, the room stayed comfortably cool. I can’t describe how wonderful Sandra’s place is!! And, she is very smart, helpful, communicative, and warm. I only briefly met her son Baldus but he is very sweet. I felt at home. A cozy, beautiful, and tidy place! Also, Sandra’s instructions are charming and clear. Thank you :)

My 17 years old daughter and I, visited Zurich in August 2019 for a couple of days and stayed at Marina's place. The apartment was even better than the pictures posted here! Marina was so welcoming and on time on our arrival. She even helped with carrying our luggage with us while she didn't have to. I do highly recommend for couples or small family.

Tania's place is in a great location in Zurich. Walking distance from most places we wanted to see and lots of restaurants and bars in the neighbourhood. It was a good size for a family of 4 and the beds were comfortable. We did however find the bathroom with the toilet had not been cleaned properly but I'm sure with our feedback that will not be a problem in the future.
The apartment was perfectly clean and conveniently located near the tram stop.
Great place to stay. Had a wonderful time and great location. The only difficult item was parking.
The house has convenient transportation and there is a supermarket coop nearby; The kitchen in the house is spacious and comfortable to live in
The flat is located on a busy street. But the windows when close keep all the sound out. So you are in an area with lots of shops and can still enjoy a quiet night.

The apartment is really great. Very cozy, clean and spacious, the kitchen is well equipped and the shower is good. The location is also good, very easy to find, just 1 block from a tram/bus station that goes straight to the central station. The only detail is that the apartment is on the 3rd floor and there's no lift, so keep that in mind if travelling with large bags.

Marina’s place matches the description! It has a great location, the apartment is clean, and it’s perfect for a stay in Zürich. Marina is responsive, and she was kind to allow us an early check in since our flight arrived at 6AM. The only thing I will note is that you can hear the neighbors through the walls next to you and above you. This is not the hosts fault, but it’s helpful to know in case you’re a light sleeper. Lastly, we needed to buy a few extra items from the grocery store in order to be able to cook and eat leftovers. Overall, I highly recommend!
I have been staying in at the apartment for five years. The experience is always enjoyable, restful and very convenient.
There were some minor issues with the check-in process, but the host quickly resolved everything and provided alternative accommodation. Great service!
