Strahinja is a great host. The apartment is as it is in the pictures. Very clean and comfortable. Toiletries, towels and all a amenities were there. Kitchen is excellent with well stocked utensils and basic groceries. Close to Coop so easy to cook and eat. Thoughtful of the host to keep snacks and drinks. Would strongly recommend to families.
Great hosts, quiet and large guest room. The only “challenge” for some would be the hike up 5 flights to the apartment/flat.
Andrea was a great and helpful host. The space was clean and very stylish. The only downside was the 100 steps up to the apartment, but we knew this was the case and are much fitter for it!
Great place, great hosts!!!! Everything was even better than expected with all the details, goodies and information that we received. Definitely would recommend this place to anyone.

Everything about the apartment was exactly what we needed for my wife and 6 month old. Strahinja offered furniture for the baby to be in the apartment for us to use for the week and was extremely convergent. The snacks and drinks were very thoughtful. Miss that cozy couch already ;) Great location to get around the city. And we managed to find some english language shows/movies on the TV.
My priority was to have a great sleep. And this place is ideal, with absolute silence during the night. Near downtown, walking distance.!

A very lovely place to stay, the apartment is at a perfect location, very easy to get around with public transportation and in close proximity to the centre. The place is great, very clean and has a lot of amenities you need. The accommodation of pets is also a plus. Rudolf and his wife were very helpful since the beginning, available whenever I had any questions and direct with their answers, which was very much appreciated. Totally recommend to visitors or people who are moving to Zurich and need a place to stay for a short term whilst finding their feet.

Beautiful apartment in the center of the city, good and efficient communication with the host. Unfortunately the Jacuzzi was not working, which was a disappointment. There's also noise sensors in the apartment, which we found a bit intrusive.

Vanessa's place was a great stay for our 1 night in Zurich. Though we never got to meet Vanessa, Luis was great communicating with us and helping us get settled in. We had a car and even though there was not a spot provided, Luis was kind enough to help us park it on the premises with some help from the neighbors. The location is great, and even though it has been mentioned before it is on a busy street - however for us personally it was not a bother. Bathroom, room, and kitchen were all clean and great. The only downfall I would say is that the quilt on the bed seems to be for a single bed which can be a tug of war in the middle of the night if there are two of you.
Tania runs the best Airbnb’s in Zurich. They are always clean, well appointed, and in get locations. I highly recommend.
Overall the place is great, very central and upscale neighborhood. The elevator was unfortunately broken during our stay

Overall, the place was a great place to stay. The tram was so accessible, elevators were also available. Check In was a breeze. Dimi was a great host always responding. My only comment would be maybe in future there would be more details upon booking about what will be provided by the host, toiletries, hair dryer etc cleaning schedule for long periods of stay so that its clear and reduce questions. The bathroom, accessibility and affordability was my main consideration and it met my expectation. Other comment is for airbnb auto-translate, most of the time its incorrect translation which confused me a lot. I had to switch it off and result to google translate just so I can understand the translation.
Christian was a very nice and kind host. The apartment it’s a little small and old but it’s correct. The location is in a quiet neighborhood near everything. It’s a good place to stay.

This apartment is in a great location, close to Tiefenbrunnen station, which has a direct train from the airport (S16) and trains that go along lake Zurich. It was very useful to have the basic kitchen. The host was responsive and helpful. However, the apartment was not particularly clean, with dirt on the blanket on the sofa, visibly dirty bath mat and bits and hair on the bedding. One of the pillows had extensive rust coloured staining and another had what looked like staining from mould on the pillow case. There is no temperature control in the apartment and I found it unbearably hot, particularly at night. I couldn't have the balcony doors open as mosquitos came in almost immediately (in November!). Overall, I probably wouldn't stay here again.
Easy to find, spacious and clean with all the amenities as well as snacks. Very good experience and great communication

The location is great and the neighborhood as well. Hosts are really really nice but the price we paid was not worth the quality of our stay. The room was very dirty and the building was old. We selected this place because price was high and we thought it is indeed a studio apartment. But to our disappointment it is not.
The place was very nice it was very centrally located and easy to manage the public transport... I would definitely stay here again

Patrick's flat is very comfortable and well furnished. It has a wonderful terrace where you can relax while having breakfast or at sunset, the views of the mountains were beautiful. Well connected to the city centre and the Central train station with trams 2 and 3 stopping nearby. The communication with Patrick was great and his friend Agnes, who showed us the flat, was lovely. We had a fantastic time in Zurich and will not hesitate to come back to Patrick's flat when we return.

Very responsive and helpful host. Apartment is in a quiet residential neighbourhood but close to key tram lines which can get you to major destinations. Good size for a family of four with one bedroom and a pull out sofa in the living room. Strahinja was great about letting us leave our luggage in the store room after check out. Overall, a good apartment for our quick stay in Zurich

We enjoyed our stay. A short walk to the trams that are easy to use. There is a Coop supermarket 3 minutes away as well, about 10 minutes walk to the south west there are a variety of great restaurants. The place was relatively quiet, very clean, the bed was amongst the more comfortable we’ve bee ln on in Europe. Laundry with washer and dryer are available in the basement which was very handy.

Patrick is a great host and greeted us warmly at arrival. We had a homelike stay with all amenities available. The place is perfect for a couple. House was clean and well maintained. We loved the large balcony and open outdoor area.

Mario was very attentive and replied within seconds. I felt very welcome and he also made sure I had everything I needed. Zurich can get quite hot during the summer and I had a little fan, however it broke. Mario went immediately to buy a new one and bring it by. Theres a big balcony where you can sit and enjoy some fresh air. The location is fantastic and it has everything you need within walking distance! Definitely recommend.

Great apartment in a perfect location, 3 minutes walk from Oerlikon Station (1 stop from the airport and 1 stop from the city centre) and surrounding shops, bars and restaurants. Mar was a great host sending all the relevant information and the place was exceptionally clean. Had a great stay here and would thoroughly recommend.

The host was pro-active and helpful when we had an unexpected construction noise from upstairs one day and the host was very helpful responding us and fixed the problem，the downside is the place with too much decor, make the place messy look and the bathroom lighting was too dim , but quite agree with what the host saying on the wall board written “ Is not how big is the house, is how happy is the home” we are pleased and happy to stay here after all!
Great location. Upstairs felt a bit dusty. There is one queen bed. The other beds can are short and can only fit a child comfortably

An eclectic top floor apartment great for a Zurich visit and only a short walk from the main train station. It is an easy walk to all the activities the city has to offer. Our favorite family fun was jumping off the bridge and swimming in the river to cool down during the Zurich heat wave!

This apartment is extremely spacious. There were only three of us, but the apartment easily could accommodate five or six. The location is excellent. There is a grocery store nearby (about a 2-minute walk), and it's only about a 10-minute walk to the train station. I definitely recommend this apartment.

Good property. Centrally located. Short walk from the main train station. Layout is a bit disjointed but mattresses were good and it handled our party of four adults easily. Large master bedroom has sloped ceiling so you need to be careful. All in all a good place. I would rent again.

Very nice place in a great neighborhood. One stop away from the train station. Easy to find and plenty or room for a family of four. Just wished our original flight wasn’t cancelled and we could have stayed our scheduled two nights! Would definitely stay here again.

Overall this was a very good place to stay! It was very big and accommodated our group of 5 adults easily. The hosts were very easy to communicate with. The apartment had great amenities including free parking. The reasons that I did not give it 5 stars - the bedding in the master bedroom was ok not great, same with the towels. There were no coffee pods or anything left for us. I really would have liked recommendations for the local area of restaurants, favorite things etc. all of these were fairly minor but made the stay feel not quite 5 star. I would book this apartment again however!

Dorothea was very nice. and she responded quickly to our emails, and the apartment was already warm when we arrived, that was a nice gesture from her. The apartment was perfect for our trip, 10 minute walk to downtown. We also used the tram a lot and the polybahn all that was 2 minutes away from the apartment.
I think for the its price the place was okay and location is great. But the host does not even provide hand soap and washing machine capsules. Floor was quite dirty. Doors make cringy noise.

Sebastian’s place is cozy for two. He is responsive and very accommodating to our every requests. However, room is quite cold during winter as there is no heater except for a dehumidifier. The walk up a steep hill to the apartment is challenging with luggages but can be resolve using other pathways. What you see is what you get.
No steps at all, perfect location between airport and downtown on tram 10 which run constantly. However, a very steep hill from the tram. Super quiet and gorgeous neighborhood.
Had 3 nights in Zurich and we really enjoyed it. The apartment was very nice and was close to centrum. There is a quite steep hill you have to force if you come from train station/downtown

The location was very ideal - close to the tram, and also very near to Zurich airport, which made our last day at Switzerland very fuss-free. Simple place to stay in, with lots of appliances and kitchenware to benefit from. Would recommend!

We stayed here for a weekend in Zurich. The location is great and a walkable distance from the central train station. However, as noted in the listing it's a steep uphill walk, so it would not be recommended to walk if you have suitcases (if only backpacks then it's fine). The unit was very clean and comfortable for 2 travelers. Unfortunately the second day it rained non stop all day so we stayed inside, but thankfully the Wifi worked great and we were able to watch Netflix the entire time. I would definitely recommend staying here if you're planning to stop by in Zurich for a few days!
The apartment is in a good location and everything was very clean. The available space was used very well and the Host replied quickly to questions.
Cozy apartment with the tram running just next to the building. Staying there was very nice and convenient.

The flat was very nice and I had a comfortable time there. The bed was very good, big and cozy, and the bathroom too. The only thing I would say is that it would be better with air conditioning, especially because in summer if you open the windows you will find some flying insects inside. The communication with Rossana was so good, she is very nice and understanding. Overall it’s a very good staying, it has good transport too to get to the centre of the city.
The location was good and it was clean, but the air was hot and repressive and the tub didn’t drain. Just not quite as good as the other Airbnb properties we have stayed in
Amazing stay! Very large apartment close to local transit and close to the city center. Tania is very responsive and kind. Highly recommend!

We really enjoyed the stay even the weather wasn’t so good. The location was very convenient for visits and supermarkets! The environment was also very calm and quiet but there are plenty of public transportation around! The rooms are large and warm enough to feel at home. We will definitely stay again when we visit Zurich next time !!

Chris’s apartment was located right across the River in old town area. Great for a short stay! Only issue was the lift wasn’t working for the first day and had to go up to the 4th floor with my luggage 🥵 haha. Obviously, it was not his fault and it was fixed the next day, so not to worry about it for the next person to book here. The only other thing is that no air conditioner during this heat wave in June made it a bit uncomfortable while sleeping at night. The fan and open windows helped a bit, but from what I hear, it’s difficult to get a permit for A/C in Switzerland for apartments. I’d definitely stay here again due to proximity to main station as well as the lake/river.

Location 20/10 Cleaniness & accuracy 1/10. You literally can’t do better for location and view. Truly. It’s amazing. But that’s where it stops. The place was very dirty. Holes in bedding, food stuck on all dishes, bird poop on inside windows, stains on curtains and walls. I have pictures. I literally cleaned every kitchen item before using. The description is inaccurate. Nothing luxurious about it. Very small for two people, missing TV, only had one coffee cup so we shared, you do dishes in the bathroom which is unsanitary. There’s just a lot. The host said he upgraded me to this location but when comparing listings I noticed it was much smaller and cheaper then the one I originally booked. He become a little combative when I brought it up. Still waiting for my refund….
Kathrin is a fabulous host. The place is lovely and we were extremely happy. They are super helpful in fixing any issues that crop up

Highly recommend staying here!! It was very clean and peaceful, and the views were gorgeous. I found it to be very walkable to the center and there was public transportation right outside the building to get you to the center. I will definitely be coming back!

The place is beautiful and the view even better. The only thing that was too much for us was the malfunction of the cooktop. We couldn’t get it to work and couldn’t cook there, which was our intention from the get-go. The kitchen appliances could also be better. Key pickup is a bit hard to get especially with the hills. It’s a hike especially with heavy luggage. You need to climb a steep hill. Tips: take the Tram, much faster to climb.

Very well thought out and executed space. I had everything I needed and felt very comfortable during my stay while my husband was in hospital. Extending the stay for a night was no trouble for Rossana to organize. No stress for me. Thank you.

Everything was according to description. Giancarlo was responsive and exhaustive. unfortunately he doesn’t provide further comforts on request, besides the ones mentioned. Overall, the stay was comfortable and the space clean. The building is quiet.
Nice place close to the public transportation that made it very easy to get around. Space was comfortable and clean
This is a perfect place for business and pleasure. I loved the location, the amenities, the ambiance, the staff and the host. I can’t imagine staying anywhere else in Zurich.

Great apartment. Nice appointments. Great bathroom. Great location. Only downside is it is quite noisy front the street. The AC’s run through the windows so it will be quite noisy. Other than that the place is excellent. James communicates really well and was extremely accommodating to an early bag drop.
Beautiful apartment within walking distance of all Zurich has to offer. Right across from the main train station but the neighborhood was beautiful , clean and safe.

Hello, Had a bad experience with the radiators as they were not working for a day and the temperature outside was -2°C and infant were freezing inside the house, one of the bathroom shower was having cold water until the day i checked out, One of the clothes rack (Heated) was not working until i checked out, On the second 2day of my stay the lift/elevator stopped working which was sorted in about 3-5hrs time frame where in half of my day was wasted. By paying 650/Euro per night i was not rewarded any compensation. Additional heater provided after 24hrs. House is nicely done and right in the city center 1min walking to bahnhofstrasse. Thanks
the place is nice but the lights in the bathroom is too dim and not enough water pressure otherwise we had a nice stay there.

The James-Team is absolutely kind and caring. I was really looking forward to this great apartment. Unfortunately, I had a to cancel due to a serious family issue. Thanks to the James-Team, who took immediately care of this I got a complete refund. Awesome Service!

This apartment is in a nice location super close to multiple tram stations making it easy to get around the city! The host was super helpful and always responded quickly to our needs and questions. As listed there is no AC and it was very hot during our visit. Fans were provided and appreciated but the heat was very uncomfortable.

I had a great night, and the house is really big. It has 3 rooms. Everything is complete and has all the items as described. The cooking items are also complete. The only downside is that 2 rooms didn't have doors. However, the owner mentioned that the house will undergo renovations, and I believe it will be even better, eliminating this downside.

The apartment itself is outstanding - very modern, beautifully designed, and thoughtfully detailed. The space makes a strong impression, and I’m happy to give it the highest rating. The team was responsive and addressed any questions that arose, which I truly appreciated. At the same time, the only discomfort for me was related to technical issues that were already present upon arrival and had not been taken care of in advance. I would gladly return if all technical aspects were fully taken care of before arrival and did not require the guest’s involvement during the stay.

It was my best buy in AirBnB for my business trip so far. Josie is charming and kind, friendly and good at cooking as well, The room kept very clean and organized perfectly, The location is just next to Oerlikon station where many train lines stop. It This new redevelopment town from industrial area has everything such as nice restraint and decent glossary market but unfortunately there is no historical feeling of Zurich

Our family of 5 stayed for 3 nights at Daniel’s apartment. It was clean, large and the kitchen was excellent. Daniel always responded quickly to our communication. This apartment is not in the old town, but there are two trams that go past and the public transport is so easy and fast to get into town I would say it is a very good choice to stay. We would recommend this to friends.
Top place to visite the city and the communication with the owner is very good!

Overall value for money. Sonja was responsive, very helpful in assisting the check-in process. The place also offers washing machine and dryer, which is really a good perk. Unfortunately the house is a bit dusty.

Such a great place to stay on a budget! It was a beautiful area, the bedroom was clean and the bed was very comfortable, and it was nice and quiet at night— slept great! Would definitely stay here again when in Zurich!

Great place in a quiet neighborhood, but walking distance to Kinkelstrasse tram stop where you can catch several different trams (direct to Zurich Train Station and Airport). Flat is very modern with good wifi and seems to be recently updated with very nice fixtures. Entrance and exit is through a keypad code which you get to choose, which means you don't have to worry about carrying around a key. There is not a cooktop but there is a machine called a Thermomix, which I had never seen before. Its like a big metal cooking blender and it was easy to make pasta in. There is a microwave as well and the washer dryer does both the washing and drying in one go. Really nice place.

Was a really comfortable and private place to stay, not so far out from the main hub in Zürich. There was some noise from construction, but of course that’s out of the hosts control. Other than that this place was perfect!

this was a great place for a quick overnight to the airport. close to the train and having a private room was wonderful there are 3 other rooms for guests and the kitchen is small but I never had a problem. the only downside was there is no sink in the master room so you still need to go out to wash your hands after using the bathroom.

Very comfortable studio within 15 minutes by tram of the city center, close enough to access but far enough for peace and quiet. It’s very clean and spacious with a beautiful, minimalistic design sensibility. The bed is large and very comfortable and the views out the window of the surrounding neighborhood were pleasant to wake up to. A 5 minute walk from the apartment up the hillside is Zürichberg woods. Go get lost in them for a few hours at sunrise, and when you get back don’t deny yourself the breakfast that is offered - it’s superb. Thank you, Duri and Luzia, see you next time.

Everything was well-organised, clean and comfortable. We had a good stay at Duri's. The only reason why I haven't given more 5-star rankings was beacuse we thought a personal touch would have been nice. We really would have appreciated a welcome note upon arrival or an extra towel for our baby girl for example. Other than that, we enjoyed our stay!

had a really great and comfortable stay. it was nice to have a private bathroom but the shared bathroom was fine too! it was convenient to be able to do laundry there. there is also a shared kitchen but the bedroom has a mini fridge as well 😃

Beautiful house with a very scenic backdrop, nestled in a friendly and peaceful neighbourhood. Easily accessible from Zurich airport via public transport. Also, well connected within the main city centre, approx 10 -15 mins by tram to central. Has most of the amenities, host is very responsive and helpful. Ideal place for a short/ long stay.

I apologize for my mistake I caused due to my misunderstanding about the time, but they handled it kindly. I am truly grateful for this stay. It was a comfortable and the people were nice. I highly recommend this place.

It's a beautiful space, very stylish and well thought out. It has every little thing you could need, has a great location near public transport (direct tram line to the airport), wonderful view, comfortable bed, and super friendly hosts. I really look forward to coming back.

A very nice apartment. The room and the bathroom are very comfortable. The neighborhood is very quiet and not far from the Alte Stadt to walk. The shops aren’t so far, as so for the public transport. We recommend you

We really enjoyed the stay. Simon was friendly and helpful, and the rooms well appointed and spacious. The location was very convenient for us, especially being close to some wonderful swimming spots and to public transport.

We had a great stay with Trudi. The Airbnb is in a beautiful historical building and the gardens are spectacular. Trudi is the perfect host! She is welcoming and kind. We looked forward to breakfast with her each morning. Check-in and communication was really smooth. The location in Zurich's old town is on a charming, quiet street and you are still close to the main sights and the lake. It's a great 'home base' while visiting Zurich. We will be staying here again and are already looking forward to it! Highly recommend!
Thank you for allowing us to book so last minute! Our family of 7 was displaced after a missed flight and we needed a place in Zurich just for the night. It was great!

Trudi was nothing less than a superb hostess. We felt so welcomed by both she and the house, really feeling like we found our home-away-from-home. Trudi provided us with delicious breakfasts, wonderful conversation, and fantastic advice on wandering throughout Zurich. The house itself is magnificent, and the location is perfect. We hope to return again one day! Thank you for everything, Trudi. Take care :)

Anouar is very warm-hearted. We had dinner together, talked about jobs, culture, and he even helped me find an apartment for longer rent. The place is cool, with all necessary stuff for a short stay. Staying there is definitely recommended.

Our staying was great, I have never experienced such a warm welcoming such as we did. Ceco, his mom and his family were outstanding, gave us many tips about the places around and what to do in Zurich. It was such a pleasure to stay there and I highly recommend the place 100% no doubts.
We really enjoy the time that we stay in this house. It's really nice and has the good location.

This is an amazing place to stay in Zurich. The rooms are spacious, well kept, and will meet the needs of large or small groups. It is just outside the city center, but the tram stop is only a few meters away, and you are at the train station and city center in 15 minutes. I especially liked the view from the rooms, and that the neighborhood is quiet and very safe. And the obvious added bonus of a great breakfast.

The host, Judy, is fun and kept us informed of anything needed for check-in and check out timely and the villa is decorated with very good taste as if it came straight from Instagram. The garden and lake view are contributing to the charm of this villa. We had conduicive teambuilding discussions in the dining area, with enough space at a large oval artistic table :)
Judy was warm, friendly, and helpful. we loved staying at her place. it was in a great location in Zurich, not far from sightseeing. The 2nd floor shower was great for my 6'7 husband!

Absolutely loved our stay at this beautiful historial home! The house is huge, and we felt like we were the only ones there. The location was perfect, away from the busy town, with walking distance to restaurants and grocery stores. Public transportation was very accessable, effecient and easy to navigate. Judy was a very welcoming host! She met us at check-in and took the time to get to know us over a cup of coffee. She gave us lots of recommendations for restaurants and activites. At check out, she met us early in the morning to say goodbye and bring us croissants. We definitely recommend staying here!
Place met the description and the photos, near the tram and bus station. Good option to stay while in Zurich.

Good location of the apartment (very near well-connected bus and tram stops), the building has a lift if needed, for families with strollers or anyone with a lot of luggage. The apartment itself was spacious, had many amenities (i.e office desk, iron, kitchen products, clothes hangers, even a first-aid kit) of great quality, and an overall peaceful atmosphere to the building and surrounding area. Strahinja, the host, made us feel welcome as a family, and was proactive with accommodating our infant's needs which was a big help! The only suggestion I have is regarding the wi-fi connectivity of the apartment, but otherwise our stay in Zürich was peaceful and pleasant. Thank you!

The terraces are amazing! It’s such a pleasure to spend the morning out on the terrace before heading off for the day. The location is super convenient, just two minutes to the tram and a 15-minute walk to Lake Zurich at a relaxed pace. The only downside was that the apartment wasn’t very clean… but that’s something easily fixed with a bit of tidying up :) Overall, I definitely recommend it to everyone!
Great, central location close to the train station, with modern and spacious rooms. Very friendly and helpful staff.
The hotel location is near to public transport and close to the shops. The room was clean. You can find everything you need to feel very well in this hotel.
it was a great location! close to the train station. place was very clean and as described. our nespresso machine in the room was broken but they provide free coffee at the lobby!

My children and I were very comfortable in the apartment and we loved it. The apartment was couple of minutes away from public transportation which was great and there was a small shopping mall couple of minutes away also. The only only minus I would say was the continues church bell ringing and disturbing our sleeps☹️ The apartment is very close to the church so you can here it very well. The church bell would ring every hour from 7:00- 22:00.

My stay at Chris place was simply perfect! Perfect space, location, communication,amenities. This is the place to be when in Zurich, 2 blocks from the lake, 10 minutes walk from Bellevue, supermarkets, restaurants, pharmacy in less than 1 minute and trams number 2 and 4 at your doorstep. Do you think this is all? No! The best is that although super central, the isolation is so good that you don’t hear anything, so your good night of sleep is guaranteed. I can’t recommend this place enough and would for sure stay here again! Thanks Chris!!!

Great comfortable quiet spotless studio in Seefeldstrasse. Unit has amazing new soundproof windows and apartment is right by tram stop and great markets. Close to the beautiful lake and wonderful green uphill hiking. Navigation to all Zürich destinations is easy and efficient. Enjoyed coffee on my tiny terrace.

A great apartment in a great location! The apartment is minimalist but has what you need. Location is excellent right across from two grocery stores and the tram. Only downside is the new, very loud restaurant on the ground floor of the building. Otherwise great!

Cher was a wonderful host, always reachable and giving us useful tips. The apartment was super clean. From fast wifi to bathroom amenities, it has everything you need. We can highly recommend this place and would always come back!!
Very convenient to get to and from. Only a few bus stops from the main part of Zürich!

This was a perfect stay for our trip to Zurich! It was right near the local tram, and a doable walk to the main station. They also left thoughtful snacks and had great communication! Would recommend :)

Location was great. Walking distance to nearest team was less than 5 min. The communication was excellent. We'r did share 1 shower for 7 people, but never ran out of hot water. Washer and dryer was a plus. It was perfect for our big group. However not really a place to all hang out as one of the bedrooms is also the TV room with the couch. Very comfortable.

The flat is okay, clean, neat and tidy, and Strahinja is very helpful, nice and proactive. One thing needs to be said though and it is that the flat is small. Technically, you can have six people sleeping there as there are six beds in three bedrooms but there's only one bathroom with only one toilet in the whole flat, and the kitchen, though nice, is small. it's really convenient for four people, and five people or six is a stretch and appropriate only for short periods. But other than that it's great

I loved staying at this place. Clear instruction upon arrival for check in. (little confusion as we were instructed with old picture but not a big issue) Only few mins (maximum 20mins) from everywhere in Zurich. Very clean fully furnished house including Kitchenettes. I am not very sensitive on noises but for sensitive people, tram sound from the railway just infront of the house, barking dog from upstairs, and noise Caribbean restaurant next door. However, to be perfectly clear, it should not be an issue for most of visitors and it was not irritating at all while all doors are closed. Loved this place.

Jose was a fantastic host. Very accomodating for an early check-in (without me even asking) since my flight arrived early. Also was very helpful in providing my suggestions to make my time at Zurich a lot easier. The place was spacious, clean, and the location was a nice quiet location but still close to everything!

Great centrally located apartment with 20 min walk to old town or a 7 min tram ride. Has everything that you need for a quick stay. The only thing are the train tracks are right across the street so you can hear it between 5am and midnight. However, if you walk enough during the day there shouldn’t be a problem as you’ll be asleep. Also, there is no tv, which is good but could be a problem for some.
My husband and I only used the space for a short period of time but it was very clean and spacious. It’s very close to the tram and train station.
The stay was wonderful. Very neat and cozy. There’s a house menu provided with every single detail a tourist would need and I’m surprised. Would definitely stay in here again the next time we visit!
Well furnished apartment within walking distance from the station. Clean and cozy too! Highly recommend

The place is clean and very accessible. There is a Home Manual with instructions, listing of trains, and stuff to do. The home is as described and the place is perfect for a day or a week stay. You get what you pay for. Simple and Clean is a hard thing to accomplish but I believe Billy and Cher accomplished it. Amazing Stay.

This place had everything you need and the perfect location! The bus and train are so close which makes exploring the country a lot easier. We didn't have a car and we were able to access everything we wanted. There's plenty of grocery stores and restaurants around (3 minute walk!) and the area is pretty quiet at night. I would stay again and recommend this place to everyone :)

The house is very clean, and is very close to a lot of tram stations (Englishviestrasse, Klusplatz, Romerhof, Kreuzplatz- the one we use when we go to Zurich HB). 2mins walk to the English-speaking Catholic church. Restaurants and grocery stores close to Kreuzplatz. Jens also provided coffee, tea, toilet essentials. The sofa bed in the living room is very large and very comfy. Probably can sleep 3 people. However the airconditioner that is mentioned is NOT for the whole house. It is only a portable one for the living room. The other rooms are cooled by electric fans. Not a big deal when it is not that hot as you can also open the windows. Just a note also that you have to climb up some steps to get to the ground floor apartment. In all, this is a good place for staying in Zurich.

This is a very nice and clean apartment with a beautiful veranda and access to a small courtyard. The house itself is located near the old town - 5-7 minutes by tram (the stop is right next to the house) or 15-20 minutes on foot. Jens is very welcoming, he quickly answers all questions.

I had stayed at Rachelle’s place earlier and I remembered it as a cosy apartment for a single person. So, I stayed here again for a month this time and it was quite comfortable. Transportation and shops are nearby and the building is quiet. The apartment is quite well stocked with essentials, so even though I was there for a month, I didn’t find anything lacking and used the washing machine/dryer in the basement too. Rachelle was friendly, helpful and responsive. Would love to stay here again.

This apartment was well furnished, exactly as described with a nice, comfortable bed, cozy kitchen, and clean bathroom. The host was excellent at communicating prior to check in, and when there was a slight hiccup (we weren't provided with a code to get into the room itself) they were extremely responsive and we had it within a moment or two, so no concerns there at all. Would definitely stay here again if we were ever to return to the area.

The apartment is at perfect location,very easy to get around with public transportation and walking distance to awesome bars and restaurants. The pace is great, very clean and has everything you need .Totally recommend it.

Strahinja was an amazing host, offering us extra items for our little ones to make our stay more enjoyable. The washer and dryer are clearly marked with clear instructions on how to use them. I also appreciated extra toiletries that were provided!
Everything was perfect from the location, house and hosting! Recommended to stay here!

We enjoyed our stay at this place. Pros: - very clean - lot's of thoughtful touches: free water, soft drinks, coffee, bath accessories, books for kids, flip flops, etc. Cons: - Location is quite distant from the city centre for daily walking (tram station is nearby though) - The place is a bit old and ran down

We had an amazing stay at this place! It's very close to a tram stop so it's easy to get around Zurich from there. The kitchen and bathroom are very well stocked with everything you could possibly need during your stay! We didn't get the chance to meet the hosts but they gave us very detailed instructions to check in and we could even store our luggages after we checked out. Couldn't ask for a better Airbnb!

The greatest thing of this place was a cosy space and complimentary things that the host gave such as beverages, beers, bath supplies, and some snacks. You can get the host to reply kindly and rapidly to your any questions.

The location easy to get to via tram. Just a bit walk once you get off. The only thing, if I were to nitpick, would be I wish the place had a fan. The open window bring cool air in but a fan would help circulate it better. The check in was easy. The hose sent detailed directions with pictures for location and process to get the key. She was responsive and the place was very clean.

we only stayed for a night but the apartment was lovely and comfortable. location was great at not far from the main train station. they also provided biscuits and chocolates free of charge. overall, it was an absolute delight staying at strahinja’s apartment.
We really enjoyed this place and our time in Zurich. It was easy to find and the host was kind and responsive. We had plenty of space for our family and it was very centrally located in the city.

Great location and window view, you can easily walk everywhere and the main train station is just a 5 minute walk away. Clean, well-stocked apartment with kitchen utensils to cook a meal. Easy check in. The wifi worked well. Great hosts, very helpful. Would recommend.

The location and view from this unit is unbeatable. The host was quick to respond and very accommodating. However, we came over a warm weekend and found the place to be unbearably warm, we stayed out of the unit until late enough to go straight to bed. The shower has been mentioned already but it is quite small and gets water everywhere each time someone uses it so fair warning!

This stay was in a great location with lots of restaurants and cafes in walking distance. The view of the river was great and it was also an easy walk to the lake. There is no AC in the unit so it could get a little warm but the fans helped to cool it down.

Excellent location, we even had a great view of the river. The apartment was also cute and fairly spacious except for the bedroom but the small bedroom was fine with us. Very easy to get to from the train station or a quick uber to the airport.

The host was very accommodating and responsive. The place was clean and well kept, with plenty of appropriate cookware. The area, Altstetten is beautiful and close enough to walk to the Limmat River, old town Zurich, and Uetliberg. Public transportation is also a few steps away and very convenient however, we preferred to walk most places.

Great place close to the main station. Lots of great local bars and restaurants to help get a local feel. Grocery store just s couple blocks away. A little bit of a hike up the stairs but there was a fan which helped tremendously during the heat wave.
The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. It located about 15 minutes away from the central, but the tram station is in front of the door.

There were not basic amenities present - not even a bar of soap to wash our hands. I stayed there with a friend and we specifically booked because it was advertised and pictured as having a pull-out couch, but upon arrival that “couch” was only a chair. The drapes were falling off the windows. There was a noticeable odor in the kitchen. No extra towels were provided. There was no air conditioning and the weather was extremely hot, however a fan was provided. Overall the experience was fairly average, and I wouldn’t recommend staying here. The two good things were that Dimi was very responsive and it was a good location.

The apartment is nicely located, close to transit. Within walking distance to some good restaurants and several grocery options. The apartment was very clean and warm in the cooler November weather. Thank you

Really nice and adventurous place to stay, for a very good price. Jakub is really nice and communicates well. The place has everything you might need - except shower which can be arranged from my understanding. You can also make yourself a tea and coffee. We went in March and it was a bit cold weather but the van has heater and it wasn’t that cold. Extra blankets were also provided. Great experience for a van!
Jakub was such a pleasure to be hosted by. He is a very clear and honest guy dedicated to providing a good experience. Truly the cheapest bed in Zurich and worth the price!
nice appartment in the middle of Seefeld. Didn't meet Christiana & Chris but they message promptly and friendly. recommended.

"I arrived in the afternoon and went out to look around. However, when I returned to the room at night, it was too hot. I looked for the A/C but couldn't find it. When I contacted Mr. Maher about the air conditioning, he told me there isn't any. I had to sleep in a hot room first night with the window open, which meant dealing with all the noise coming from outside. The next day, he brought me a fan. The second issue is the outside window, which doesn't have a curtain. Imagine having sunlight flood your room at 6:00 AM when you planned to sleep until 9:00 AM."

Franz was extremely kind and communicated very well and responded quickly. It was a pleasure having him host me and my girlfriend during our time in Switzerland. Franz gave great recommendations for activities and hikes in Switzerland and I highly recommend his beautiful home if you’re staying in Zurich it’s only a 5-7 minute walk to several of the Tram stations it made it very easy for us to plan quick trips with everything close by there are also several supermarkets close within 7-10 min walks if you need anything it’s very well located and I’m very glad that we chose to have Franz host us.
The place really good and clean, missing on the complete address to be easier to arrive at the door but the rest fine.

Not a bad location as it’s walking distance to many places and quiet at night. However, you really only get a small room with a bed and a small shared bathroom. And the heat was stifling! There is a fan that somewhat helps but I’d frequently wake up in a sweat. There was also a peculiar smell in the apartment that requires me to wash my clothing in another stay (the drying unit here didn’t seem to be working for others). Not a bad spot, but I’d probably do a hostel next time around.

The apparment is fine, the zone is quiet and safe. It is necessary to take a train or a bus to arrive to the appartment from the city center (walking would take some time). The room is private, but the bathroom and the rest is shared. It was fine for us, but it can be relevant for other guests.

hosts were very responsive and helpful, and they kept a lovely apartment that was clean, comfy, and just what we needed. about a 40 minute walk to lake zurich, but very close to supermarkets and a few restaurants and bars. the kitchen here was phenomenal we felt comfortable and safe here. thanks hosts:)
The room was up to my expectation, though a bit far from public transport. The host was helpful and very responsive, I feel comfortable communicating with them. Overall, it was great
Súper friendly, informative and responsive host. Location is 5 mins walk from the waterfront, fabulous sunset. Cafe, restaurants all you need is in the surrounding. Enjoyable stay.
The host is nice and friendly, but the room is too expensive for its size. The location is great tho if you just want a place to sleep.

We had a marvellous stay. Chris was extremely helpful in giving local tips and the place was wonderful. Clean and well located. The central town Altstadt is about 15-20 minutes walk but the location has all facilities available. A supermarket, cafe, and tram stop just in front of the building.
The place is located in a lovely part of town, close to the lake. Great for morning swims (if you're into it). The apartment is easy to reach by public transport, clean, organized and quite spacy.

Fine apartment in the tram line. Very near are grocery stores, restaurants and bakeries. The bathroom has a great shower and the main bed in comfortable. Keep in mind it is on a busy road and therefore very loud. The kitchen has a few things for preparing basic meals.

Great location and fair price. But the place was not thoroughly cleaned (there was confetti and popped balloons on the floor from the Zürich Street Parade the previous weekend) and the host had the checkin time wrong even though we discussed it prior; we showed up and he asked us to come back in one hour.

We stayed here 4 nights and 5 days and what a great place for our family in Zurich. Location is nice and upscale, away from the Zurich city hustle bustle. The lake was just a couple of blocks away. The supermarket was across the street and many restaurants on the street itself. Loved the laundry service. We were able to utilize the kitchen for breakfasts and eat dinner at the table. Great stay and location. Ideal for a family. We used the Sofa come couch for the kids which was comfortable.
Convient location to the train station, bedroom was a bit small, but overall, we enjoyed our stay and the quiet atmosphere of the hotel.

Great hotel, staff, and location! I really enjoyed my stay—the staff were friendly and helpful, and the location was perfect for exploring the area. The only downside was that the room was a bit too warm, and opening the windows let in quite a bit of noise from outside. Otherwise, everything was excellent!
Dimi was a wonderful host - responsive and helpful from the moment we booked. The apartment is in a great location, had everything we needed, and was very clean. Highly recommend.
A great place to stay over a weekend to see the city! Very central and near everything

As comfortable as it is for a 3-star hotel stay. Room and bathroom were clean and comfortable for use. Located near the train station (5-10min walk) and close to restaurants and the river. Honestly a little too pricey, 3-5min walk further in the area are accommodations half the price.

PERFECT location, walking distance to everything we needed for our 2 night stay. The communication from the staff was so quick and friendly and they let us check in early so we didn’t have to lug luggage around. The room felt so clean and was just what we needed. And lastly, the chocolate fondue fountain in the lobby was the best additional touch!! Would definitely recommend or stay here again.
Excellent hotel! Including the chocolate fountain! Staff is kind and helpful. Rooms are comfortable and well appointed. Walking distance to everything one would need.
Great spot in Zurich located close to the old town and many bars. One team member was extremely helpful.

We appreciate the quick check in and food items offered at check out. Unfortunately the bathroom in the listing images is not the same bathroom we received. The shower is much larger in the listing image. The was pink mildew in a few areas in the shower. Our stay was very brief, less than 24 hours, so we didn’t get to experience all your hotel had to offer. Staff was great!

The hotel is in a great location in Zurich for exploring downtown, restaurants, and shopping. The hotel is above a couple of restaurant/bars that close later and most people stand outside until 1-2am. We did not have A/C because it had been turned off for the winter months, so we opened a window in the bathroom. Unfortunately, smoke from the restaurant/bar did fill the room so it was a little bit of an uncomfortable night. Overall, If you are looking for an affordable stay that is in a convenient location, this is a good option. If you looking for relaxation/comfort, you may want to look for other options or find a room that is on the non-bar side of hotel.
This hotel was very clean and in a good area it seemed. The staff was helpful with a lot of recommendations. The rooms are small but was fine for our stay. I would stay again

Very cool building and very cute rooms! My boyfriend and I stayed for 2 nights and did a lot of sight-seeing around Zurich so the hotel was more so a place to keep our things, shower, and sleep! The chocolate fountain in the lobby was a very pleasant add - we definitely took advantage of that each time we entered / exited! It was well worth the money and a perfect central location to get around everywhere! Staff was very nice, welcoming, and helpful. The only downfall was that there was no parking aside from street parking, but we were able to drop our rental car off early and train + walk back to the hotel no problem. Would stay here again when in Zurich.

This Airbnb was in a perfect location to the train station (5 min walk), Old Town as well as Bahnhofstrasse (the popular shopping street). We were able to check in early and the staff is very courteous. The rooms are in the small side but that is common throughout most of Europe so we knew that going in! We would definitely recommend and stay there again if in Zurich.

We had an overnight stay in Zurich, and this was the best place to stay for our convince. It’s very near by to main train station, tram stops, main shopping street and also 15 mins travel for Zurich lake cruise and 20 mins for Lindt chocolate factory. Close by there are great options to grab breakfast. We discovered a great burger place just minutes away from the hotel, The Holy Cow, a great recommendation for vegetarians. They also let us keep our luggage in the hotel after checkout. The minus - the rooms are very small. If you’re travelling with light luggage there’s nothing to worry about.
An excellent little touch-down point, ideally located in central Zurich for the old town and Hauptbahnhof. and with friendly, welcoming staff. Highly recommend.

Love the style and the breakfast was good but at an additional cost. If you have to stay in the city and you're in a pinch, this place works. If you can stay outside of the city a bit you can save some money, have breakfast included, and get a more authentic experience.

Checking in and out was super easy. I loved the location because it's both quiet and very central. I also loved how restaraunts, markets, and the train stop are a very short distance away. The price is what you'd expect for Zurich. The only thing I'd request is weekly cleaning if booking for more than a week.

For a two-night stay the hotel was conveniently located, a 20-minute walk from the train station and very close to the excellent Kunst museum, easy to spend six hours there. Lovely Morocco-themed cafe and bar. The hotel room was spotless and warm.

Very kind and responsive reception. Flexible check in process and clear instructions. The room and bathroom were very clean. My only slight disappointment is that the room felt a lot smaller than expected, but the staff were incredibly friendly. Parking is paid unless you find a free parking on the road. Breakfast is not included, but available for purchase. Overall, a great fit for what we needed, which was lodging close to Zurich airport.

3rd time staying in Christian's apartment (or maybe the 4th?:), great location with easy access to lake, public transportation, restaurants. Very clean apartment, comfortable bed, and well equipped kitchen. (If the windows are open, you'll hear the tram and some restaurant noise, but the windows are well insulated and when closed, you easily get a good night's sleep). Chris and Christiana are great communicators, and attentive to needs. Absolutely recommend staying there.

This was a lovely hotel in the heart of Zurich, and so walkable to transit, restaurants and shopping. The hosts at the hotel were incredibly helpful during check-in. The room was clean and really comfortable.

Such a beautiful stay at the Villa! Judy is one of the most proactive hosts I’ve come across, exceptionally friendly and helpful. She provided awesome recommendations and even took the time to meet with me personally for a little catch up which I really appreciated. Everything was spotlessly clean, from the room to the bathroom and common areas. The home is stunning, decorated with thought and has real character, including the slightly squeaky floors that come with a historic home! Eating breakfast in the garden was the highlight of my stay - so incredibly peaceful! Location is fantastic, very easy to get around and the room itself was comfortable and bright. Would definitely recommend a stay here!

This AirBnB is superb. The hosts are very social, friendly, and interesting people. The room is private, large, has a fantastic balcony and nice and functional furniture. The location of the apartment is very central. Although it is in a busy street, the room is surprisingly quiet. For us, it could not have been better!

My stay at Andreas's was just perfect. The apartment is ideally located, very well equipped and particularly clean. Andreas was very friendly, he was always responsive in our communications and attentive to my possible needs. I highly recommend!
It is a cozy apartment, clean and comfortable. Its location is very good, close to the Opera (Opernhous) and easily accessible by tram.

Very very nice apartment! Everything was as described. Great value for the money! Everything was perfect and clean - and Ramona was very sweet and helpful the hole time. Highly recommended! The only thing you should know, is that the apartment is located close to the train station which is a bit noisy when sleeping with open window - otherwise the location is perfect, as it is close to the city:-)
Fabulous accommodation close to the main station. Spotlessly clean and comfortable. Extremely helpful and welcoming hosts
Lea was so nice and the apartament very comfy

Lea was an excellent host, with superb communication throughout my stay. The apartment's location was perfect, offering easy access to trams, restaurants, and supermarkets. The cleanliness and safety of the place were top-notch. I would definitely choose to stay here again in the future.
A great stay at great location. Close to both train station and Zürich attractions. The room was comfortable, clean and tidy - perfect for a few nights in the city.

The building is nothing to look at from the outside, but the 4th floor apartment is more spacious that I thought it would be from the photos. The bed was very comfortable, the kitchenette had everything we needed. Bruno even left some coffee for us which was much appreciated. The storage was great and the location is fabulous. Half a block to the river and right in the middle of old town Niederdorf. We would stay here again in an instant and would not hesitate to recommend Bruno's place and Bruno, who was very accommodating and helpful and easy to communicate with. I think staying here helped us love Zurich even more than we would have.

The apartment was great! Super clean and had everything we needed for a four day trip. Location is perfect and in the middle of great bars/restaurants. Unfortunately, it’s a little loud at night because of the bars, but it was what we expected, so it didn’t bother us. Parking is about a 5 minute walk up the hill in a Blue Zone and we never had issues for the entire weekend. Tobias is a great host and I’d definitely stay here again!

Right on Neiderdorfstrasse, so late night excitement should be expected; only slight disappointment was that we had to wait ~45mins to check-in; however that was completely balanced due to Toby receiving a package for me prior to my arrival and it was waiting for me in the flat...I would definitely stay again!!

Definitely would consider rebooking Toby’s place. It’s super central and ideal for a short or long term stay in Zurich, and the price is good as well. I had a nice time and enjoyed it very much. Toby is also an excellent communicator, he made the process very smooth. I would however ask that the process for doing laundry be a little bit clearer for your tenants moving forward. But overall great!

Tobias is a super host and has great communications. He was flexible on the check in and even had a friend bring the keys. It is just as listed. A very nice place. The only downside is it is in a busy area and on the weekends is quite noisy. With the warm weather, we had to keep the windows open and deal with the noise.
We enjoyed the central location and felt like we were at the heartbeat of it all. The Christmas Markets were in walking distance. We would definitely stay here again. Thank you, Tobias.

Tobias’s studio was great for a short trip and time spent in Zurich. As mentioned by some of the other reviews, it’s loud. We were also there during a heat wave and it was a bit hard to work out of the studio. Unfortunately we were unable to do laundry even communicating it ahead of time due to lack of accessibility with an access card (that the hosts did not have available). We booked this Airbnb specifically because it had laundry accessible in the building. That being said it was small but had basics enough for a short stay! Would recommend otherwise if you just require minimum items and for the location.

Tobias’ place was in perfect location and his checkin instructions were super easy to follow and the whole process was incredible easy. We stayed in a very hot day so it was a little warm in the apartment with no AC but there were multiple fans available to help cool off, which helped. It would be difficult to have stayed in the apartment during the day with the heat (so not a great place to do work or school if you wanted to do that in the summer) but it cooled off a ton at night with windows open and fans on so very nice to sleep in. I’d recommend this place as a perfect launch pad to explore Zürich! Tobias was wonderful and so helpful.

The place is okay. It’s very tiny but you won’t spend much time in. The shower is awful. I’m not a tall person for european standard (I’m 1.72m) and the shower was way below the top of my head. Tobi was cool at the beginning. Then he mixed up our checkout date and sent a person (Pedro) to enter the apartment. Both of them were super rude. He came later personally to apologize but the situation was awful. He basically said: get your things and leave, it’s already one hour after your checkout (it was the next day).
Loved this place! Great location and a lot to do nearby! Place was very comfortable and loved the bed. Toby was very responsive and flexible after our flight was delayed.

Josefine responds quickly and check-in and check-out are quite relaxed and straightforward. It's a small room, but there's more space to use. From Josefine's place you arrive at a nature reserve within 15min of walking and are in the city centre in about 20min by public transport.

Fantastic apartment in Zurich. Perfect in every way and would have loved to stay longer. Convenient to all amenities, brilliant hosts who provided excellent communication throughout. Highly recommended as one of the best apartments in Zurich.

Valeria had a lot of recommendations for us, I landed with no plan and she helped chart our daily activities around Zurich. Juerg was super fun to talk to and the house is a beauty. Awesome views from the bedrooms and very clean. Bathroom is spacious and well appointed. Loved the stay, especially the walk down to Elephant River. On down days, we walked over into the dense forest area which was fun
We found everything we needed in Karina's apartment: the location is great, close to train station and right in the city center. Karina showed us the place and answered all of our questions.

Tania and others were quickly responsive to our needs and showed great care for our well being and comfort. The apt was very clean, lots of storage space. Kitchen functional for easy dinners. The location is not far from train station however it is straight down many stair and then back up again although there is a bus stop very close by. Grocery store several blocks away but is closed on Sunday so plan accordingly.

This is one of the best airbnb apartments we've stayed in. Really stylish, very clean, and in a super location. It does get a little hot in the summer because it has lots of very big windows (you can't see this in the pictures very well) which catch the morning and early afternoon sun. But there are sunscreens that you can roll down. And in the afternoon the sun is gone and you can open up the windows and doors. Also, the big windows do make the flat very nice and bright. :) There is also a wonderful little outdoor area where you can sit and have a drink or eat. Despite the fact that it's in a very busy area, the flat is very quiet. The neighbourhood is also very cool - take tram 2 or 3 to tramstop 'lochergut' and walk to ida platz for a drink or a bit to eat, very nice!

Nice place, comfortable and very well equipped! Great for longer term stays! Well connected to public transport and easy to get to by walking as well! It feels like they really put attention to details. I visited it in summer and it was a little too hot on the inside, but they did provide a ventilator and in Switzerland AC is hard to find out of hotels! All in all a great stay and would definitively come back!
Really enjoyed our stay. Apartment was clean and spacious. Had a few issues with the wifi, but Harm responded immediately and we were able to fix it with no issues.
such a great spot that is very close to everything and all the transportation. Harm is an excellent host. thank you for allowing us to stay!

Great place, clean and convenient. Will be better once the construction next door finishes (as it starts at 7am!) but clear instructions and cool studio flat. Super convenient if you have kids with everything you would need for them. Did not try the sauna unfortunately!

Maria's flat is amazing! It is very close to the center and (that is my personal oppinion) very stylish! Our room was spacious, clean, full of light and we even had a separate door to the balcony. Unfortunately, we did not meet Maria but she was very nice in the messages. Her boyfriend was very helpful, kind, made us feel like at home. If we go to Zürich again, I would gladly return to them! :)

This is my new go-to place whenever I come to Zurich. The place is secure, is a very short walk to public transport, and central to a lot of places. Kitchenette is well stocked and there is plenty of closet/shelving space. Dayana was quick to respond to my questions at check-in, and the flat is definitely a safe place for single traveling women. (PS For long-haired folks, the water pressure is also amazing)

Thanks to Maria and Beny for the space and privacy provided to us! Their local recommendations were well received, and Cinnamon and Pepsi ensured that we were never bored when resting back in our rooms. Will miss this place!
Great place to stay in Zurich It’s close to multiple tram lines that are a short ride into the city center. The space is clean and located in a beautiful neighborhood.
A super cosy studio we stayed at with our 18-month-old daughter. We had a lovely time and really liked the location. The place was clean and as described in the listing. Definitely a recommendation!

Good location, spacious apartment and sweet cats. But the room needs some attention; beds are super squeeky, matrasses are old and too soft. One big window does not have blinds so the room does not get dark. Hosts talked to us during check-in, but completely ghosted us after that. We did not felt at home.

It was exactly what I needed. Quiet, nice residential neighborhood except for the church bells which I thought were nice. Great place to hole up and work if that's what you need like I did. Good access to public transportation. The Dodelbahn which is the closest tram stop closes around 11:30 PM and runs less frequently in the evening so you have to pay attention. The Romerhof stop is a short walk but it's uphill in heading to the apartment. The apartment is in a beautiful old house. The kitchen facilities are minimal. Don't expect to cook a full meal. The bathroom is pretty large by Euro standards. Bed was comfortable with nice comforters in the European style. I would stay again.

Maria’s home is absolutely beautiful - just as it looks in the photos. It was great to have a base and even though we didn’t really use the kitchen, was nice to be able to access and use thr fridge, relax in the living room etc. Even though we only briefly saw Maria, she made us feel very welcome & relaxed. The only critique we had was the noise from the road. It was so hot in Zurich when we visited so needed to sleep with the windows open and it was very loud all night. Also not having a curtain or shutter on one of the windows was difficult for me as someone sensitive to light when I sleep (even though I had an eye mask).
Great location, very walkable to the train stations and the main downtown area. The space itself is very large, however the room does get quite warm even on cooler days. We would definitely return!

Dayana is a good host who's communication was excellent and who provided great area information. The home is in a lovely neighborhood with reasonably priced street parking and easy access to buses/trams. The unit fit my family of 4 well and had a nicely stocked kitchen. The noise of the bells from the large church a block away was the only problem. The bells ring hourly (and some daytime hours every 15 mins.) from 3 am to 11 pm. Some hours are just a few rings and sometime 150+ rings (like 7 am & 11 pm weekdays). We learned some Swiss churches do this all-day bell schedule and many people adjust to it. Unfortunately, we have some lighter sleepers in my family and, even with ear plugs, the bells woke us up.

Great place! Very tidy and many nice touches. Clean,modern, comfortable Great washer and dryer, espresso machine and use of perfectly equipped kitchen. The only Air Bnb I’ve been to that actually has sharp knives. But the icing on the cake was her two cats Pepsi and Cinnamon, adorable and so friendly. Highly recommend

It is a really rustic and unique place. We stayed at the bottom 2 bedroom apartment that is past the stairs. There is one bathroom with 2 showers that you have to use stairs to get to. Rooms are pretty spacious but the kitchen is a little tight. The backyard is private.

Cher’s place is an incredible oasis in Zurich. She has thought of everything to make her air bnb feel like home. The outdoor patio is fantastic and the location of the apartment is outstanding. Literally everything you need is right at your fingertips. Cher was super responsive to any questions we had and is very organized and wonderful in her communication. Our family of four would definitely stay here again.

Cher's apartment was perfect for our family! Everything was easy, the location is just the best you can immagine, railways are close and buses as well, everything is walk distance and the neighbourhood is very nice. The kitchen is well equipped and supermarket is so close. Cher is always very prompt to answer any question you may have and is very well organized!!
Unfortunately I never got the chance to stay at Claudios place as I got sick, but the communication with Claudio was super and I'll stay at his place the next time I'm in Zürich.

A great Airbnb find! A part of the house right under Uetliberg— amazing location and great value. The house has everything you need, a well-stocked kitchen and bathroom. A somewhat old-school feeling which I really loved—it really feels like a place with a soul.
Spacious flat with a nice terrasse. The location is great and quiet
Cher was responsive and helpful! Amazing location. Tram is a bit loud in the double bedroom but there is a fan available that mutes the sound. Big beautiful windows! Would be back again in a flash!

We highly recommend this apartment! Great location, very clean, and hosts were very friendly and responsive. Perfect for our family of 4. It was very easy to walk to restaurants and bakeries, and the nearby tram was convenient. We’d stay there again!

Luca’s place was very great to rest after a good day. Not only was the flat clean and tidy but the whole building ! We felt safe being there. We had to buy some stuffs by ourselves but it didn’t matter much because everything else was perfect. The flat was sparkling clean and it was quiet outside as the flat is situated near a park/forest. Luca was always there answering very quickly if we had any request (Thank you for your kindness once again.) I would definitely recommend booking Luca’s place and will surely book his flat again if I happen to come back to Zürich. Thank you again for everything. Best regards Camille
Magnificent, spacious plot in the heart of Budapest. Very nice, welcoming and responsive host. We can only highly recommend this place.

I had a little difficulty entering the apartment (the entry keypad is high up and slightly hidden in the frame of the door) but the host was very responsive and helpful. The flat is quiet and very spacious and very well located. The kitchen was really well equipped and everything was very clean and the outside space is great! It is a high quality property and so it is let down by things like very old and damp smelling bathroom towels, cheap and hard pillows and low quality bathroom products.

Great stay in a prime location! The apartment is close to public transportation, stores, restaurants, and grocery shops, making it super convenient. The home was clean, easy to access, and had a large terrace that would be wonderful in warmer months. The only downside was the pillows—all were extremely firm, so a bit more variety would be a nice touch. Overall, a great choice for a stay in Zurich!

the apartment was very central for our stay in Zurich. it was very easy access to trams and rail. Very spacious, with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. Cher took very good care of us. we needed a place to store our luggage after checking out and we were able to put our luggage in storage while we went on our tour of Lindt chocolate factory. Cher was the perfect host!

The location in Seefeld area is excellent, there are two supermarkets directly across the street, a nice playground and several restaurants and bakeries. Chris’s place is good, the apartment is a good size for a couple with a small child. Chris provided us a crib. The beds are comfortable and the kitchen has the basics we needed. Chris had prepared some nespresso capsules when we arrived. The only issue we had is that it was very hot in the summer with no it conditioning. The attic apartment gets super hot and it was hard to sleep even with the fan in the room. Thanks for a nice stay!
Tania's place was nice and clean. Great location near the train station and within walking distance to the lake and old town. Would definitely recommend staying here!

Tania’s place is amazing! Very spacious and accommodating. It’s about a 30 minute walk to old town which is easy and doable. All basic necessities such as towels, soap, etc were provided. The space was clean and Tania was very helpful for us!

Everything was perfect and fitted the description and the pictures shown on the site. The only negative part is that it is noisy because the flat is located in front of two very busy tram lines. It was particularly warm during our stay with vey high temperatures and it was impossible to sleep with the windows closed. Thus, we have to choose between high temperatures or noise from the street starting very early in the morning... I am sure that in winter time would be perfect and I would probably rate the stay as "great" instead of "good". Nevertheless, the place is highly recommendable!

Had an awesome stay in David‘s apartment! Loved the location: very quiet and close to the tram. The apartment was well equipped and the bed was very comfy! Everything worked well. Communication was excellent as well. Definitely highly recommend it to future Airbnb guests!

We enjoyed our two nights at Grazyna's house in Zurich. It was clean and tidy, and the location is good. You can get public transport easily to the city, and a cab to the airport is not very far and not expensive. We had a warm, quiet, comfortable sleep, and Grazyna is upstairs if you have any questions. And her little dog Amelie is adorable too! Thanks Grazyna

David was an incredible host, the apartment is exactly like the photographs and he was so responsive when it came to my inquiries. He was amazingly polite and kind. A perfect apartment for a couple, me and my girlfriend enjoyed our time immensely. Hot water was as described, would be a bit frustrating at times however, did not take long to get used to. Thank you for a beautiful stay!

David's place is a great base for exploring not only Zürich, but it's super easy to access Zürich HB via a short tram ride to the station. The studio apartment is perfect for a single person or couple and has everything you need for a comfortable stay. There are lots of restaurants and supermarkets nearby as well. David is a great host, very responsive and detail oriented. Check in was easy and clearly outlined in communication from him prior to our stay. Thanks, David, for helping make our stay in Switzerland worry-free and pleasant!

We had a great time staying at David's for our week in Zurich. He made sure we had everything we needed from start to finish. The apartment was even better than the photos! The balcony was great and the kitchen was well equipped for cooking. We walked everywhere most days but there were also multiple bus lines close to the apartment which was nice when it rained. We would definitely recommend David's place to anyone visiting Zurich.

The apartment is conveniently accessible from Zürich's Main Train Station, surrounded by plenty of dining options. The building doesn't look attractive, but the apartment is very clean, well-equipped and comfortable. Overall, very good value for money. The best part, Steffi and her boyfriend were extremely communicative and flexible at all times.

Piotr's place was great for my one night stay in Zurich! The room is huge with a very comfy bed. Only 10 min tram from the zurich main station and 30 min train to the airport makes it a super convenient location. Piotr was super nice and friendly, even gave me a few recommendations for my short stay. Highly recommend!

Very neat and tidy unit in a decent part of Zurich. ‘Excellent’ customer service to any needs we had during our stay. The only recommendation I might have would be a more comfortable mattress on the bed. Other than that, very nice experience!

We loved our stay at this apartment. It is located very conveniently right next to bus (89 and 304) and Tram stops (13) which will get you easily to Altstetten or the city. There is a Coop in the building and a bakery across the street for all your grocery needs. The place was very private and we truly appreciated the fantastic view over the valley especially from the loft at night. The only thing we had some issues with was the mattress which seemed to be very hard but I guess it depends on the individual. We found a solution though and all was well. We would definitely recommend this accommodation and will be back! Thank you Tobi for assisting us with all our questions.
Lovely clean place and in a nice quiet area with easy links by tram and bus to the centre.

We loved to stay in Elena's Ecohouse. The house was nice, impeccable clean, cosy and situated in a green neighborhood in the western part of Zürich. We could park the car nearby and could reach the whole of Zürich easily with public transport. The only thing that visitors should know is that the house has two (double bed) rooms but that they are not completely privat. The rooms are on different levels but are (partly) open spaces and those sleeping in the upper level need to pass through the lower bedroom to go to the bathroom. Anyway, for us that was clear beforehand as it was visible on the photos and on the plan that is given with the description. I would definitely stay in Elena's house again.
Very nice experience there. Amazing location to visit the city you can get most of places on foot easily. Also the host is kind and friendly.
Very clean and well equipped apartment. Good location. The host offered a storage room for our luggage after check-out.

I was originally booked into one of Dimi’s other apartments but after finding a huge amount of mould in the bathroom Dimi immediately moved me to one of his other apartments which was bigger and in an even more central location. Everything was dealt with very swiftly and the second apartment (this listing) was perfect. Huge living/dining space, large bedroom which was very comfortable. Check-in was easy with finding the keys. I would definitely stay here again. The price is maybe a little steep but for the location it is worth it. Thank you for another good stay!

Great location and apartment is really nice. Unfortunately we visited Zürich and day temps were close to 90 and the apartment does not have AC. We did have fans and were able to open the windows. Very comfy beds and clean apartment

The property was neat, clean, and had all the basic amenities we needed for a comfortable stay. However, we were disappointed by a last-minute change in our booking. We had specifically opted for a 2-bedroom apartment so the four of us could stay together, but we were informed at the last moment that we’d been given two separate rooms instead. This defeated the purpose of choosing an Airbnb to stay as a group. The change also caused delays, as we had to wait quite a while for someone to physically come and hand over the keys, with no clear communication in the meantime. We were left waiting at the property and trying to reach the host through Airbnb support. This part of the experience could definitely have been handled better.

Me and my fam of 4 LOVED this stylish apartment. It was incredibly clean and so well appointed. Plenty of space even with the 4 of us and lots of luggage!
