The manager on the property helped us with anything we needed, whether that was a spare plug adaptor, an extra fan, and directions to town. The only issue was that we arrived at the end of a heatwave so our first night was pretty warm as there's no aircon. But it was short-lived and once the weather was perfect, the accommodation became moreso :)

We had a wonderful stay! The place was exactly as described — clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything I needed. The location was perfect, close to supermarkets, restaurants and transport. The host was very friendly, responsive, and made check-in smooth and easy. We really appreciated the small touches that made the stay feel special. I’d definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting the area and would love to stay again!”

The place was just what I needed - clean, good space. Unfortunately, the window in the bedroom wouldn't open, and no one was around to fix it. Also, I was never able to get the wifi to work. The host was responsive, just unable to do anything about it.

I had a short stay before I flew back to my country. It was a clean and cute room. Everything is as expected. Rossana is also a great host! However, it was a bit noisy opening the windows at night. Please also note that there are few steps of stairs you have to take. I had a bit difficulty carrying my luggage up to the room.

This is a very practical and well maintained stay. For my visiting relatives, it offered everything they needed. Rossana (Host) is very attentive and clear. It is Not a luxurious place, though it is very well kept and fitted. The only negative thing to say (completely personal) is that you gotta brush your teeth in the kitchen sink, which is the only one in the room. That said, if you like what you see, book your stay with peace of mind.
He is the best host very friendly and a great human being He provided me everything that I needed.he was continuously in touch with me until I reached his place .

The space was in a relatively good location and very spacious for a couple. Tastefully decorated and fluffy towels. Check-in was easy as well. However, I left with a bad taste in my mouth, though, because when I asked the host to please provide some hand soap (there was none; only several bottles of shampoo), he told me he trusted his crew and that they would have left it and that he was "under the impression" I'm trying to get money from him. It was insulting and rude. Marc was unresponsive and unprofessional, so something to keep in mind.
Enrique was a nice Host and the apartment was super cozy

The apartment was spacious and looked just like on the pictures at first sight. However, later on we discovered large stains on the couch, some of the chairs at the dining table and also the curtains.

Christine is an amazing host! Thoughtful and flexible with times. She responded immediately to any inquiry and recommended a very sweet sightseeing place nearby. I would stay at her place again. The house is very clean. However one thing is inaccurate and was slightly surprising to me: the shower room is separated by only one curtain from the room next to it, which is currently occupied by another tenant. Another small thing, from my room I could hear almost anything the person next door was doing.
Clean and for this price&couple of nights is good. But the toilet is not in the room, need to go to the first floor.

Nice little room in the University district. Had a wonderful surprise when they upgrade my room without telling me, so I ended up having a toilet in my room despite what was advertised. It was a great room for the price and very clean. While it's not exactly down town, you can still walk to everything or hop on the public tram which is just a couple blocks away - super convenient.

The room is basic and the bed linen was crisp and clean. The net curtains however were grotty and needed either washed or replaced. Communication was poor - I had to chase to have a reply to a question I had about check in (no reply after a month). Check in was easier and with a longer checkin window than stated on Airbnb details.

The room was not cleaned when I arrived, but the nice gentleman at the check-in was very kind and switched me to a normal hotel room. I had a comfortable stay and I am glad I was not in the tiny room advertised on Airbnb.

The Platte200 is a very small room in a really cute hotel in a great neighbourhood. The room is small but there are lots of hooks, a place to hang clothes and a little chair, so it’s very comfortable. The bed had a great pillow, lovely crisp clean linens and a cozy duvet. The shower is a good size and you have a little sink in the shower room so you don’t have to go downstairs to the toilet to brush your teeth. The bathroom is downstairs, which is a bit of a hike if you have to go in the middle of the night! But overall I had a lovely two nights in Platte200 and I would recommend this place as a good value near downtown Zurich.

The room I stayed in was pretty small, and had only shower and a sink but no toilet - so I needed to go to the other floor to get there( which I don’t find a problem tbh). The people at the reception were great, and I was able to check in a little bit earlier which was really helpful! The room is small, but enough for one night stay. Shower was clean , however the room itself had some stains in the wall, but overall a great stay for the price I payed !

Very cute place. Note that there is no toilet in the room; it is one floor down. There is a nice shower though and the room is cozy. Also note that this location is not very walkable from the city center. It looks like a short walk on the map but is up some steep and winding hills. However, there are very frequent trams at "Platte" (like every 5 minutes or so) a couple of streets away. It's a short ride from the center and back.
matthias's place was well placed and easy to get to from the airport. it is close to the city centre and allowed us to explore in the few hours we had. matthias was very helpful and a great host.

We had a wonderful time staying in Dominik's beautiful apartment for the holidays. It's very well located near the Wollishofen train station, and you can either take a quick train or tram, or walk along the lake to the centre. It has a beautiful view of Lake Zurich and Uetliberg mountain, and is very tastefully designed. It was a wonderful home for us for our stay - would recommend for a cozy stay in a quiet suburb still close to the centre of Zurich. Thanks so much!

Chris's apartment is an amazing place to stay in Zurich. The view of the Limmat River below and the old town across the river are amazing throughout the day and night. It is perfectly located for exploring Zurich -- in walking distance to the main train station, shopping areas, amazing restaurants. The apartment itself was clean and comfortable. Chris was fantastic with communication and making check-in easy for me. You'll love staying here -- especially if it's your first time in Zurich.

This place is fantastic! Amazing location, great view, several small cooking appliances if you need, walking distance to the main train station, restaurants, bars, comfy bed, nice pillows, windows that open nicely for some fresh air (it’s on the top floor so the heat rises up there a bit). Neighbors are a little loud and the walls are paper thin so you can hear everything. Check in was a little off but chris accommodated and we would definitely stay here if we came back to the area! He has other properties as well!

Chris was easy to communicate and left very clear instructions for check in and check out. Nothing crazy like some other Airbnbs! The bed was fairly uncomfortable for me but there's also a twin sized chaise lounge, so I slept on there instead. Great location very accessible to trams and the central train station.

Definitely recommend this place, the stay was great. Location is perfect, right in the center of old town, so everything was in walking distance. The train station is about 10 min walk from the flat. The flat itself is pretty clean and cozy. There’s no much space, but it’s perfect for one person. The hosts are super nice and responsive, very flexible with the check in and booking. Thank you for making my stay in Zurich so comfortable!

The space was immaculate, modern, serving every need, as well as accurately described from the listing. Henrik’s reliable communication and amiable guidance will help you enjoy Zurich to the fullest. He is worthy of his super host status and high review numbers.

Nadine and her partner are very welcoming. The check in is after 2pm but they let me check in at 12 pm. The location is near the tram station especially if you use the garage door and the tram duration to the main station is like 6 minutes. The place is clean and feels just like home. Before I forget they put chocolate in the room so yummy ( i’m not someone who like chocolate but these were good). Nadine place will be my first choice when i visit Swiss again.
Min is a wonderful host. I definitely love the time I live with Min and would like to come back again.
The location is good and the host is very nice and he even helped us to pick up the luggage! Very good experience except that the toilet is quite complicated, but the host will explain to you!

The flat is bright, comfortable and efficient. The location is great and close to so many amenities. Supermarket extremely close. Small problems came up and were dealt with very quickly. Communication was excellent. We would rent from Tania again for sure if we were ever in the area.
Great location to hop on the tram and See the city. The place is super nice and the beds are so comfortable.

Excellent location, great place and very near from the supermarkets such as Migros and Coop, the city center is near and the place is super safe! The hosts reply fast and they offered us things more than we expected!

The apartment was lovely, the building and neighborhood was awesome. The only thing was that the Wi-Fi was never able to operate at full speed. It took awhile for it to connect and when it eventually did it was super slow. Other than that it was a perfect stay.

Spotless clean place in the heart of Zurich, walking distance to everywhere. Fully equipped kitchen, you can easily prepare your own food, which was worthwhile, because I returned late in the evening from work and didn’t bother to go out for dinner. A place to feel home away from home 🏡. I will definitely return to this place
Super nice brand new room in the most beautiful Jugendstil building with both the lake and centre in walking distance.

all the amenities were right as the description, the place and the building is beautiful, and the view of the appartment I got it was really lovely. It was a heat wave on Switzerland so the fan was a gift to avoid the extreme temperature. Would definetly reccomend and stay again there!!
Very nice cozy place. Good location & close to city Center/ bus station/ railway. Of course expensive but still reasonable vs. Zürich average cost. The host is responsive and nice to talk to.

I had originally booked a different place but there was a plumbing issue and they offered me this place in the vicinity. It turned out to be a nice surprise and better than expected. Tram is just down the street and there’s a nice boulangerie off the corner. It’s just west of the high end shops and walking distance to Banhoffstrasse. Place was clean, quiet and bright. The elevator was a plus. Nice view as well. Host was very quick to respond. Thank you

Perfect for two. The room has plenty of space. The neighborhood is quiet but there was some road work one day and the windows protected well against the noise. On the downside: there is no micro-wave. Maybe it's me ... but I think that the micro-wave is essential. When I go to an Airbnb, I either eat at a restaurant or heat a dish in the micro-wave. The flat has an oven, but that does not do the trick.

Christian’s flat was a dedicated Airbnb space and did that job very well. Easy to find and access and very clean. There was a very noisy building site nearby, but the double glazed windows were excellent at keeping the early morning Jack hammering noise out. Great location near to the centre of town and the lake. Recommended
enjoyed the stay here. the location is awesome. place was quiet and clean. is definitely worth the price we are paying.

Great location and nice place! Bed and bathroom was really great! We did however miss salt, peppar and oil to cook. The apartment was also extremely hot during the days so if you are going during the summer I would be prepared for that, luckily we spent most of our days outside. Besides that we had a lovely stay.

Very suitable for parent-child tour friends, there are children's room, lego toys, a piano, a garden, and a cute cat with human nature. The kitchen is perfect for cooking at home. It's safe and convenient to park your car in your garage. It's only five to ten minutes' drive from downtown Zurich. The landlord is very friendly and will reply to any questions in time. In a word, this room is especially suitable for those who travel by themselves. It is highly recommended!
We enjoyed the stay at Lilian‘s place. It was super clean and quiet near the city center and all advertisements. Highly recommend!

Amazing apartment and wonderful hosts. The place was beautiful, tidy, clean and the room was very comfortable. We slept like logs. Bert and Kamil are wonderful people and really did everything to make us feel right at home. Their dog is the sweetest and added even more amazingness to an already perfect stay. We would really like to recommend this Airbnb and we will definitely be staying here again when returning to Zürich.

Bert and Kamil are amazingly sweet and welcoming hosts! We absolutely loved staying with both of them. We only stayed one night and they made us feel right at home, and the breakfast is such a sweet treat! Their home is beautiful with lovely views of the city and easy to walk everywhere. Can't wait to stay with them again for our next visit!

The flat is in a great location and is beautifully clean with all the necessary amenities. The local supermarket is conveniently close, the public transport system is easily accessible and the wonderful lake promenade is two mins away. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and love Zurich! We'll be back!

Absolutely the best guest experience one can have. Bert and Kamil are the friendliest hosts. They take care of you from the start till the end, while having the loveliest conversations. Check-in and Check-out was very easy and flexible. They gave great recommendations, the place was easily reachable and quick to travel in Zürich. The room is super fancy, along with the bathroom. Most comfortable bed I’ve slept in. 11/10 recommend. Totally worth it, go book the room!
The living experience was perfect, and the environment was wonderful! The breakfast was healthy and delicious! Bert's considerate service left us with an unforgettable experience.
Chris was accomodating and gave us all information needed in a timely manner. The location made it convenient for working at the Zurich Uni. Recommended :)
Amazing place!!! We really appreciate the place. Well located, but a little noisy during the night because you hear trains! I recommend the place and the host is very nice!

We had a great stay at Krone’s Pop Up Hotel. We actually have stayed a second time, but booked directly on their website. The space is tidy, comfortable and organized. There is a front desk agent at select hours throughout the day (check in and check out). There were Nespresso pods for the morning, which was a nice touch. The bathrooms and showers at this property are communal, but there was always one available when needed and they were very clean - there is a sink and mirror in each room, as well. Overall, this was the perfect space for our stay. The neighborhood was just what we needed, and extremely walkable.

Unfortunately I cancelled so I haven't seen the room itself. But the employees were really kind and understanding towards my situation. The contact was polite and quick and thus they received these 5 stars from me.

Staying at Krone feels like staying more in a dormitory than a hotel - especially if like me your bathroom is shared. I do not mean that as a complaint - the facilities were well-maintained , and the room - while not decadently outfitted - had a simplicity which I quite enjoyed. The room is heated, but comes which a portable heater just in case. Concierge was efficient, and the location is ideal. Admittedly, I did not myself use any of the “hip” (while not fancy) amenities or shared spaces the building had to offer - but they are there! Zürich was wonderful, and I hope to venture a return one day!

It was a nice stay, everything was as described. Nice host. The listing mentioned that we cannot use sofa in living room which is ok but the sofa takes up majority of living room making it unusable, so for a relaxed seating the only place remains is bedroom. It was complete peace and close to tram station.

We enjoyed our stay at Sandra's place. It was in an excellent location and very close to transport links. The flat was warm and welcoming with some lovely touches by Sandra, including a lovely kiwi jam made with fruit from her garden. Thoroughly recommended.
Fantastic, nicely furnished, new apartment at a great and quiet location in Zurich. Great hospitality and communication with José. Also, the bed is very comfortable!
Amazing apartment, nice and clean, very comfy and perfectly located. The host was easy to reach and friendly. I can only recommend.

The apartment is in a convenient location, close to a tram station and easily accessible from airport. The location itself is very beautiful. It is a well kept and maintained apartment with ample kitchen facilities. Micheal was a great host. He was very responsive to all our questions and concerns. He gave very clear replies. Check in was smooth and so was check out. Would definitely recommend this place.

Irina is very responsive and knows the area very well so she can offer good places to eat and activities to do. As a bonus, she accommodated my later checkout time which I really appreciated. Would highly recommend!

Irina's place is the closest you can be to the train station, and the tram station can't be nearer. It is literally at the door step. The bed is large enough for 2 adults and a small child. Irina is a great host, very friendly and always available for any queries.

We had a very nice stay at Daniel’s flat. The description and pictures accurately represented the flat. It was clean and had everything we needed. The flat is located in a quiet and safe neighborhood, yet is only around 10-15 from the city centre by train and/or tram. Daniel was very friendly and responsive. Thank you Daniel for our nice stay in Zurich

Comfortable little apartment in a very cute neighborhood (very residential) with a great grocery store. When we arrived, there was only enough bedding/pillows/towels for one person. We did eventually find more in the closet. Daniel was flexible with check in and the apartment is convenient to public transit and the city center (a 15 min train away).

Absolutely lovely central location in the Old Town. With a couple of extra touches like coffee pods that fit the machine and sugar etc it could be outstanding. Marie did accept a late booking from us so maybe that could explain this , but the accommodation was running very low on toilet paper (we ran out) and had no garbage bags.
The place is small and clean. Overall is a good and is near the station.

A little confusing since the check in location and actual Airbnb are separate but the staff were helpful. Great location, super walkable to everything yet the room was quiet. The only thing was the room smelled like it had been painted recently and it was a little overpowering.

Decent place, good location. Small rooms, complimentary mini bar drinks which was nice. WIFI was weak, which was the main reason I went. Clean rooms, ok shower, hospitality varies, some super nice and take the time to help, others just Swiss nice. All in all an ok experience, not great but definitely not bad

Greats place to stay for few days . Great location , secure and private ! The young guy at the Front Desk “ sorry forgot his name “ is the best . Kind , helpful and super friendly make a difference to our experience . Thank You 🙏
Awesome place … great location .. walking distance from all the attractions and market.
Really happy about the place!! it is really close to the city center and the place looks incredible! the hosts are always available for anything at any time.

Very nice apartment. Clean and the hosts were very helpful. Parking was expensive at the building but the location was great and very close to public transportation, so it made our time in Zurich very easy. The area it is locates is in a walking mall type area with a grocery store and a gym so it made our lives very easy while we were there. I would recommend staying there for anyone traveling to Zurich
We really enjoyed our stay at Bjorns place. The location is quite central and it does have a lot of amenities within the complex. Would definitely recommend and stay again.
The host is the best, super nice, responsive and very hospitable. The place is very central, super clean and very handy, everything you is available.

The apartment is very nice, just like it is displayed in the pictures. The bathrooms are new, the beds are very comfy. Note that the third bedroom is an open Maiaonette one, this I did not see when checking the pictures . However, with six adults, the living and kitchen area are too small, with four adults and two little kids it is totally fine. Only downside in the kitchen is, that we only had 6 glasses, knives, forks etc. it would’ve been nice to have more. Apart from that, no complaints, I would stay there again!

I had a wonderful stay in EMA’s studio apartment. It’s in a fantastic location - great and safe neighbourhood, within walking distance of Old Town, cafes, restaurants, supermarkets and shops are close by and public transport is within 3 mins walk too. The apartment is clean, fully equipped and the Wi-Fi was excellent. You are also only 4 mins walk to the lake promenade which is absolutely beautiful, especially during sunset. EMA were great with communication and were very responsive if you had any questions or problems. The added bonus was that the apartment was cleaned and towels were changed every second day. If I’m ever back in Zurich again, I would definitely stay with them again. Thank you for your fantastic hospitality EMA!! 🙏🏼

Rafael was such a warm and welcoming host! The place was exactly like the description in the Zurich area. The only downside was the street noise at night, since we had to have our windows open due to no air conditioning. Otherwise everything was great!
This place is amazing. The views outside is wonderful and the private balcony is next level.
Host is great and helpful. The house is clean and comfortable, especially the kitchen is well equipped. The location is convenient, just a few mins walk to the Tram station.

Very clean apartment with a beautiful terrace. We checked in with the front desk, who were very helpful and walked us around the apartment. It was well-equipped, including washer/ dryer, bathroom amenities, and a well stocked kitchen. The view from the terrace is amazing (river on one side and hills on the other) and the tram into old town stops right in front of the building. The only thing I would say is that this is not a warm cozy apartment (I was cold for most of the stay) but it is pretty in a minimalist way.

The apartment exactly as described in the listing and photos are accurate. Peter and Engin are incredibly responsive and helpful. 1 minute walk to grocery store (COOP and local store, which is open on Sunday) and about 2 minutes to the tram lines. Would definitely stay at again. The building has a small elevator, but note you will have to go up about 8 steps from the entrance to the elevator landing. Note the apartment is not air conditioned, but several fans are provided. It was uncomfortably warm on days that were 30C+, but not mu

The apartment was excellent and looked even better than in the photos. The room was more spacious than expected and in a great location, only about 100 meters from the tram station and just 7–8 stops from Zürich HB. Both bedrooms offered good privacy. The host decorated the place with great style, and it truly felt like staying in a real Swiss home. We were pleasantly surprised to find a CD player with a large collection of CDs. The bathroom was fully equipped, almost like a 5-star hotel. The host was very attentive and offered quick, personal assistance whenever needed. We would definitely stay here again if traveling as a group of 2–3 people.

Great large space that was clean and comfortable. We were there during the heat wave with no a/c (very few places have it), which was a little rough but they had a good fan. Great communication and cleaning every other day if you want it.

We stayed for 3 days in Roland’s place. We chose the area because we had friends who live in Oerlikon. The small apartment was exactly as shown in the photos and extremely clean. Roland was SUPER responsive - within minutes - and addressed a small issue that arose with highest professionalism. We would highly recommend his studio apartment (we are Canadian and that is what we would call his space).
Roland is helpful . the place is just as like the photo and more . it is clean and close to the supermarket. Highly recommended
A lovely little place located right at the heart of Zurich. The room is modern and furnished well and was also very well-stocked. I would highly recommend for anyone travelling in a group of 1-2!
José-Luis was reactive, the appartment was clean, well located and really well equiped. The only inconvenience was the noise outside during the night.

Although the location is convenient for tourists and train travel, the street is extremely loud at night which makes sleeping tricky. The flat itself is well kept and the kitchen well stocked. Check in was smooth. Unfortunately we felt the host was very delayed in responding to our questions and queries.

A very well located apartment with easy walking access to train station. The apartment has a comfortable bed and good shower which were the main amenities used. Area was safe and apartment two levels up. There is also a basement laundry area. An added bonus was an adopter when my old style one wouldn’t fit in the recessed slots. Recommend Cher and Billys place.
Good area and great communication! My friend and I really enjoyed exploring Zurich from this cozy Airbnb, and thought it was in the perfect part of the city.

The entrance to the apartments was unassuming and not quite what I was expecting but the apartment itself was very convenient and comfortable. All amenities were as listed, cooking facilities were ample. It can get a little noisy in the evening with the sound of the traffic but dies down later part of the night. Walkable to Zurich HB, churches and tourist spots within the area. overall a pleasant stay.
The condo was clean, comfortable and conveniently located. We loved the decks!

It was 3am before the bar across the road started to quiet down. The description said if you’re looking for a quiet break might not be the area for you but the noise was awful and we, after a couple of drinks ourselves, couldn’t get to sleep. I’m sorry but I would not recommend

Great Airbnb, practically a hotel! Cleaning every other day if you wish. Communication was great - was able to ask things throughout my stay and they responded quickly. In a more residential area so it was nice and quite but also a quick 15 mins slow walk to the train station. Only issue we had was with the shower drainage when using the ceiling shower however we did not inform EMA house of our issues during our short stay. I'm sure they would have remedied the issue quickly if we had. Would definitely stay again and recommend!

This small studio is very well located for exploring downtown Zürich. The apartment was very clean and has microwave, fridge, coffee maker, tea kettle, and a very nice shower. It’s small but comfortable for a short stay. For more than one person it might get tight for a longer stay. Check-in was a bit confusing for those not familiar with the Nuki process. We were only here on a Friday night and it was quite noisy as there were groups of people gathering to party just under the apartment on the street level alcove. But the windows help a bit with muffling noise and we had a comfortable enough sleep for an early flight next morning.
Sonia’s listing was very clean and in a prime location. The only thing I’ll mention is that it can get a little noisy given its proximity to the bars. Communication was perfect!
The location is great and the room is well-equipped with a lot of essentials even though it's small. The only drawback is that it's kind of hot in summer.

Great location, middle of old town with lots on your door step. The entrance doesn’t look so appealing,, but don’t be put off as once your inside it’s very nice. Pablo was really responsive to questions that we had. The small studio apartment has everything you need from Apple TV, Nespresso machine, induction hobs and everything you require to cater for yourself. Would stay here again and would highly recommend.

-good location -clean -small store in ground floor where you can buy water -restaurants are just across the street -have to carry heavy suitcase up and down 2 flights of stairs/not good if you have mobility problem

This is an absolutely fantastic location to explore Zurich and surrounds. Getting there was easy and Sonia described the place very well. It is noisy at night - but this to be expected being right in the centre of Zurich! We would stay here again due to its location and ease of use. Sonia and Pablo were great hosts.

We had a lovely stay here! We were only here for one night but the location was exactly what we needed. Central location, close to everything, clean apartment, and flexible checkin. The noise or temperature (no AC) did not bother us because the fan provided blocked out noise and cooled the place down. Unlocking the doors was done with an app, which was kind of confusing, but we figured it out. Would definitely recommend this apartment.

Jose's team is very responsive, I don't have to wait for more than 5 mins for a response. The apartment feels brand new, quality branded (Miele) kitchen equipment, washing machine, dryer, vacuum cleaner etc. Tastefully decorating and extremely pleasing. Very quiet area, easily located and very convenient as the tram stop is nearby. Only 9 mins to Zurich HB and the tram is very frequent. Full set of kitchen ware for cooking. Overall, this apartment is much better than hotel rooms, and even my own residence! Only consideration for the host, is about the lack of instructions to access English TV channels or movies. We tried and gave up watching TV even we got back to the apartment. There are no air conditioning in the apartment, but fans are provided when we requested them.

Great place. Sunny, quiet, stylish, well equipped and with a nice balcony. I had a blast. It’s close to the big park by the lake which is very beautiful and has nice restaurants. It takes about 20-30 minutes walking to get to the city center though, but for me it was not a big deal.

Wonderful apartment; Convenient location, 1-minute walk to the tram heading to the city center. Clean and comfortable room, fully equipped kitchen and bathroom. Wi is a friendly and welcoming person; we had a great time. Staying here is a great choice if you want to truly understand life in Zurich. Highly recommended.

This place is a great little hideaway for Zürich. The location is awesome and easily walkable. The walk from the train was no more than 10 minutes and Christian was great with giving clear check in instructions. The apartment is smaller than the photos show, but great if you are just looking for a place to sleep after a day of adventuring. The only reason I give it a 4/5 is because the bed was pretty broken in and difficult for my husband and I to share for that reason.

Overall, I liked the place, it was really worth the money. The location is nice - close to train station and tram stop. It is also close to the walking path along Limmat river. The room itself was pretty clean, maybe a bit small. But there was everything you needed. Maybe some hangers for the clothes would be nice. Wi is a great host, always there to help you.

Overall a great place to stay. Very easy to walk from and super close to the train. It’s def a basic studio, not mich to it, but a good value. Host was responsive. Ideally like to have more bath towels provided.

Had a comfortable stay. Wifi worked well for remote work and video calls. Despite the hot weather, having the windows open and the fan helped. Just a few minutes walk to grocery stores and trams/buses. The only small downside is the shower temperature fluctuates between warm and cold. Otherwise, recommended!

Great location, close to the main station and well commuted with public transport (bus or tram stations 2 min away), lots of shops and restaurants in less than 2min walk. The host is very responsive and considerate, apartment is clean and spacious with 2 balconies. Perfect stay for the city life experience with night life adventures;) Definitely recommend and looking forward to stay at Au’s flat again

Lovely apartment finished to a very high specification. Location is easy to get into the centre of Zurich and easy with a bus stop directly outside. You are sandwiched between the train line and the main road, but the soundproofing is to a very high standard. No complaints.

Ina is great! Unfortunately, we didn't have the opportunity to meet but she answered all my messages quickly and kindly. The apartment is in a very calm and quiet neighborhood. There is a bus stop nearby that takes you anywhere in the city quickly. The room is great and spacious! I recommend it to everyone!

This is the place to stay if you like quiet and still want to be close to a train station! Ina is very kind, responsive, and even left out pastries for me. Room as advertised-- I appreciate that it had a desk!

Wow!!! Beautifully located in the heart of Zurich, expect to wake up 1 min away from the pristine lake Zurich and welcomed by the soothing yet dreamy sound of the bells of the major Zurich münsters! The apartment has everything you need for a short stay - from kitchen appliances, utensils, to linens and bathroom paraphernalia. I’m still in awe with the location, and how it enabled us to discover the city with tremendous ease. Indulge in walks around town and good restaurants nearby. And, of course, enjoy the fact of having a beautiful lake 1 min away. The communication and check in procedures went smoothly. Finding the house is also not an issue as it is pretty easily identifiable with any maps app. Will come back :)

This is in such a great location! On the map, I couldn't tell if it was really close to the city or not, but it's incredibly close to the lake (just a couple of blocks), and then I would walk along the lake the entire way into town!! I just walked everywhere from Maurice's place, but there's also a bus stop very, very close and the buses/trains/public transport are incredible and clean too. This apartment was great: comfortable, clean, close to town, and Maurice was easy to communicate with and get ahold of with any questions.
The check-in was smooth. The place was comfy and location was great. We did enjoy our stay very much. I recommend a stay at Tania's. 🙂

Great location, close to public transport, restaurants and super clean! The size of the flat is good and beds very comfortable. We went during a very cold weekend and unfortunately the heating system is maybe not enough powerful or should be checked because it was a little bit cold in the flat. Apart from this, we had a lovely stay and would come again.

Dimi is an excellent host. It is superbly clean— maybe the cleanest place I’ve ever stayed at ! It is near a tram and you can get into downtown Zürich very easily and I’m very happy we stayed here. It is roomie given what else you can get in that area,—thank you Dimi for a great time!!

The apartment has a great view ! And We enjoyed seeing the skating rink across the way. yet the building was quiet and in a courtyard. The apartment is spacious and very well laid out. It was nice to have the two bathrooms with a family. The kitchen is great and had everything we needed. The hosts were always available and very responsive. Thank you! We will visit again.

The place was clean with all that u needed but my comment is that it’s written it has air conditioning but we found a very small one in one bedroom hardly working and rest of the house doesn’t have which was not as described we chose this place especially for the air conditioner,a little bit far from city center 35:40 minutes by transportation. It was spacious and clean and the kitchen has all the utilities needed only a microwave.

Nice apartment, says it was air conditioned but they were mobile ones and one broke straight away and we didn’t get a replacement. Other than that it was good, great location to the transport networks and shops, would stay there again 👍
we had a wonderful time at the apartment. it was well located and easy access to shopping and close to the city center and the airport.
Seamless check in, helpful staff, no problem with parking even with a big vehicle and great scenery from the apartment.

We had a great time at Gerard's place in Zurich. Gerard is quick to respond to all the queries and was very helpful in getting us settled. The place is in prime location surrounded by fantastic restaurants. We even had a great time watching the parade on Sunday which was less than a minute walk from the place. Highly recommended and we will surely stay here if we visit again. Thanks for hosting us.

Definitely worth what I paid for. There was no soap and shampoo, and he immediately went and purchased it and brought it over. The area is rough, graffiti everywhere and a cannabis store below the building. He was a great host, and did all he can to accommodate.

Overall, the location is excellent, and the space itself is clean, well-maintained, and thoughtfully organized. Gerard was highly responsive and attentive throughout our stay. However, I must agree with previous reviews regarding the noise level. If you're a light sleeper, this might not be the best choice, because you hear everything and everyone from inside (hallways and stairs) and outside.

This listing was attractive and the stay as a whole was pleasant. We (my family) liked the location and accessibility. The apartment was well kept and neatly maintained. I would love to come back and stay here again. The only drawback was, there were additional hidden charges which of course was optional. The listing said it can accommodate 4 pax and a price was quoted. After booking there was a recommendation made to pay additional for sofa bed, for "comfortable" stay for the same 4 pax. I raised it with AirBnB, they confirmed that since it is optional, it is my wish to choose to pay. So what happens to the "comfortable" aspect for 4 pax ? If I hadn't paid would I have had an "uncomfortable" stay?

Our time at Josephine’s - and in Zurich - was too short and we’ll definitely be coming back. We didn’t realize how busy the neighborhood was, so the complimentary ear plugs came in handy, but the space was clean and felt super safe. Definitely recommend!

We enjoyed our stay here a lot. It was very clean and comfortable. The entire place was clean and organized including the common areas. Reception is not 24x7, however, there is a contact number provided that will respond immediately and is also very accomodating. Location is also a plus and near Zurich HB station.
Accomodation is in a strategic location and very clean however a little confusing to find the entrance.

Amazing cozy room right in the middle of Altstadt Zurich. The location could not be better. The room is small but it has everything you need. The bathroom is great and modern, the kitchen is also just enough. Last but not least, Peter is an amazing person, he cares about his guests and he is very interested to talk to. Definetly recommend 👌 👏

Loved it here! If I ever need a place to stay in Zurich in the future I’ll definitely be back. The only thing is there’s no AC so it was a bit warm trying to sleep and the church next door rings it’s bells every 15 minutes but for what you get it’s more than worth it!

Great place to stay, cute and small studio perfect for one person or a couple and very close to the bus stops. Efficient stay. Note, there is no stove so you won’t be able to cook but there is microwave and blender and fridge.

Great place to stay in an accessible area of the city. You are able to get a bus/tram and get to the city center in about 6/7 minutes. The host was very responsive and helpful, always offering tips of what to do in Switzerland. Would definitely recommend!

I had a wonderful stay in this peaceful studio. It looked exactly like the pictures and had many extras like an assortment of teas, a gift of chocolate, and some basics in the refrigerator already waiting for me! The host was very pleasant and messaged a couple times just to make sure I had all my needs met. The studio is located in between Tiefenbrunan and Stadelhofen train stations. I most often chose a quick 20 minute walk to either station, but there are also trams within a four minute walking distance from the studio, that run every few minutes to the stations. I enjoyed the scenery on my walks through peaceful residential neighborhood, and passing by the local stores. The bed is comfortable, and the towels are plush. A great stay!

The location is good, it's outside the city and one has to take the train (S10) to Schwabstrasse and then take the bus 73 that doesn't appear on google maps suggestions. The walk uphill is wonderful and there are beautiful landscapes when you go for a walk. While the location is great, unfortunately the stay wasn't so much. It was cold and the blanket provided was not big enough for two people, they mentioned that there isn't one more available. If the property is supposed to host two people, there should be enough resources available to host that many. Also, according to me the whole point of Airbnb is that the host interacts with the visitors and help them with the suggestions that a local would know better, in this case, there was absolutely no such interaction.

The Airbnb was located in a good place closer to the public transport. The big issue for me was it was not worth the price we paid for. The bed was very uncomfortable - it was a sofa bed which has partitions in odd areas and was painful to sleep on, both me and my partner woke up with a back pain - that being the biggest and the only pain point. Would recommend placing a full mattress instead. Besides that Kora was very communicative and the place was squeaky clean.

Nice apartment and located close to many restaurants and cafes. Be prepared to walk up stairs to get to this location however , but we did alright and in our mid 60's. Didn't realize it was on such a hill, but we did like the location.

This place is in perfect location - short walking distance to trams and train station that take you directly to the airport. Tania shared great trip details with a map, even a great hiking spot near the city where you can get great views overlooking Zürich, lake, and part of the Alps.
perfect! large spaces, clean, close to the center and well connected, everything necessary was there. the price Is High but in line with city'prices

Nice fairly well located apartment with comfy bed. The shutters in the bedroom can be closed so the room gets nicely dark. Clean and generally as described in the ad. Check-in was easy and communication good. The only thing was the apartment smells of cigarette smoke, you get used to it after a bit but it’s not very pleasant when entering the place.

Highly recommend this cosy little apartment. The host is great and location perfect. As other reviewers say unfortunately the walls are thin and you do hear other residents at times, but if you can ignore that it's a great little option.

The location of the apartment, the ease of access, its cleanliness, and the quietness of the street were all excellent — I would rate them a 10. The only downside is that the apartment tends to get quite warm, and there is unfortunately no cooling system available. I believe that at least a fan would be essential for added comfort. Additionally, having an iron in the apartment is a thoughtful touch and much appreciated; however, it might benefit from being updated.

Deutsch unten. — AirBnB the way it was originally intended! The entire family is incredibly charming and hospitable. Location, room and amenities are even better than you‘d guess from the pictures. We felt right at home and might be back some day. — So war AirBnB ursprünglich gedacht! Die ganze Familie ist sehr liebenswürdig und gastfreundlich. Lage, Zimmer und Ausstattung sind noch besser, als die Bilder vermuten lassen. Wir haben uns wie zuhause gefühlt und kommen vielleicht auch wieder.

Sarah and her family were really helpful, friendly and kind. I had a warm welcome and found the place to be very comfortable. The bathroom is luxurious. I drank wonderful coffee and learnt about good places to eat and explore. The lake-side spot nearby is also wonderful.

This is well-located and tastefully furnished apartment. Johannes is an excellent host and his communication is fast and accurate. Zurich is an easy city to navigate and we used trams and busses which were just a few metres from the apartment. We would highly reccommend this property.

Really nice studio apartment in Zurich. We enjoyed the location, which is well-connected to bus and tram networks, and has a lot of bars and restaurants a short walk away. The art museum was also a 10 minute walk away. The studio was very clean and well-suited for travelers doing work, and gets great light. The Wi-Fi was quite good; the external monitor looks great, but we unfortunately did not have the right port (Thunderbolt) on our laptop so we couldn’t use it. Johannes was very responsive and professional. We would come back and stay here again.

Great location, near public transportation, 15 mins walk to Zurich main station. Mi is great and she replied to all my inquiries instantly. The only thing to consider is that the bathroom has no door, so it’s not suitable for people who require privacy.

The location is great. Very close to the main station and yet being on a back street, the station noise can’t be heard. Communication with Stephanie is easy and you normally get your answers within an hour. The check in was easy. The apartment is spotless clean, big enough for a week trip and the space has been smartly used. There are enough amenities and with high quality (cutlery, plates, dishwasher, …). Maybe the only downside is the thin walls that you can hear your neighbor and their pet. All in all, great experience!

Great location near city center and the lake and close to grocery stores and nice restaurants. Just know that it is right near a tram route so you may hear the trams at night. But honestly it was great location and a clean apartment. Would totally stay again on our next trip.

Very cosy, clean and well equipped little studio with a garden view, close to the Milchbuck tram stop. The only little drawback is that when the window's open you hear the cars passing by, but with earplugs it's no problem. Thanks for the great stay!

Had a really pleasant stay in this comfortable apartment with a v comfortable and spacious bed and great views of trees. Check in and general communication was outstanding. Resolved unexpected issue with plug adapter quickly. Line 10 tram nearby was perfect, especially getting out to the airport. Quiet location aside from some tram noise. Loved integrated transport system in Zurich

Booked at the last minute so we could rest after a long flight. This worked out perfectly! Reasonable distance from the airport, easy to find, and we had no issues getting inside. Loved that there was an elevator for heavy luggage, and felt extremely safe while inside! The local area is full of dining options. The shower was a great bonus- and the little patio area was awesome for “people watching”. Great for a short stay!

This is a great place, Sonia is really nice and helpful, the place is small as its name states but has what you need. The only minor drawbacks is the heavy tram noise at night when they are parked for the night, and the long time it takes (at least 5 mins) to get hot water. Will be back

Very good place for a short stay, the apartment has everything you need and is only a short walk from Zurich HB train station making it super easy to get around. Only downside is the road outside is quite noisy first thing in the morning.

What a cute Airbnb within walking distance to sights and train station. Comfortable and well equipped. We really loved this place! Great local bars and restaurants nearby. We stayed during a hot time of year and there is no AC or fan, it was too loud at night to open windows. Plus it’s a ground floor unit. Majority of the year it wouldn’t matter, but it was unbearably hot without airflow when we stayed. That’s the only downfall for us. Everything else was amazing! We would stay again!
Sonia's place was fine for us. We had everything we needed. And the place was well located with easy access to public transport.
The apartment was lovely and an easy walk the tram station! The only issue was that it was very hot at night, even with the fan on.

This is a great place for a short stay in Zurich. It is close to the train station and commercial streets, and easy to find. There is even a supermarket nearby! I had a great time, but I did expect more appliances for what I paid (e.g., a microwave). I know Zurich is expensive, but still… The pictures describe the place well. Thanks for everything!

I stayed at the apartment for 4 days and had a great time. The apartment was easy to find and in a great part of Zürich with many restaurant, cafés and the train station nearby. Check-in and check-out were super easy. During the night there was some noise from the street, neighbors and bars nearby. Aline was very nice and replied quickly. :)

I enjoyed Lazhar's place, but I think the guests should know it is a shared townhome very close to public transport. There are four rooms for rent all on different floors (I think). Lazhar is very responsive and was helpful in adding better pillows and a dorm fridge for my six night stay. I was disappointed by the extra fees he charges even for sheets, which I thought was ridiculous. Also, there is no real common area to sit and a lot of post it notes with rules. However, it was restful place to stay and close to Seebach train/bus station and very easy to take the 768 bus to/from airport. Also, there is no free car parking at Lazhar's place, but possibly available for extra fee. Overall, it's a nice clean and quiet place.
We had a great stay, the studio is exactly as advertised. Sonia and Pablo are responsive and polite hosts.

Céleste is a incredible host. She assured that checking in was as easy as possible and made sure everything went smoothly. The room and apartment was as advertised, the place is very clean and has everything you need to live comfortably. Céleste as an individual is very nice, welcoming, easy going and easy to communicate with. During my stay we had amazing conversations and a great time all around. I am so fortunate to have her as my host being new to Zürich. I am sad to leave however, I undoubtedly recommend staying with her if you’re able to.

Céleste's apartment was the perfect location for a course that I took at the ETH. It is only 10 min away from the main building and also close to Oberen Letten and city center. It is relatively clean and has everything you need for a week. I didn't meet Céleste in person but the communication was good. I would stay there again!

I had a wonderful stay at this flat in Zuric. The apartment was spotless, beautifully decorated, and had everything I needed for a comfortable stay. The location was perfect and close to public transport, shops, and restaurants, yet quiet and peaceful at night. Céleste was very welcoming, responsive, and provided great local tips that made my trip even better. I especially appreciated the little touches in the flat, which made it feel like a home away from home. I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Zurich and would definitely stay here again...

Rene’s apartment was all I hoped it would be: easy to get to (10 minutes by train from the airport); easy journey to the centre of the city, (Hauptbahnhof 7 minutes by same train); quiet area, clean and spacious apartment. Rene was always responsive to all my questions, and very helpful with advice about accessing places to eat. It’s worth making the Hauptbahnhof journey, but there’s a pizza place and supermarket a few minutes walk away from Rene’s apartment. Excellent value. Thanks, Rene.

Delphine’s apartment is tastefully decorated, very spacious and comfortable. It was very easy to get here, following the instructions provided. The bed was comfortable and the apartment is quiet. The apartment is on the second floor, so there are 43 steps and there isn’t a lift. There is a great little group of shops just along from the aparmtment - organic groceries and bakery. And the restaurant opposite it great too. You can walk into central Zurich, or catch the tram that stops at the end of the street. We would stay here again, if we were visiting Zurich.
Apartment is very well located and just as in the pictures. Flat is large and very clean

The room was nice and clean, and the host was kind. However, I probably wouldn’t choose this place again because of the location. It’s on a steep hill, which makes it difficult to reach, especially with luggage.

I loved this stay! It was clean, very nicely decorated, and there was a lot of sunlight & a nice kitchen, bathroom and living space. Jung Soo even let me check in a couple hours early because my flight had landed early! The only downside was that I booked it expecting to have the place to myself, but there was another AirBnB renter also occupying it at the time. It wasn’t a problem at all, both host and other tenant were very quiet, and hardly there-never really ran into them! But May be something to ask the host about before booking. Thank you Jung Soo for a nice stay! I appreciate it:)

Jack collected me at the airport and drove me to the apartment! You can't really improve on that for starters!! The apartment is a good size, there are supermarkets and a gym within a short walk and the tram stop is outside (that's the only downside - it's a little noisy but earplugs are great!!). Plenty of space, good amenities inside, big tv, great shower pressure. And you can run downstairs and catch a tram to the centre in 30 seconds!!!

Simple, unfussy and uncluttered, with a superb central location. A short twenty minute walk gets you right into downtown Zürich, or five stops from the tram stop literally outside the front door. Oodles of supermarkets within a few minutes walk makes cooking in the apartment trivial.

Amazing stay here at Jung Soo’s place. I reached Zurich late in the night but the whole place made it look like I was at home. Thanks for the home cooked rice and an amazing resting place before I headed out for another adventure ( thanks for the orange 🍊) . The place is a perfect fit for someone looking to escape the buzz of city and rewind the day later. Thanks! 🙏🏻
Had a great stay at Saschja's. Great location for getting into the city and at an affordable price for Zürich
Perfect for our group. Well worth the money and conveniently located. Would recommend

It held the 5 of us perfectly! Super spacious and had a bunch of great amenities and items in the kitchen and bathroom to use. The only downside was how far the walk was from downtown, about 25-45 min walk.

Yvette is such a warm and welcoming host. Her place is the cleanest space I have ever stayed in. Very clean very quiet and such a perfect location. I highly recommend if you are visiting Zurich. And, it is walking distance to the wonderful lakeside. As well as shops, markets, and bars.

Ideal if you happen to travel alone to Zürich. Everything went smoothly, Luiz is very helpful and cooperative. The Bus station is nearby. You might meet the lovely cat which welcomes and enjoys any petting.

Dimi very accurately described the check in process so it was very easy! Place was very clean and spacious, and it was nice to have the little terrace for sometime outside. Place is also very close to tram station which made it very easy to get around. Highly recommend staying with Dimi!

Fabulous location and environment. Dimi is very responsive during the stay to answer all kinds of questions we have. However, the parking space and washing machine is not as cited on the airbnb page. There is actually no parking space, but a public parking lot by the road, which costs around 2 CHF per night. While the washing machine is not in the house, but at the top floor and requires a deposit card, which is not being notified during the check in.

Our stay was amazing! The place was spotless and very beautifully decorated. Unfortunately the AC was not running when we went, but they provided a fan for us in the room. Anna was really helpful in answering all of our questions and accommodating an early check in which was much appreciated. Definitely recommend. :)

The apartment is very clean and cute, it’s all new and it has a full functional kitchen. It’s near the tram stop so it’s comfortable to move. Sonia is very kind and nice, and they reply the messages very quickly!

I recommend staying at Pablo and Sonia studio apartment. Pablo was very responsive and detailed for check in and other info about the area. The studio had everything we needed. Small kitchen, washer and close to old Zurich. I recommend this place. Only thing I do wish was available was air conditioning. However most of Switzerland does have air conditioning.

Sonia’s place was very small but done exactly what we needed- a clean place to crash for the night. All appliances are there and kitchen it perfect for cooking. However we did have issues with the shower as the head could not be adjusted and the water also leaked all over the floors as the water was not draining efficiently, to avoid this we had to put the water pressure on very low. Other than that, it is an convenient place to stay for the night after landing in Zurich.
Sonia and Pablo were amazing hosts and so accommodating! The place was very clean and felt at home. :)

Very clean little studio with everything needed for a short stay. The hosts left little candies and chocolate that added sweetness to our days. Convenient furniture choice for the size of the place. The shower door is slightly awkward with the sink placement, but the size of it is very much appreciated! Clear instructions were given for everything needed, and we had a comfortable stay as two. Also an amazing location to get to access public transit.
The place was very modern and clean. The only drawback was it’s not very close to the train station.

The villa is amazing! Featuring a huge garden with lots of flowers, herbs, strawberries, vegetables and big trees. Best location in walking distance to the lake and city center, but quiet and surrounded by nature. Pearl is an amazing host. She welcomed me with food & drinks. Breakfast and dinner were served every day and included in the rent. Pearl's great hospitality exceeded my expectations by far. Enjoyed playing with the dogs. I would love to stay there again if the internet connection was better.

Pearl is an amazing host. She welcomed me into her home and showed me around the house and the gardens. She explained that the villa is part of trusted houses and it is 200 years old. Unfortunately, the listing is not accurate and the building is not so clean.
Rafael’s place is perfect for a nice stay in Zürich! The apartment is lovely, and Rafael is always available if a question comes up. Highly recommended!
Great apartment in a great location. It was clean and looked exactly like the photos. The only thing to be aware of is that it’s located on the 5th floor with no elevator, but it wasn’t a big issue.

Very clean and very comfortable. We’ll decorated. With everything you need even laundry detergent (appreciate the thoughtful details). Very easy access to airport and all of Zurich from Banhof Wiedikon stop. Would happily stay here again!

Great location one tram stop away from the Opera House. Lots of restaurants and stores nearby, within short distance to the lake. The apartment has all the essentials you might want to spend a few nights, do some cooking, and relax after a day of sightseeing.

Great place to stay, they have everything you needed for a short trip! big plus is the washer/dryer. Place was neat, ive been travelling for a month now, this is the only place with no molds in the bathroom. Host was very responsive and helpful. Great location, few mins drive to the center. Lucky I found free parking at night from 8pm to 9am!

The location is excellent and perfectly situated to visit the city with public transportation within minutes. The apartment is nice and spacious. It lacked a bit of amenities but the host was responsive to our requests. Overall, nice place.
The place was super clean, minimalistic, spacious and recently renovated! It’s a short walk from the train station and downtown

Great private apartment and perfect location. Within 20 min walk to Old Town. Convenient parking spot (paid spot which was fine). We had to book and check in on the same day and Cher was awesome getting us situated with only 1 hour notice.

Staying with Ernst was a great experience - he gave such helpful and clear instructions on how to navigate the local public transit towards the flat, and was very communicative. The apartment was very comfortable and it was an amazing experience overall.

Fantastic location, very hot room when hot outside, and noisy throughout the night. But you are paying for location and it was as described. Great communication and staff. Thank-you. The one common room with Aircon, fridge and amenities was a blessing.

Quaint little place but great price. The shower was so great after a long day. We didn’t use the kitchen area and were out most of the days we stayed, so we just needed a place to rest. It was perfect for these reasons!! Also great communication overall! Very helpful.

Teresa's apartment is perfectly equipped and with what you'll need for a stay, very close to both Aldi and Coop as well. All amenities were in good condition and the apartment was also clean and organised. Walking distance from anything you need or anything you want to see, and it is a great price considering how close it is to Zurich centre. Apart from all positives, maybe I was just unlucky hence why I still give it 5 stars, on the weekend some of the neighbours can be noisy, and the apartment is on the ground floor next to the outside communal area so you can always hear people coming in and out of the building. However, Teresa is great and fast at communicating to solve any issues and will be in quick contact with the building manager on your behalf, so problems were solved. thanks!

Teresa is very responsive and accommodating. One inconvenience during my stay was that the internet was not working at all — I tried connecting with three different devices and restarted the router multiple times. However, she did refund the Wi-Fi fee, which I appreciated. The place is very conveniently located near the train station. That said, the apartment felt somewhat dark and stuffy. Since Teresa does not live in Zurich and may not be able to check the property regularly, some aspects of the apartment were not exactly as described.

Staying at Francesca's was wonderful. I felt right at home and it was perfect for a two week stay in Zurich. For those who do not know the area, it can be loud and active but the windows of the apartment were so good I barely noticed. The kitchen was stocked well with everything I needed for cooking. Bedrooms spacious and comfortable. I can't recommend her place any more. :)

I had a great stay at this place! The apartment was spotless and had everything I needed for a comfortable and relaxing visit. The location was perfect—quiet, yet close to the center. Paul was incredibly kind and responsive, making everything stress-free. Would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area!

Transportation is not an issue anywhere, easy to get around. The host is really cool to talk to and very helpful in all areas. The only downfall was that there was not a place for me to do laundry, other than that, everything else was great. overall, I recommend the place.

This place is clean and very central. You can walk to the city Center in 10 minutes and there is a market nearby to buy food. The communication with Antonio was easy and he is a nice person. Our experience was unfortunately not very good. The place smells like marijuana, there are no dark shade curtains and we had to wake up at 2:30am at night because the host came back little drunk and he had forgotten his keys. Also, the Wi-Fi connection is very bad; the rooter is too far away and the connection kept breaking up. The host said it is a temporary problem. Lastly, the mattress is very soft, it is like a sponge. In summary, the place is fine if you are staying a short time and it really didn’t give us a safe and comfy feeling.
The place was very close to the city center, Antonio is very nice and friendly, had a great time in his place.

Giuseppe was an amazing host and the place was absolutely wonderful! The location is perfect, the number 7 tram is right outside of the apartment which gives you access to everywhere you want to go! It was so nice to have public transportation so close to the apartment. The Airbnb was very clean and had everything you need. If I had to pick one thing to improve on would be the bed, however it was very minor. I recommend this place to anyone who is staying in Zürich and will be coming back in the future.

Nice one bedroom apartment in Zürich Wiedikon just around the corner from the S Bon station and located in central Zürich. Walking distance to everything including trains and tram. Would highly recommend for a single or couple. Great location and not a lot / no hotels in that area so the only way that you're going to find a place to stay is literally at an Airbnb.
As listed. Only concern was when we arrived at the door nobody answered, and Antonio didn’t respond to my messages. Eventually a friend of his let us in.

Beautiful and cozy place in a great location. Walking distance to touristic places and restaurants. It is next to a train road which makes the place super noisy in days and nights. Specially when you need to leave windows open in a hot day.
Great communication, instructions were well written. The place is very spacious and close by to public transportation.

We had a great experience staying at this airbnb! Accommodation was close enough to Zurich HB and was perfect for a family of four, extremely spacious and clean. The only small thing to consider is the flat being on the 4th floor and there’s no lift in the building. The hosts were extremely responsive and super friendly. They even arranged for a toddler high chair at short notice. Can’t recommend this place enough!

Lovely home to stay in! Very spacious and very clean! My family enjoyed our stay here. The only downside is having to climb up the stairwell with our luggages but other than that, all’s good! Will definitely book again when I’m in Zurich!

Our host truly offered an excellent experience during our stay. Their responsiveness was commendable, attending to our needs and inquiries promptly. The apartment was nothing short of delightful comforts. It was clean, cozy, and fully equipped with everything we needed. The location was conveniently situated near a train station, giving easy and direct access to the airport. What you see in the photos is exactly what you get - no disappointments there! However, please note for those with heavy luggage or mobility concerns: the apartment is located on the 4th floor and the building unfortunately lacks an elevator. Despite the small drawback, we absolutely loved our stay and would highly recommend this well-kept, homely apartment for its superb value and location.

We only stayed one night in this AirBnB. It was extremely clean and had a lot of local restaurants near by. It is a bit away from the tourist area but only steps away from the train station. Overall very satisfied with our short stay.
Location was fantastic with a train stop around the corner- also very close to a tram stop. The hosts were very fast to answer questions and were very helpful

Unfortunately I haven’t had the chance to meet Lea in person but the check in was very smooth, the room was spacious and nice especially the bed super comfy! The apartment is well-located in a quite neighborhood within short distance to the main HB train station and tram. It’s also near the main shopping area by foot.

I stayed at Lea’s place for 1 night, it was walking distance from the main train station and easy to find. Check in was easy, and the apartment is shared with 2 other people as there are 3 rooms. The bed was comfortable and the apartment was clean, basic room but I felt right at home and had everything I needed. The only downside is the walls are quite thin so you can hear the other guests in the flat.

Roman’s place is clean, quiet and very comfortable. The location is great, with the tram stop right around the corner, making it easily accessible from the airport and getting downtown. Thank you for a pleasant stay!

The studio itself is darling and there is so much to do around the area. We especially loved Hangs Vietnamese restaurant. That said, the apt complex is noisy and dingy, a shame given how cute the neighborhood is!

This was a great place to stay if your willing to take public transport or walk into downtown Zurich. It was noisy throughout the night as mentioned in the description and the windows needed to be open for fresh and cool air among the July heat but it was kind of the hosts to leave ear plugs. When I realized there was no ice cube tray the hosts brought one over for us which was very kind. Overall this was a good stay just be ready to commute and wear earplugs if your a light sleeper like me.

There's a lot I could say, but to keep it short, I don't know if I could ever find a better host. The room is huge, nicely-decorated, and impeccably clean. Everything was smooth sailing, thanks easygoing communication and amenities.
This is the second time I stay here and I would definitely also come back again :)
The airbnb is 15 min walkable distance away from Zurich HB. The supermarkets are nearby and the area is private and quiet. Got everything u need in this place. Would recommend this place!

Perfect stay, clean, ideal location, and great host! The beds were very comfortable, and the bathroom was luxurious. We couldn’t have asked for a more convenient location and high quality accommodation. The only down side was the sound from the upstairs apartment, which is unavoidable of course. Luckily there were fans available which provided white noise.

The place is nice, the kitchen, furniture and beddings, the area is walkable and near to the train station. The apartment is big. Would definitely recommend the place for those who’s coming to Zurich.

We had a comfortable stay at this apartment in Zürich. It’s about a 20 -minute walk with luggage from the main train station (Zürich HB), but there’s also a direct bus that gets you there in around 10 minutes, which is convenient. A couple of grocery stores are nearby, making it easy to pick up essentials. The apartment itself is spacious and well-maintained. The only small downside is that the curtain doesn’t block out much sunlight, but it wasn’t a problem for us since we brought sleeping eye masks. Overall, we had a pleasant stay.

Lovely and clean apartment in great location. The neighborhood is safe and right next door to the zoo. And walking to public transport was within 5 min. Perfect for getting around to explore Zürich. It is important to note the listed amenities because there is no TV in the apartment. The only thing that was really missing that should have been provided by the host are the required city trash bags. The apartment was very clean. And reasonably spacious. We had a very nice stay. I would recommend this property.
Great comfy little spot, super close to tram stop, big + pretty park, busy street but the place shut out the noise well and we had no trouble sleeping.

Helpful host who had an amazing apartment within 2 minutes of the train system in Zurich. Very helpful and appreciated the thorough binder of information as well as recommendations for local attractions.

We loved our stay in Zurich. The apartment was cosy, comfortable and an easy location for getting in and out of the old town. It was a well appointed apartment - the washing machine was handy and easy to use. The only comment would be the sofa bed is really only suitable for a smaller child - my 15 year old son who is quite tall slept on it and found it wasn’t very comfortable given his size. Overall a great apartment in a convenient location.
Very comfortable and pleasant brief stay at Yannick's! Excellent host in making sure and going all the way for guests. Highly recommend..

We had a great stay at Sven’s place, a stylish, spotlessly clean, quiet and well equipped apartment in an interesting part of the city. Transport was a breeze with a tram spot just around the corner. Sven made everything easy with great recommendations and guidance. We enjoyed the balmy summer evenings with windows open looking out over the neighbourhood. Definitely recommend.

A very friendly and adorable host she is! Enjoyed a lot while we did chit chat about various hints and she is so nice to us. She is a very classic and smart lady. Even she suggested us the best place to surface around and suggested the restaurant to have traditional food Wichita really worthy. We just stayed one night but if we go again then surely wanna go there and want to have some food made by her as she told us that she love to cook and she can cook for us. All these things gave us a family environment. A big thanks to her.

Central flat, good price. Bed comfortable, and flat has the basics you need. Small things like a heavier shower curtain and clean curtains in the bathroom - as well as a more accessible place for the keybox - would quickly elevate this listing.

Harm’s place was perfect for our family of four. Plenty of space to spread out. The riverside location was quiet and so peaceful. The apartment had everything we needed and was a super quick walk to the Manegg station and a small grocery store. Would definitely stay here again.

We stayed for 4 nights in Zurich to sightsee and enjoy the xmas markets. The place was easy to get too from central train station and from the airport. Plenty of trains and only one stop from the centre. Once there it was a short walking distance about 8 minutes to the flat. So very conveniently located and close to the city. Plenty of shops and restaurants around. The flat was very clean and spacious with all equipment as listed and internet available in working order. Kitchen fully equipped. We had a very comfortable stay and will return to the same place when we visit Zurich. The host was very friendly and responded promptly to our questions.

Overall, fantastic, modern rental in a great location. The layout, design, and styling was top notch. The ease of digital pincodes was great to avoid keys. The only two negatives are an over-reliance on digital (check in process requires full passport info) and the only way to get help is through what’s app and working through a digital navigation system. The place was often too warm even with the heat off and windows open. Would stay here again for the price and location.

We stayed in a one bedroom apartment and it was a good size for a couple of nights. However the kitchen was tiny, we moved lots of clutter from the worktops which helped give extra space but I wouldn’t recommend this apartment if you want to cook full meals. Additionally they advise not to use the hob as it can set the alarms off, so you are limited to what you can cook. Good for breakfast and salads but little else! The location was great, near shops, cafes and transport links. The noise mentioned in other posts didn’t impact us, the church bells added character and it was quiet throughout the night.

Small studio, as described! Loved the updated, modern furnishings and finishes. The balcony was spacious and a great spot to get some fresh air outside of the studio! We loved the location, was extremely walkable from the train and to bars/restaurants/shops/super-market. Checking in and getting in/out couldn’t be easier with the codes they give you! (Plus, there’s an elevator) Would for sure stay here again! Thanks Numa!

The location is central to so many things! It is walkable from Zurich HB or there is a tram stop within a half a block that can get you anywhere in the city. There are also several restaurants and a grocery store within a block or two. The building entrance is well posted and requires a security code to enter and another code to enter your individual apartment. It was very private and felt very safe. The apartment was very clean and the kitchenette was convenient. The space is perfect for 2 people. The apartment is in a business/residential neighborhood. You will hear people walking/talking below your windows, the tram coming and going, and the church bells throughout the day (the bells do not ring at night) but it just felt as if you were immersed in Zürich living culture.

The unit itself is pretty neat and comfy. Just a few minutes of walk from the nearest bus stop (Manesseplatz) makes it very accessible and convenient. However, the apartment does not have an elevator so if there are many luggages, it will feel a bit laborious to bring them all upstairs. Nevertheless, I certainly had a very pleasant stay here with my family, recommended if one is looking to stay over in Zurich.
Great location for price and easy to get to through public transit. Spotty wifi while in parts of the apartment

Filipa was very accomodating and the place was great for our 3 night stay. Everything was only a walk away or public transportation was accessible too. We rented a car and were able to park and Filipa also helped with navigating around the parking situation around Zurich. We went to Grindelwald and it was only an hour drive which was nice. Amazing location, the airbnb is a little dated however was very comfortable
