Filipa was very responsive. The place was as written. However, the walls were very thin, you could hear everything so it was quite loud. The entrance to the building and the laundry room are pretty sketchy- felt unsafe when entering but in the apartment and the surrounding area were safe. The pots and pans were sticky with residue so we needed to clean them first but it was okay. The space is very big which was nice. And the location is great- close to grocery stores, walking trails to city center and easy walkable to everything. We were traveling with 2 kids so it was nice and easy to get places from there and they provided a crib. All in all we enjoyed our stay there were just a Few things we didn’t love and thought others should know as well.
we enjoyed the stay very much. and look forward to go back to Blueground next trip
We only stayed overnight before a flight but the place was very well kept and clean. We only wish we could have stayed longer! Would come back for a longer stay in Zurich.
Great spot! Very clean and spacious Airbnb. The only thing that was an issue is that the entry and parking instructions were confusing so be sure to double check that the map matches where you are!

Really cozy place. Near to supermarket so that’s easy. Also lots of trams. Only thing I would say are the pillows on the bed. They are very very used and no longer have proper shapes. So an update on those would have been nice. Everything else was good

This is a GREAT unit outside old town Zurich. There was plenty of space for our group of 5 to sleep and spend time in the main living room. Plenty of walkable restaurants and metro travel as well. The host was always responsive and her recommendations were spot on. The only negative (for us) was that this unit is on the 4th floor (5th to us Americans) and there is not an elevator. I had to carry multiple suitcases up the stairs. If this isn't an issue for you, book it now!
Very nice apartment, like the description and the pictures in the advertisement. Great location!

Since I treated Thomas with sincerity and respect, I would have appreciated it if Thomas had made more effort to communicate with me clearly & face-to-face instead of badmouthing me. It was my right to change the reservation within the allowed period pre-defined by Thomas. From the review he left me, I could tell that he was inpatient when texting me on the platform. And When I found out that the check-out time was different than what I expected, Thomas assured me that it was okay to stay. However, he was just being ingenuous - I do not consider that as politeness - because by that time, I already cleaned up the room and could have left at any time. It is not okay to say ‘it’s okay’ but then badmouth someone afterward. I really tried to be respectful. Please do not be so hostile.

I recently stayed at this Airbnb and found it to be a spacious and comfortable spot. The place itself is quite nice, with ample room to spread out and relax. However, the amenities provided were quite basic. One thing to keep in mind is that the host is unavailable after 9 PM, so plan accordingly if you anticipate needing anything in the evenings.
The location is great - but the church bells can be bothersome as others have commented. To us it was just part of the Swiss experience - but you need the windows open and the bells are loud

We had a wonderful stay at Daniela’s apartment! It had everything we needed and was a quick walk to the tram to get anywhere in the city. Daniela has a lovely home in a quiet neighborhood and was super kind and responsive to anything that came up. Would definitely stay again!

Good location, comfy bed, plenty of hot water, room temperature was fine, very quiet. Our only complaint was that there was only one small set of shelves to place our clothes. There was no place to hang clothes, all closets and most cupboards were taped shut. Except for the large kitchen table, there were lots of decorative items on most surfaces that also limited our ability to place our things. We felt like we were moving in on top of our host. This was not a major inconvenience, however, and is something that could easily be remedied.

Overall, it’s exactly what we expected! Tania was easy to work with, and responded quickly to all our questions. The apartment was in great condition, and had everything we needed. There is a cute little co-op down the street, so we were able to get some groceries, and it was easy to catch an Uber into the main part of Zurich (approx 10-15min drive). As mentioned by others (so we were already mentally prepared), there is no ac, but there are fans in each room, and there is no elevator.

The host is really friendly and helpful. The room is basic and comfortable. The other flatmates were also very nice. The only downside for me was the hilly location. I arrived via the main train station (lines 13 or 46), and while the bus/tram stop is only a 10 minute walk from the apartment, it's a steep climb and I carried heavy luggage.

A good and clean place to live. Place and traffic are good and convenient. Price is reasonable. But the sound isolation in the apartment is not perfect. If you are easily awakened by noise you need to prepare earplugs

Willimien & Roberto’s apartment is really home from home. The communication was brilliant and excellent instructions making it easy to find. We loved the local area and especially being able to get to the river for an early morning swim and collect delicious pastries on the way back. We walked to the centre of Zurich, which may not suit everyone but an easy route down. Sadly we didn’t get to meet them but we really appreciate everything they did to welcome us to their home. Kay & Monica

Sonia and Pablo provided everything in the info pack (the only issues we had were because WE didn't read it properly first time round!) They were able to provide parking onsite (it's OK for a small car) The location is right next next to the tram which made getting in and out of the city VERY easy We were NOT at all bothered by the noise of the trams during our stay

Great place to stay! Easy tram ride to Zurich and they come often. Place was clean, had everything we needed even coffee pods for the nespresso, nice kitchen with fridge was super useful. Easy to access the condo with the key pad. We had slight trouble finding the place at first when we entered the adress on the gps but fairly easy to find. We are people that live in a city so the noise level was completely fine with us however they left earplugs at bedside if we needed them. The only thing I would add is a safe to place items like passports and stuff but I would totally recommend this place/come back!

Beautiful place, comfortable bed and great amenities. Decor was cute. Flexible easy self check in. They warned us of noise coming from the road and kindly provided ear plugs, but we didn't need to use them as the noise wasn't bad at all! Perfect temperature in the room. Walkable distance from the Hallenstadion which is where we were visiting. Recommend!

Angela's place was a great find. The location was very close to the train station, and we were fine getting there with our luggage upon arrival. The apartment is in the middle of restaurants and shopping and is quite lively with some street noise. The street noise was not a problem at night as it did quiet down. We were able to sleep well without disruption. One of the best things was the hosts, who were extremely welcoming and personable. If in the area again, we would definitely book this spot.

I’m glad I booked Angela’s place off of the reviews. I was a little weary of the photos, but they don’t actually do the place any justice. The apartment is bigger than it looks with 2 separate living rooms with a sofa bed in each and also a bed room which was the perfect amount of space for 4 guests. Excellent location.

Angela’s apartment above Rafael’s cafe is the perfect base to explore Zurich from. It was an easy walk to the historic district, river, university, shopping and restaurants. Transit and supermarkets are also very close. We felt very much at home in the large top floor apartment- there was plenty of space for our family of 4.

When we arrived, the place smelled fresh and brand new which impressed us. However, most of the essentials we needed for cooking were barely available. In addition, there was a lack of communication as some of our important questions went unanswered by the host which was frustrating for us.

Milan is wonderful and the flat was amazing! Milan greeted us and gave us a quick tour of the flat, along with some recommendations on exploring the area. His restaurant downstairs was wonderful with friendly service and good food (and gelato). The location was perfect to explore the local area, and quickly access transportation. The place was spotless and the decor was fun. The cherry on top was the rooftop terrace - the pictures don't do it justice. We spent an evening up there enjoying the city lights, church bells ringing, and a local artist playing beautiful music on the streets below; and mornings sipping coffee and enjoying a croissant. Wish we could have stayed longer - loved this place!

Great place to stay and a perfect host. Charming place with plenty of character. A vibrant neighbourhood and walkable to the city but the flat itself remains peaceful for an undisturbed night. I would gladly return, Mari made me feel completely welcome in her home and her recommendations for the city and the quarter were tip top.

Jules was a great host. Quick to respond. Let us drop off our bags early before checking in. Location is close to trains and tram station. Very hot when we visited. Beds and pillows were not the most comfortable but the space was large and the bathroom was nice.
Awesome location and very convenient with many amenities within walking distance. The apartment was perfect for my stay.

We loved Nico’s place! Nice high ceilings large rooms, not to many stairs, parking right at the front door, king beds and one of the bathrooms is just huge and beautifully redone and the shower was perfect (A rare find in Europe where most bathrooms are small). Really appreciated the racks/shelving in the rooms for storing things. The kitchen is small but for traveling/vacationing it was perfect.

Nico's place was great for a family to explore Zurich and surrounds - a short tram ride to the city centre, gave easy access to Zurich's sites as well to the main train station. Nico was responsive when we first arrived
This was a great place to stay. It was very nice and clean. The location was perfect and so easy to use public transit from it.

Location is great, very close to the tram/bus stop so it’s easy to get around. Unfortunately the neighbours upstairs were extremely loud on our first night, keeping us awake until 2am which made the start of our trip quite stressful. The apartment was also quite sparse, barely any toiletries and the bedding was very basic. The bedding that was put on the beds when we arrived was also damp. The kitchen is also tiny with very limited space to cook and the fridge in a different room. Overall it was ok for a short trip.
Nice place, next to the tram stop. Very nice and usefull for a family

Mario’s place is located very close to the central part of Zurich, we walked everything by foot. Mario was fast to communicate although we found we had to message him frequently due to issues. We felt like we needed to do the legwork as guests. The keys were collected from a different location, you have to instal your own blinds otherwise you’re totally exposed, we had to ask where the guess towels were and I touched wet used towels under the bed and check out instructions included us having to empty the bin and find a specific one on the street which I couldn’t find. I ended up walking up and down the streets with a bag of rubbish before I was told I could just leave it for the cleaners.

Anissa’s place is very convenient, it right close to the train station. It is spacious with open living room and kitchen. However, it is not professionally furnished and decorated. A decent bed and furniture would be needed; the window curtain there does not cover the whole window. There was a lots of books piled up on the walkway of the living room. Hire a professional decorator, add a decent bedroom set would go a long way to improve the property, and make the guest staying more comfortable. If furnished right, house / room could rent at higher price. As it is now, the bed we sleep on making noises when we turned our body.

It was great to stay at Dimi’s place! It was very clean and looked exactly as the picture. Only thing worth mentioning is to not walk to the place with luggage from Zurich HB. The map will say it’s only 10 minutes but the path to the Airbnb is a lot of uphill and stairs. Take the tram instead, and it is super close. Thanks Dimi, it was a pleasure
Great stay and great deal. Really enjoyed the apartment and the area was quiet at night. Would book again!

luiz is a very good landlord, he is very warm and friendly, the location of the house is very easy to find, luiz helped us to park the car and pay the fines, thank you very much, if I have a friend who is coming to Zurich, I will recommend luiz's house!
Great stay—super close to the Oerlikon train station. Luiz was super friendly and kind!
Michal's place was lovely! Had lots of space and was close to transportation to get into the city. Easy check in and check out.

Michał’s apartment was a beautiful place to stay, and was very conveniently located for public transport (tram and bus) into the city centre. It was also very convenient to get to the Stadium, which was the primary reason for our visit to Zurich. We had a great stay, Michał’s communication was great and we would definitely recommend this apartment to others!

Luiz was the absolute kindest host!! He made us feel comfortable during our stay and was always offering suggestions for things to do and recommendations. The only reason I'm rating our visit 4/5 stars is because our room was incredibly hot. A fan was provider which helped a bit but our first night especially was hard to sleep through. Other than that, super great stay and host! Thank you Luiz.

The apartment is very well located—close to the train station and surrounded by bars, restaurants, and grocery stores. Haoran provided clear instructions and was very responsive. Unfortunately, the room itself was quite disappointing. It is somewhat isolated from the rest of the rooms, requiring additional stairs and a terrace crossing to access. The bathroom is not en-suite nor private; it is across the corridor and shared with others. The room was cold, taking hours to warm up even with the heater at maximum. The duvet was too light for winter, and while a spare was available, I was unsure if the cover was clean.

Tania’s place is about 15 mins walk and 10 mins bus ride from Zurich HB train station which is very convenient. Amenities are new and stylish. Though during our stay in June there were lots of flies but we could not close the windows due to the heat.

Very nice place, super spacious and very clear guidebook. The floor was a little bit dirty (we found hairs not belonging to us, little bit of debris, etc.). The neighborhood is also not ideal, there were many strip clubs in the area and not many people. We were right next to the tram station, however, so had easy access to all of Zürich. Overall, very nice spacious place and responsive hosts, just issue with the cleanliness and the surrounding area.

The place feels right at home and it had everything you need to ensure a comfortable stay. We think the kitchen was perfect and the apartment itself was massive which adequate furnishings. The only issue we had with the apartment was the construction work next door. We stayed on the A side of the apartment and the noise started every weekday at 7am and stopped around 5pm. There’s also no elevator so be mindful if you have heavy luggage.

The budget Airbnb stay was a bit bare bones with minimal amenities, and guests should pack light due to many steps. The host was responsive, and the location was great, close to the train station and restaurants. However, the apartment lacked sufficient towels for two people. While it was surprisingly quiet, an issue with the AC arose on the last night, though a fan helped. For those on a budget, it's suitable, but others might prefer upgrading to a hotel for more comfort.
I enjoyed the stay but there is construction going on so be aware of that and the train can be loud as well. But overall love the place and would definitely stay again.

Apartment was clean and well appointed with clear instructions for check in, check out, wireless, TV, etc. Grocery nearby and the area is walkable. Public transportation everywhere nearby and is convenient. Never troubled with noise at all and slept well. We walked to old town and lake area for sightseeing and lake cruise. Took train to Lucerne for a day trip that was great. Recommend making Lindt factory tour reservations well in advance. Great home base we used for 3 nights. About 20 minute walk to the main train station where we arrived direct from Munich and left direct to Venice.

This apartment is exactly as described! It’s close to a train station that is about 2 minutes from the main train hub in Zurich. It was VERY clean and felt safe! The beds were comfortable and Cher was SO amazing to send recommendations for local places. The only downfall was the lack of AC (in June) so we had to sleep with windows open and heard all of the neighbors. Not a reason to not stay here but something to keep in mind! We loved having a washer and dryer to help with our clothes. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and being close to the train station so we could easily access the more touristy area of town but still at an affordable cost. Cher as a host made everything worth while for our 1 night stay! Thank you 💗

Great location! Easy to find and access! We enjoyed our stay. They accommodated us at the last minute and were pretty responsive. The only thing I would have appreciated if they had some extra blankets as it can get cold at night. We were pleased with a property and our overall stay. Great experience in Switzerland! Thank you for hosting us!

Had a wonderful stay at Cher's flat! It was very clean, cozy, and thoughtfully maintained, making it a perfect space to relax. The location is fantastic: just a short distance from the city center with public transport only a few minutes away, which made exploring Zurich super convenient. Check-in was seamless and user-friendly, making the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. Highly recommend!

Very very hot apartment with only 2 fans and no air conditioning. Requested additional fans Zürich was in the 90F during our stay and was told we could only have 2. They suggested to open the windows however this is a ground floor apartment that is right next to the main building entry and leaving the windows open when sleeping at night felt unsafe. If we did, in my opinion, anyone could literally just walk up to the window and come into the apartment. So we kept them closed and didn’t get any rest while staying here. I overlooked that they did not have air conditioning and would not stay in a place without it in the future as it was so so hot. Other than the heat, the place was clean and decorated nicely with IKEA style furniture.

We had a great experience! Cher and team was always very responsive to all queries. The place was very clean and appliances were in very good condition. Location does not have any parking near the entrance and with narrow roads it was little complicated when we arrived, but otherwise the location is good and the Zurich public transport is excellent! Cher also helped us in understanding street parking rules and had local recommendations!

This is a hidden gem in Zurich. 20 minute walk from downtown, train station and tourist areas. The place is pristine and comfortable. I appreciated the fast responses from the host and the amenities. It can get a bit loud in the evening time as it is located next to a busy side of town, but the blackout windows worked well to cancel out the noise.

Cher’s place is convenient to the city centre of Zurich. Had a small issue of bathroom lightning and had someone over the next day to fix it, great response time. There’s also paid street parking if you’re driving, however most of Zurich street parking limits to 2 hours, unless overnight.
the apartment is awesome. close to tram, groceries, and some restaurant. just about 5 minutes by tram to the main train station.
Super safe and convenient location. The condo itself was beautiful and made us feel right at home! Amazing space.

Spacious and well appointed apartment, in a great location for public transport, places to eat and drink, supermarkets etc. It was perfect for our family of 5, and a great base to explore the area. The host is very responsive to all requests. The only thing to note, is that the area around the apartment can be noisy, with nightlife and the tram depot. It did not bother us, but might be an issue if you are a light sleeper.

I think the only thong missing was ceiling fans in the bed rooms or better pedestal fans in the rooms. It did did get pretty hot inside the apartment and got cooler well into the night. Otherwise I was very happy with the stay and would definitely recommend the place

Thomas was a great host. We felt very comfortable in his place. He was pleasant and had good local recommendations for restaurants, etc. The only issue we had was with parking our rental car. It is VERY difficult to find parking in his neighborhood. We paid for the blue permit through the parking authority $30 chf (at Thomas recommendation), and then there were no blue spots. We ended up also paying for public Parking. So we paid for something we never even used. That was a bit frustrating.
Very accommodating host! Thank you Dragi for having us! The place was very clean and just like the pictures. Very comfortable to be in as well, almost felt at home. Would certainly recommend. 🙂

Dragi's place was exactly as advertised, we appreciated the good quality and amount of toiletries and laundry amenities. it's so clean and fresh. the ONLY drawback was the noise in the neighborhood, but that was indicated in other reviews part of being close to restaurants and bars is the behavior of patrons. very noisy, late (10 pm) until early (5 am) , by our standards, especially on weekends. if you close the windows you will be able to rest!
Two flights of stairs but there is a lift for bags. Close to nightlife and easy walk to train and restaurants. Place is clean and had all the amenities that we needed.

We had a great stay at Dragi's place! It was clean, comfortable and had the amenities we needed/listed. Easy walk to the train station, which was important for us. We have a young child, and while it was loud at night, it was not that loud. There are shades to pull down the window, which kept it dark and quieter. Would recommend!

We stayed at this apartment for two nights with family and had a great experience. The place was easy to find with clear instructions provided by the host, who was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. The apartment was clean and well-equipped with everything we needed. The only thing that would have made it even better was having a dedicated parking space. Overall, a comfortable stay—I’d recommend it!

The apartment is perfectly placed for exploring the centre of Zurich: peaceful yet within a few minutes of the lake, shops, restaurants and everything else that the city has to offer. Mika is a friendly, helpful and very responsive host.

The experience with the apartment went well, but when we left, the host accused us for stealing a remote control for the lighting. We explained many times that we will be traveling for a long time, and that a remote control is the last thing we need to have -- also it is a system that doesn't work in our country. Then, for future guests, ask for an inventory and take your time to check that all the remote controls (and items listed) are around. In our case, there was no inventory, but then we were accused for a remote control that we never used.
This flat is centrally located and very convenient. The neighbourhood is lively, but the noise dampening and blackout curtains were very effective.

What a lovely stop in Zurich! The place was even better than advertised and we loved the tiny little porch overlooking the goings on below. She was kind and helpful and honestly, it was everything we were hoping it’d be!

Loved this Airbnb. Very comfortable and the host was so kind and responsive. Loved that I could catch the tram right outside the apartment. I would highly recommend to anyone wanting to enjoy the beauty of Zurich.

Location is very accessible both trams and train and walkable to groceries store and fast food especially McDonald and Starbucks which my kids loves it,the apartment is very spacious ,tidy and very modern which I’m very pleased ,the host are both responsive and helpful and they make sure you feel at home at there place..given a chance to visit Zurich again I will definitely comeback to this place ,I’ll highly recommend the place to my friends and colleagues at work
Great location, next to the train station and transportation. Lots of bars and restaurants around as well

we stayed here due to convenience to train station - which is definitely the case. 5min walk from train, right above tram stops, and there are many grocery store options nearby. all the amenities were available and it was nice to have washer dryer and dishwasher! however i personally wouldn’t stay here for more than a night. as a group of girls we didn’t feel very safe - the tram goes right under and unless you close the blinds all the way, people outside (both from train station and on the trams) can see right inside. there were also stains on the couch which made us feel a little uneasy about cleanliness. last thing to note, there was a request to take a photo of the adapter before leaving otherwise there will be charges. i thought that was a bit weird and scammy

We had an amazing stay at Noelle and Tobias’s Airbnb! They were super nice and easy to communicate with, which made everything so smooth. The location is perfect, with everything we needed close by. The interior is both creative and beautiful, yet totally functional. We especially loved the private outdoor lounge space – a great spot to chill out. Unfortunately, our dog had to stay home this time, but it’s awesome to know this place is pet-friendly, which is pretty rare. We loved every minute of our stay and will definitely be back. Highly recommend!
Great host and the location is really close to the bus station. You can get to Zurich main station in around 30 minutes. Great deal!

The flat was really good, weel insulated, clean and everything needed to cook. The surrounding is not terrible and guess people whom knows a bit of Zurich would know. Although the room was good quality I have see good place in the center for same or even less fee. Communication was very good and proactive.
Very easy to navigate to from the train. Host was very helpful and responsive!

A very good stay at Strahinja's place. The flat was walking distance to the Letzigrund for a concert we were attending. Plenty of bars and cafés in the area for drinks and breakfast. The beds are comfy and the flat is larger than on the photos. It is functional -although it could do with a refresh with general wear and tear quite apparent. However, the hosts were really accommodating, left little snacks and coffee capsules, and generally very helpful. I do recommend to stay here. Thank you.

Had a lovely stay at this Airbnb! The bed was incredibly comfortable, and the kitchenette was well-equipped with everything we needed. Check-in was a breeze, and the place was spotless. Located in Zurich's vibrant red-light district, it felt both fun and exciting, with easy access to the city's attractions. The absence of air conditioning meant we had to keep the windows open, which made it a bit noisy at times, but the provided earplugs were a thoughtful touch we didn't end up needing. Overall, a great experience!

Airbnb was clean, easy to access and comfortable for our stay. Only complaint would be that the building uses central controlled AC, so it was still quite hot in our room. However with the provided fan and opened windows it was manageable.

We loved staying in Angela’s very stylish, spacious and peaceful apartment, a short tram ride from the centre of Zurich and close to bars, shops, restaurants and the lake. Angela was a brilliant host and we would love to stay in this apartment again some day.
Great place for the price. Clean and convenient check in. The only con was the area might be a little unsafe. But nothing to do with the Airbnb itself. Overall a great place to stay.

Location was close to the city center and within walking distance of Zürich Hauptbahnhof. However, Schöneggstrasse—where the place is located—can be noisy and busy, especially on weekends, due to the nightlife. The check-in instructions were clear and easy to follow. If your expectations are a clean apartment/bed, hot water, and a practical kitchen, I would recommend it.

Turan helped me with all the details to reach the location, was very helpful during checkin. But host was not very friendly and didn't provide lot of details regarding the sight seeing. Also the room was not great, all the rooms in the house was well maintained and good looking but the provided room was like a dumping place, it has lot of unused items in the berth and cupboard. It can be a good place for bachelor, but was not a great choice for family.

A great place to stay in Zürich. Our family of five enjoyed the surrounding area. I recommend reserving the parking with the owner, as street parking and parking garage are not very convenient. The place is in a great area with lots to do and easy access to public transportation. Fifth floor apartment, so be ready for stairs. No elevator, but chalk it up for a cultural experience. Would highly recommend, and would stay here again.
We had a wonderful visit. The location was close to public transportation and very clean/convenient. We would stay here again! Thank you!

Cher’s place is one of the best spots on Airbnb in Zurich! We only wished we could have stayed longer. It's conveniently located with easy access to everything. When we return to Zurich, we will definitely stay here again. We had a minor accident, and Cher and her team were incredibly accommodating, for which we are extremely grateful. The apartment had everything we needed, including an international charger. The only minor downside was that being on the ground floor, it was a bit noisy with tram sounds and the doors opening from outside.

Loved our stay here! The location was conveniently next to public transport and the apartment was very clean! We felt right at home. The apartment does get warm with the summer heat, but the host provides fans, which helped a lot.

Great apartment, very clean and well appointed! We needed a quiet place to stay after our busy days and were very comfortable at Thomas and Markus's apartment. The location was also great - just a few tram stops from Zurich HB, and the same from the apartment to the airport. It was clear that Thomas and Markus had put in a lot of thought and effort to make guests feel welcome and comfortable. Instructions and tips were also great. Would visit again!

Thomas and Markus are wonderful hosts who are prompt in their communication. They also provided me great recommendations around the city and the place. The apartment is exactly as described with everything required for a comfortable stay along with being squeaky clean. The patio is a perfect addition to enjoy a morning coffee :)

We had a great stay and would definitely recommend this place! The apartment was easy to find and check in was super smooth. Everything was very clean, modern, and thoughtfully furnished and decorated. We felt right at home from the moment we arrived. The neighborhood was also fantastic, with supermarkets, restaurants, a cinema, and everything else you might need within walking distance. We especially loved being so close to the river, which was perfect for cooling down on hot summer days. Our host was very responsive and incredibly accommodating throughout the stay. Overall, a really lovely experience!

Super cute little stay right in the center of the city. Other reviews complained about the noise but for anyone that’s stayed or lived in a city it’s normal city sounds. Saturday night had a lot of people out and about later, but I figured they were just enjoying their night. Super hot shower and really close to a coop for food and the train station. Definitely a great experience!

one of the best airbnbs I have ever stayed at. bed was comfortable, having AC was amazing, the kitchen has everything I could possibly need to cook, it was amazing! convenient location between 2 bus stops, an easy wall to the main station, and a grocery store next door. Andreas was very helpful and responsive too!
We enjoyed staying at the Ariana's place and hope to be able to stay there again in our future trips to Zurich.

We only stayed 12 hours (one night), but the sign of a good place is that we felt bad for leaving so soon. Sergio was very responsive and kind, he helped us check in and gave us our space despite an early morning departure. Great location. Cozy place. Comfortable bed. Can't ask for more.

Very well designed apartment: stylish, functional and creative. In a quiet area, but still close to the center and the lake, easily accessible on foot or by tram (stop a few meters away). Very rich in services and facilities, for cooking, cleaning, etc.: nothing was missing. Great courtesy of Jordane: always quick to respond, precise, on time. She comes personally to provide keys and explain all the features of the apartment. Overall, great and perfect experience!

It is a clean, modern, interesting apartment in an incredible location. Jordane was very friendly, generous, and kind. The challenge is that it is on the ground floor. Being on the ground floor does not present a problem, generally speaking; however, on hot summer nights, you feel a level of vulnerability because you have to leave the windows open and sense there is a security risk as the windows open directly to the street or a patio that has no significant wall around it. If the property added a portable air conditioner and somehow found a way to provide more security around the patio, it would be ideal.

Highly recommend this place!! We were staying at Brigitta’s place for almost a week, the travel to Zurich central is so easy, to/from airport is just one tram away. The place is super nice, just as described, we felt right at home and she’s very responsive. When we Switzerland again, will definitely book this place again :)

The house is beautiful, however you have to be aware that the parking lot could be a problem if you rented a car. Also, the host is very reactive but not flexible at all. I asked for an additional pillow because mine was too soft, and they didn’t allow me to have an extra one because “the number of pillows reflect the number of guests in the reservation”. Not very nice to say. We are talking about a pillow, not gold.

We loved this apartment. The first thing that made an impression on me was how fantastically clean it was. Really outstanding in this area. Lots of nice touches like new washing up implements, lots of coffee pods (although we didn’t use them, I know lots of travellers who would be very happy at this). It’s in an excellent location with shops and transport really near but it is so quiet indoors. The hosts are extremely quick to respond to any query even late at night. Very impressed by their customer service.
All according to the ad. The apartment was super silent, perfectly located and the kitchen has everything one needs.

I booked the day before travel, so got a discounted rate which made this very good value. Excellent accommodation, and well presented. It’s cosy, but has everything you need, and it’s handy to have a small kitchen, especially if you’re staying for a few days. It’s conveniently across the road from a well connected station, with good small supermarkets that are open on Sundays.

The Airbnb was bright spacious and right in the middle of everything. the rooftop terrace was stunning and the couch and furniture were very comfortable. pillows were ofhigh quality. location is unbeatable less than 10 minutes to the train station and easily walkable to all of Zurich. right next to an aldi and a busy street but quiet up above it all Host was great at quickly answering questions once we were there. if your staying for a bit longer you will have to refill the toilet paper but the Aldi is literally next door so not too much hassle.

Very nice and cozy home - not a rental place, but the actual home where the family lives. House is very clean, with fully equipped kitchen and comfortable beds. We used "perks" that most rental homes would probably not have, such as a printer, a piano, and full selection of spices in the kitchen! The location is not close to city center, but a short walk to the tram station - door-to-door all included, 18 minutes to Paradeplatz.

Marc's apartment was very cozy and the beds were very nice. He was very clear with the directions and had all my questions answered already before me needing to ask. The only downside was the shower which is a little high up to get into and there looked to be some kind of mold in the top right of the shower wall. Overall great stay and enjoyed Switzerland alot!
Very cozy and great place to stay. All the accomodations are available. Its great location as well. We wnjoyed the stay alot.
Amelie was very kind from the moment we inquired about the apartment. Location was great, near Enge train station. Only 15 minute walk to main shopping street. We loved our stay and would stay again.

At first, the unit seemed a bit costly but the photos promised an amazing place. The reality turned out to be even better and exceeded my whole family’s expectations. It was worth every penny. We had an amazing time so much so that we felt more inclined to spend more time in the flat rather than go out and explore beautiful Zurich.

Our family loved our stay at this place and our trip to Zurich! The location was convenient and only a very short walk to train stops, and a 15 walk to the ferry stop. It had plenty of space for us. We didn't get to enjoy the outside patio area during the heat dome, but the views were as advertised during our morning luften. Amelie was a great host and very responsive.

The apartment is situated in a great location! Train station and main attraction are super close. Easy to find, in a safe neighborhood. The room is as described, cozy and all. Angelo is very friendly and always ready to help.

Nice and cozy place. Clean and simple one-room apartment with a built-in kitchen. Walk to the busy Old Town in about 20 minutes, but the tram goes right to Franco's place, too. Highly recommended for those planning to have business at the ETH, which is within walking distance.

The place was very well connected to the Public Transport. Well kept. However, it is to keep in mind on which floor you are getting the accommodation as it may be difficult carrying heavy luggage to third floor as there are no lifts. Lighting may be improved in living room and bedroom. Check-out timings are non flexible as requests for slight delays are not accepted.

Dimi's spot was the perfect stay for my family and I! Quiet area and not too far from the main city center. It was also pretty hot when we stayed but each room had a fan and he even gave us an extra one!! Appreciated the quick responses! Thanks Dimi!

SO SPACIOUS! Perfect for 4 couples or a large family. Our “adult children” noticed “no tv” but isn’t that we vacation is for? Haha This apartment is stunning and in a very easy location to walk to the historic part of town and restaurants. And as always, the top of my list is a comfortable bed. These were lovely after a long day of sight seeing. We would stay here again!

Many’s place was a great stay! Very walkable from restaurants and the train station. Staff members at many’s place were so welcoming and friendly. The only thing we found ourselves needing was a few more kitchen utensils/supplies.

Exceptional stay in a lovely city! It was refreshing to see that a Super Host actually upheld the standards that we’ve come to enjoy over the years. Massimo warmly welcomed us and gave us a tour of the place which was helpful. The place is pristine, fitted with everything we needed for our short stay and the storage space is abundant. The hair dryer is one of the best I’ve come across in our Europe stays and very much appreciated! The location is also terrific and within walking distance of everything. We opted to walk from the train station with large suitcases which we managed however I highly recommend asking the Super Host for a better route that doesn’t require stairs to get to Many’s.

Charming stay in a lively location, but be mindful of the heat. This was a cute and well-located place! overall, we enjoyed our time here! Just a heads-up for future travelers: during warmer months, the ventilation can be a challenge. Even with the windows open, it stayed quite warm inside, and the street noise made it hard to keep the windows open overnight. If you’re visiting during cooler weather, this likely won’t be an issue. With some improvements to airflow, it would be an even better stay!

The apartment was very cute. There were a lot of options for restaurants close by. The building seems to be very old and we could hear everything, from the upstairs neighbors coming and going, to people outside being loud all hours of the night. The curtains did not keep the street lights out so it was difficult to sleep but the bed was pretty comfy. I think adding some blackout curtains would help.

I recommend staying at the loft for short and long visits. Good location, nice surrounding environment with convenient public transport. Clean and green area. Solid, new building and good community areas for guests

I've decided to book Charles's room after reading the comments on Airbnb. And everything was same with the comments. Charles and Karina is so friendly, helpful. Home was really really always clean. Location is so closer to the train station. In the morning it's lovely to start the day by hearing birds singing..by the suggest of Charles i had a good programme. Thanks for their hospitality. If you want to book it, never have doubt just go ahead for your comfortable accomodation.
Cleaning was not very good and the house was cold…

Thanks Marcin for your hospitality during our stay in Zurich recently!! We thoroughly enjoyed it's surroundings and city 👌. It's a 2 rooms neat & clean top floor apartment facility. The facility is well maintained. It's well connected to the public transport system - bus station 🚉 around 200 meters. Has grocery stores and restaurants around. Marcin - your timely help and timely communication is appreciated 🙏! Thanks 😊. We would like to visit you again!!
Very comfortable apartment for my family of 5. Check in was very easy, apartment was clean and conveniently located to the tram stop. Quiet at night. Highly recommend!
Alessandro was very cooperative and accommodating. The flat is very nice and comfortable. We had everything we needed. The surroundings a bit noisy but the windows double glazed

The penthouse was absolutely fantastic, and we had an amazing stay. It was very spacious, modern, and beautifully designed with an open-plan layout. The three bedrooms were perfect and comfortably accommodated six people. The view was incredible, and the balcony was a wonderful place to enjoy breakfast or a meal outside. The location was excellent, close to shops, restaurants, and many amenities, making it easy to explore the area. The owner was very welcoming, friendly, and supportive throughout our stay. Everything about this penthouse exceeded our expectations, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, spacious, and well-located place to stay.
Location is great！The apartment is bright and spacious. However, there are no cooking oil and salt in the kitchen as the web site stated.
Demi was a great host, quick to respond all the questions and very respectful and kind. Apartment was clean and spacious. Would come back again!

Clutter free base. Three stops on train to the centre of Zurich. Apartment is clearly only used for rental so not homely but that was ok for us. At first we were disconcerted by being dropped by taxi in a car park and all the concrete. Then realized it’s just the architecture here - the area is really nice and feels safe. Easy access to centre and host very responsive. Wonderfully fresh white bed linen and towels
Very clean and spacious!!! Loved the location as it was peaceful and quiet neighbourhood!! Would highly recommend!

The apartment was clean airy and bright. The checking in was absolutely seamless as the instructions were clear. It is very close to the Central and Zurich HB however in a residential area so peaceful. The Sonneggstrasse tram stop was few metres away. There were many restaurants and eateries in a walking distance. Overall we had a comfortable stay.

Olaf's place was very accommodating and well situated in a walkable distance to the city center, main sights and public transport. The communication with the host was very easy and friendly, he was also flexible about the times of check-in and check-out.
The place is perfect if you are looking for a spa experience and relaxing on weekend. The room is perfect for two but small. But the facilities are on point. I will come back soon

Great apartment at a pleasant neighborhood. The access and Dimi instructions for check-in was great (as usual, since I stayed in some of his other rentals in Zurich). The apartment is spacious and has almost all the amenities needed for a short trip. The only downside was that the shades are too old and won’t completely close. I’m used to sleep in dark, and outside light was waking me up every day at 5am 😅

Super nice and clean Airbnb in a centrally located area, very quiet for the area. I will say the only downside would be you are in the addict, 3 flights of stairs, and short ceilings (probably 6.5 tall).

This apartment was beautiful, clean, well-equipped, and in a great location. There were 3 of us and we fit comfortably. Nora is kind and very responsive. She gave us recommendations and helped us at all times when we needed it. It was an easy walk to Zurich HB train station, perhaps 15 minutes. It's close to good restaurants and shops on Badenerstrasse. The only issue was the clothes dryer in the basement didn't dry our clothes, so we had to hang them up, but that wasn't a problem. I definitely recommend this apartment!

Nóra is a great host. She is kind, flexible, helpful and quick to respond. The apartment is very nice. It is spacious, clean and well equipped. The area is nice. It is full of life but still calm and friendly. The communications are very good with a tram stop close by. Would easily stay at Nóras place again.

This was honestly the nicest and most comfortable Airbnb we’ve stayed in. We felt completely at home. Hemerson was super sweet and always quick to reply whenever we had a question. The place is a little outside the center, but with the tram stop just around the corner, getting around was super easy. Everything was just perfect , we can’t wait to come back soon!

Clean and spacious with a balcony to boot. Beautiful sunflower fields, peaceful forest trails and the delicious Ziegelhütte gastropub are just up the hill and tram 7 is right across the street for easy transportation in and out of the city center.

Overall the place was great and excellent value compared to alot of other listings. The location was ideal and we went to a local restaurant just 3 min walk away from the place and the food was amazing. However, there were left over party balloons left in the room and the couches were stained and some glasses were still dirty in the cabinet. Cleanliness could have been better.

The apartment was very pretty and well equipped but the walls were too thin, Daniel and the neighbours seemed to have an issue with the noise even though we were speaking at very low volumes. Moreover, Daniel’s tone on text was rude and intrusive, we did not appreciate that.

The place looks exactly as in the photos. It was easy to find and Daniel was very responsive. There were a few cobwebs and spiders when we arrived which was unpleasant however Daniel told us that it is due to the house being close to the forest. The place could do with a few more utensils and condiments like sufficient salt and pepper. Overall the stay was good, magnificent view of the forest and nice to get to the city centre.

Overall, it was a satisfying stay. The apartment was spacious and perfectly suitable for up to six people. The bedrooms were large and had wardrobes. The kitchen was also good. However, the owner should consider a few points about the apartment. The bathroom needs renovation and the tiles should be replaced, as in some areas there were black spots resembling mold. The showerhead was positioned very low, making it impossible to stand while washing. The heating system was very unclear, and there were no instructions on how to use it. The bedrooms did not have radiators, but they were not cold either. The main entrance door to the building was very difficult to open, and we had to ask the neighbors for help each time. Access to shops and the city center was very good.

This stay was amazing! Andrea was truly a great host and communicated very well. She even let us store our luggage at the airbnb before our check in which was very kind of her to do. The location is very close to public transportation and everything about it was perfect. I highly recommend you stay here during your trip to Zurich!

Main complain is that apartment was not cleaned very well. There were hair on the floor that is not fine but may happen. But there were hair in the bed. For me its not acceptable especially for that price. Another item that is not covered in the description is elevator. Its small. Very small. Though it is said for 3 people it can contain only one normal-sized man and a small suite case. But if you have a stroller it does not work. All the rest is good. Apartment is in the very quite neighborhoud. Good supermarket (coop) is 3 minutes walk. City center is 30 minutes walk. Kitchen has all dishes to cook. Even fridge is a normal size. Host is very responsive

Thank you so much Andrea for your wonderful hospitality. From the moment we arrived, everything was smooth and easy. Your clear communication, fast responses, and warm attitude truly made our stay comfortable. The apartment was spotless, well-equipped, and felt exactly like home. We really appreciated the small details you prepared for us, and the location was perfect for exploring the area. We couldn’t have asked for a better host. Thank you again for making our trip even more enjoyable. Highly recommended, and we would definitely stay here again in the future! 🤍🇨🇭

me and my family had fantastic stay at this AirBNB. The place was exactly as described-clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully stocked with everything we needed. The check-in process was seamless, and the host was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout my stay...

Perfect location steps from the Kunsthaus museum and charming old town with all the cafe's and shops to explore. The apt was very clean and the huge windows opened up to cool down the place without air condition. the apt is small but charming and the bathroom show works well. The only neg thing was the wifi didn't work when I was there she said she tried to fix it but it never worked. I would highly reccomend Dimi's place
Nice, bright and clean apt. Very close to all the central locations - lake, restaurants, bars, universities, etc.

between the smart lock with app, keypad, and physical key, we found the place very easy to get in and out of. it's along Zurich T9 tram line that goes from downtown (Zurich HB (the main train station)) to the airport, which made our arrival and departure very convenient. all the furniture was rustic (in a good way) and cute, and the two salt lamps by the bed were very nice. kitchen is nicely stocked, but there isn't a ton of counter space. the place is close to a tram Depot, (the host Sonia is transparent about this before she confirms booking, and ear plugs were provided) but it wasn't loud enough to bother me. the window shutters (blinds?) close all the way, you just have to keep turning the Crank :)

Well located place - just 15 min away from the city centre by tram. Very clean apartment and great spot for a city trip in Zurich. Sonia is very quick in responding in case you have any questions. As a suggestion, I would like to add that it would have been nice if we had been allowed to enter the apartment a little earlier than 3 pm, as it was already ready but the code was set for 3pm sharp.

100% recommend this place! Great location! Right next to a tram station so it was super easy to get around. The apartment is very clean and comfortable. There are a lot of nice things to do nearby but the apartment is very quiet in the evening. Matteo and Margherita are wonderful hosts! They made me feel like home! The third host Legy is an absolute love bug. Be aware! He is also a con artist! Don't trust these cute eyes when he tries to convince you that he needs a second dinner. If you are visiting Zurich, this is definitely a great place to stay

Such a gem especially in a place like Zurich! The room was clean, spacious and comfortable, the hosts communicated well, the location is just perfect for all possible activities in Zurich but the main highlight is the sweetest and most sociable cat ever! Will definitely book this place again when back in Zurich, thanks for everything!

Franks flat is a quiet neighbourhood about 30 minutes from Zurich by public transport. It is 15 minutes from the airport by taxi. ( 50 euros ) It was as appears in the photos, comfortable and quite spacious. The kitchen is well supplied with plenty of crockery and cutlery etc As others have commented some shampoo coffee pods etc would be nice ( but as others had commented we came prepared even though we were only in Zurich for 48 hours !) The parking is not easy in the vicinity. But luckily we only needed parking overnight. And Switzerland is a very expensive country for visitors !! Thank you for a lovely stay.

Clean, large and simple home in a quiet location. It’s about a half hour walk from the center of town, which is perhaps the only negative. This is compensated for by the very close access to the tram line. The host was instantly responsive and I had no issues with check in or check out.

Not the best communication before arrival I wrote twice on the platform and sms without any answer and had to phone once we arrived. Very clean room but the real problem and what needs to be mentioned only for smoking people who like to smoke all the time, the smell of cold tobacco was really horrible. Even with opened windows it didn't go away, the neighborhood is very noisy even very late so it was definitely difficult to sleep. It's more like an hotel with many rooms and cleaning people staff in the morning than the home of someone. Only advantage as the price are crazy in Zurich it's relatively reasonable and very clean except the horrendous smell of cold cigarettes. So OK for smoking people on a short budget I guess
Great location and as shown in the description.

Amazing stay with a very kind and accommodating host! I loved the location and enjoyed relaxing on the balcony. The host went above and beyond to make my stay comfortable. I will definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place!

Exactly as pictured, very good and friendly communication. The place has plenty of amenities and lots of closet space. It was extremely clean. There's a nice balcony, and the doors to the bathroom and living room also have a lock for extra safety/privacy. There's two elevators in the building. You're allowed to leave any leftover unopened food for the cleaners. The only two downsides: - the self check-in is very handy, but the key box is a few minutes walk from the apartment, which means a slight climb with your luggage up a hill. Only a minor inconvenience, but it would have been good to know beforehand - the apartment had no oil, salt or pepper, coffee or tea. Thank you for the pleasant stay!
Convenient location meaning easy to get around the city. The facilities were clean and kept tidy regularly but the room did have a cigarette smell constantly.

Great stay! Very comfortable beds and the apartment had everything we needed. Although the place isn’t very large it’s a comfortable stay, in a great location. Only thoughts - there is no air conditioning but there are fans and the windows do open. Additionally the street is very loud outside and with the windows open it would definitely be challenging for some to sleep, but was just fine for us. Definitely recommend this place!

Clautilde was a great host, always very responsive with quick and clear communication. The apartment was very cozy, clean and tidy and just what we needed. The only downside is that it was very noisy. Between the bars on this street and road construction that started around 6am, there were not many quiet hours at night. This extra noise may just not be avoidable for being in such a central location, but something to know depending on how lightly you sleep. Overall, still a great stay, great host, and great location!
The place had everything we needed and was in a good location, walkable to many of the sights and the main train station.
Comfortable room and bed on a peaceful street. The check-in was smooth and easy.

Room was perfect for our one night stopover in Zurich, close to the station, clean functional shared bathroom and flexible for checkin time. Interior decoration is functional rather than hotel standard and fortunately for us the Jazz club opposite wasn’t loud on a Monday evening but the complimentary ear plugs suggest this isn’t always the case.

Typical European hotel. Nothing special, you’ve remodeled all the charm out of it. Please start copying US hotels and add USB ports so we don’t have to purchase an expensive converter and haul it around with us. The chance to do laundry was a plus, but other than free coffee, no breakfast was available

A very big apartment located in a small street close to the lake, not far from Stadelhofen. It has everything you may need, including a washing machine and a dryer which is a huge plus in Zurich and a big balcony. The place is very pleasant, quiet and comfortable. It is clean and well maintained on a high standard, like one can expect in Switzerland
Appartement was wonderful and the host was always reachable, absolutely perfect!

I had a wonderful experience at Daniel's property. He provided clear instructions for the check-in process, making it very easy to settle in. The location is excellent—just a 5-minute walk to the train station, 3 minutes to the nearest bus stop, and about 7 minutes to the closest tram stop. The bar on-site was a delightful addition to my stay. I highly recommend this property to friends and travelers in the area. Just a note: there is no TV, which I initially overlooked 😂. However, this turned out to be a positive aspect of my trip, as it encouraged me to disconnect and enjoy my surroundings.
We had a wonderful stay at Daniel's Airbnb, the apartment was spotless and the view was absolutely stunning! Everything was just perfect, I highly recommend it!

I really enjoyed my stay in Stephanie's apartment. You will walk in and know that you're stepping into someone's home and I found that quite charming. The location is excellent, steps away from train and tram stations, but I most enjoyed walking along the lake front to get into Old Town. You're also near some good cafes and a co-op for groceries along Seefeld. The apartment itself was spacious with a big bathroom and kitchen and the building is really quiet. The only slight downside for us was the largest bed was a bit uncomfortable and we probably would have appreciated two extra towels. Minor issues - I would stay here again!

Check-in was smooth and the location was convenient, with easy access to the tram. However, the overall stay was disappointing. We also noticed spider webs in several corners, and basic amenities like shampoo were not provided. For the price paid, we expected at least the essentials to be in place.
Spacious and bright apartment in a green residential area not too far from the main station. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.
Not too many complaints. Place is about a 15 minute walk into the center city but there is really not much around the apartment. Place was clean and fit 6 people well. Check in very easy.
Stayed for a short period and I loved how close it was to everything. I walked everywhere and the neighborhood was fabulous. Giancarlo answered all my questions and was very helpful.

The space was perfect and exactly what I needed. I think it was a great price for the location. Walking distance from just about everything but several stops/stations nearby if you need to take the public transportation.

Great spot from a local apartment management team. It’s a quaint space with everything you need. It was difficult to get air flowing through the apartment, but the free laundry and stocked kitchen made up for it!

Excellent, clean and spacious accommodation. Relatively price friendly parking, public transport stop right in front of the house. Very good communal accommodation. Thank you, I will be happy to come again in the future.

The place is great. Close to Tram stop. It’s a studio apartment, so the space is small. One issue was that there is no Air conditioning and in summer, it can be a little distressing. However a fan was available and this softened the blow of the heat. Dimi communicates, at her own pace. Overall a good place that’s cheap and close to trams.

Alex was an excellent host! He gave us clear directions for a flexible check in and even met us at the team station to personally walk us to the property. He provided us great recommendations and made our stay special. I would love to stay here again. Highly recommend!

The apartment is very nice, in a quiet neighborhood, close to the Sbahn station (10 min for the HB). Rooms are wide, clean, well furnished. Kitchen is well equipped. It was easy to interact with the manager, who was always polite and proactive. One mishap: they left the wrong key in the mailbox, so we had to wait for the right key for a while. One small problem: the dishwasher broke down, but the manager immediately sent the technician to identify the problem. Suggestion: provide written instructions for garbage disposal. Each country has its own rules, so it should not be assumed that guests are familiar with Zurich garbage rules. I think it is a very good choice for a short stay (we spent 8 days) in Zurich.

The place was very clean and generally comfortable.The kitchen was well-equipped with everything we needed, including a coffee maker and toaster. The beds were comfortable, but the pillows could use improvement. The property was warm and had nice towels. Access was easy, and it was quiet overall. The instructions provided were clear and Lina was a great host.

We enjoyed our stay in this 3 bedroom apartment. We visited Zurich on the hottest day of the summer (92 F), so the first night was a bit warm without air conditioning. But the apartment was everything we could hope for and large enough for 6 people (4 adults and 2 teenagers). Nico was very responsive to our questions and helpful.
My flight got cancelled the day before, I informed them that I won’t be there but they never responded. Unreliable and unhelpful host.
the place is a perfect location but the rooms are under my expectation for 100 CHF, the bathroom and room was not clean

Everything is very good, especially for the price in Zurich. The flat is clean, easy to access and near a train station. The only little thing is that sadly during our stay there wasn’t not hot water, I don’t know if it was just during our stay or it’s always like that. Everything else is great !

Pascale was so friendly and responsive to any requests from my side so I felt really comfortable and safe. The place has good connection to city centre. In the kitchen you gonna find everything you need. Huge bedroom, plenty of space. Washing machine was a life saver. Happy to choose Pascale as my host and next time will do it again. Thank you

The host was incredible and communicated very well. The place was clean, easy to find, and very centrally located in a fantastic location. However, please note that there is no shared living space, which makes it nearly impossible to hang out with your party. It is just two bedrooms, a kitchen, and two bathrooms. Additionally, the showers and tubs are difficult to get in and out of, even for young and healthy individuals. I am 5’10” and the side came up to my mid-thigh. There is a built-in seat that makes it very difficult, as you have to stand in one spot directly under the water. Otherwise, it’s a great place to lay your head and the host is fantastic.

Checkin was marvelously clear and easy thanks to Dragesa. However the flat was much smaller than the pictures showed, therefore than expected. It was a little claustrophobic. One of the 2 bathrooms didn’t have a sink to wash your hands. Everything needs maintenance and a good refurbishment. The owner should charge half the amount of money it asks. All in all, the experience was great thanks to Dragesa!

Quaint and cosy 2 bedrooms, no lounge area, functional kitchen, 2 bathrooms, one as an ensuite the other separate. The only difficulty is that the showers are inside the baths and the bath ledges are at least half a metre high. I stand at 5 foot and it was tricky to get out, easier to get in as there is a raised ledge. Apart from that, we really liked this accommodation

A very traditional Swiss style dwelling, photos reflect the flat. It didn’t occur to us until we arrived that there’s no living room or common area but they do provide a few small tables where you can eat - one in each room. It’s compact and old school, but that’s Swiss style dwelling. Totally peaceful at night to sleep but a lively neighborhood during business hours w lots of hustle and bustle in the area. Right next to tons of stores and food, but you need a reservation at least 3 days ahead to be sure to secure a seat at nice or well situated adjacent restaurant. If you are plant based, clean eating or GF check out “pret a manger” (ready made) or “MIGROS” (grocer) to stock the flat.

Great location to the HB and the Bahnofstrasse, and the Coop. Home was comfortable after we got past the expectations of a bigger home (the walkway was cramped and small, and the main door would block the person who is trying to exit from the other room). While the house is cute and cozy and full of character, the other toilet before the kitchen is very small and cramped and you need to be very careful when exiting from the bath tub.

We spent two months in the apartment and we loved it. It’s not a typical Airbnb place because it’s a real personal space and it feels like that with all its ups and downs (mostly ups). The location is amazing for longer stays and even for shorter ones- it’s the best part of Zurich by a long shot and the trams to the center take 5-7 minutes and pass every 2-3 minutes. We would definitely recommend it for any single person or a couple who wants to experience true Zurich and it’s charm and calm

We found the apartment to be well located though finding it the first time was a little challenging. Guests should not give up. It is located near a large mall and two grocery stores for easy access.The bus and train stops were very close. It is very spacious.

John’s flat is even better than the pictures and previous reviews describe. Really great easy location, relaxing apartment, fantastic host. Would happily stay here again if I’m back in Zurich. Appreciate John’s responsive communication, care and attention.

Rafael's place was beautiful, compact and close to grocery store, Coop. Also walkable to bus stop which directly to train station. However the common area was a bit small but the kitchen are fully equipped. Other than that, everything are excellent.

Delia and her husband were super helpful and responsive. They gave recommendations, responded right away and let us store our bags and receive a last minute parking spot if we wanted it. I’d say the place isn’t exactly how it appears in photos, just an old property. It was very noisy even on week days outside and upstairs so I wouldn’t necessarily come here to relax but if you want to stay out, it’s lively and fun. The only other thing is the area is a bit dicey, I wouldn’t stay here alone as a woman but felt comfortable with my boyfriend.

this was an amazing apartment. very well kept and modern. my fiancee and I loved that it was super close to the Zurich Main Station since we used the SBB trains during our entire week stay. the only downfall of this space is the walls are thin. we stayed during the weekend and the bar next door was extremely loud until nearly 1am each night.

We spent 4 days and we had a great stay at this apartment! It’s clean, well-maintained, and located within walking distance to Zurich's Central Train Station. The apartment itself is very nice, although it would have been even better with a microwave. The area can be quite noisy from Friday to Sunday, as there’s a bar downstairs, and the sound is very loud – almost like it's inside the apartment, even considering the typical Swiss quietness. It’s also worth noting that there are some instances of illegal product sales right across from the building during certain hours, so a bit of caution is advised. However, Lara was amazing and made our check-in process very easy. Despite the surrounding environment, with a little care, I would definitely recommend this place.

We had a good stay at Lara’s. Lara is extremely helpful and available at all times to assist with everything regarding the stay at the property. We liked the apartment aesthetics and cleanliness. We got to the place around 9pm, via Langstrasse and it seemed a bit uncomfortable to walk through there. Please take the other way to the apartment. If you are with kids, the music from the bar next door, can get a bit loud at night till around midnight. Lara is a lovely person herself and does her best to assist with everything. Cheers, Anya

The appartment is very modern and cozy. You can reach the city center by foot or tram within 10 minutes. Unfortunately, there were several long dark hair in the provided towels as well as beds and bathroom.

A modern and great apartment in an excellent location. Great connections with public transportation. Wonderful view. Easy communication with clear instructions. Few minor improvements could be made, such as sharper kitchen knives and better vacuumed carpets and leaves should be cleaned from the balcony. However, we would gladly return and warmly recommend the apartment!

Great neighborhood, spotless place with a cool balcony and backyard!! A real Zürich experience. Felt like a quick 15 min walk everywhere. We were required to be quiet between 10pm and 7am, but the neighbors upstairs and downstairs didn’t follow the same rules which wouldn’t have bothered me if the rules weren’t so explicitly stated in the listing. Stayed during a heat wave had a specific request that led to some back forth. That being said all of the hosts were very gracious and accommodating. Overall a wonderful little place, well equipped with amenities and a cool spot to call home for any duration!
Really fast answering always when we had questions about something. Also very easy to reach from the airport by tram. Clean rooms and was just what we were expecting!

Great place to stay with family and it's only a 5 min train ride to the main station "HB". Stefani was super responsive and provided great instructions. The place was neat and quite spacious. Highly recommend!

The apartment is in a fantastic location, close to everything you need. The accommodations are generally comfortable, though it can get quite warm at night during the summer. Unfortunately, there's no AC, and the current fan provided isn't quite sufficient to cool the space. For the price, I would have expected a better fan, and I hope the host considers upgrading it soon. That being said, the apartment itself is nice and would be perfect with improved ventilation.

The location is close to many restaurants and supermarkets. The kitchen is very well equipped with a new and efficient oven and a full size fridge. The only drawback was the noise from the neighboring bars on Saturday night. The music was on until 2 am. It gets stuffy during hot summer nights since the windows had to be closed to keep the noise and 2nd hand smoking away. The rest of the nights were quiet and fine. I’d book it again given how reasonable the rent is but just avoid the weekend stay. It might be a good choice for young folks who enjoy night life and don’t mind the noise.
We had a good stay for two nights here. The only major issue was that we were unable to use the dryer and due to the weekend, it could not be attended to during our stay.
I’ve stayed at Giancarlo’s places previously and they’ve all lived up to expectations. I would not hesitate to recommend any of the locations that he manages.
Great place and the host is very responsive, however the stay is a little far from main attractions and the bed is small for 2 people.

This was so conveniently located just a quick walk from the train station. It was very clean and we were very comfortable with the accommodations. The host was very responsive and kind. We loved Switzerland!

There were four of us and we absolutely loved our stay! The space was spotless, spacious, and felt so comfortable. Perfect central location, we could walk everywhere. Would definitely stay here again!

The flat was very clean, very well located, and it has a great view from the roof. Chris was friendly, helpful and easy to talk to. The only thing I'd improve would be the check-in process, the flat has many switches, buttons and remotes to control the lift, main door and windows/blinds which are not intuitive, and the host was not fully sure how they work either, so it took me a bit of time to figure it all out, but other than that I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Zurich.
Location was good and the stay was worth it

Great stay! The apartment is close to two tram stations and the apartment complex is very easy to find. Everything was clean and everything inside looks just like the photos. Nana responded to all our messages within 20 mins, no complaints :)

It's a decent stay, one can consider the place for a few nights stay. The presence of laundry is a great plus, however very complex to operate (we wasted a few CHF only to learn how to operate the washer and dryer. Accessing the laundry was not easy either. The room is conveniently located near tran stations and MIGROS for any groceries. The host Nana was very responsive and helpful, which makes the experience overall positive. We did find some dust, stains here and there (which was a big concern and we had to clean things ourselves). We found chicken bones (and other food leftovers) on the floor, below the bed. Not expected from high rated AirBnBs like this one. The cleaning agency needs to do a better job for what they are charging the guests. Overall, it's an Okay place.

The host was polite and did try to address the issues we raised and communication was cooperative. However, during our stay we experienced a blocked shower and an ongoing ant problem in multiple areas of the studio, including the kitchen and bed area. Airbnb ultimately provided a partial refund, which we appreciated. Overall, the stay did not fully meet expectations, but the host was responsive in dealing with the situation. We would recommend ensuring that the ant infestation is fully investigated and eradicated before anyone else stays.

The stay was fantastic and Dragesa was really good. The location is in a beautiful neighbourhood and quick morning walks to the nearby park was all we needed for my kid. The apartment was a quaint little place to stay and explore the city. I would definitely recommend this place.!!

Overall we had a nice stay, but the apartment we ended up staying in is not the one pictured. Our room was still a good place to stay for our quick trip in Zurich, just not what we expected. Host was communicative and check-in was smooth.

The airbnb was easy to find, but it looked much older and darker than the pictures. Overall, I felt like the price was a little steep for the space and it could’ve been cleaner (dead bugs squished on the ceiling and hair on the floor).

The apartment is not in the center of the city, but a few tram stations. It is old, but well maintained. It was very nice to have selection of tea and some coffee capsules. There is a small supermarket quit near. It is a very peaceful and quite neighborhood. Not much to do. The only drawback is getting the key - it was a struggle opening the key lock both when we arrive at dark and even when we left in the morning.

This place is centrally located and restaurants and shopping are in walking distance! Kitchen is well equipped with everything you need and the place was very clean. Our only complaints were both bathrooms were on the first floor, which wasn’t convenient for the bedroom on the second floor. Also, in the second bedroom, mattress is on the floor and very uncomfortable. Unfortunately, my mother who was assigned that room had to sleep on the couch instead because she got a backache.

We had an amazing stay with Julien! I highly recommend the flat. Julien was very reactive and understanding. He also provided us with good addresses/ tips in the area and was happy to chat with us while at the same time respecting our space. The kitchen is very well-equipped and the bathroom spacious. The neighbourhood is also great and very central (we did everything by foot). My friend and I were delighted with our stay and would recommend the accommodation many times over! Thanks again to Julien for his kindness and warm welcome!

Had a wonderful 4 night stay in Nicole's place. As others have stated, it is bigger than it looks from the photos. There is also a large balcony, perfect for dinner in the evening if you want to stay in. The bathroom is a shower over bath and is beautifully clean and spacious. There is no microwave, air conditioning or lift/elevator which may be relevant to some guests. The apartment is a 2nd floor apartment but the first flight of stairs is short (only 8 steps or so). We had a great time and would certainly consider staying again.
