This is a beautiful, very clean apartment filled with history in the centre of the old town. It is very comfortable and clean. Anna is a wonderful host and was so attentive, helpful and friendly. I would highly recommend this apartment.

LOCATION. LOCATION. LOCATION. We are a couple with the baby, and we truly enjoyed our stay at this place. For us, location was everything. In the most beautiful part of town. Just couple steps away from all the best places. In the apartment everything was fine and clean, just as in photos. Check-in was easy. If we visit Zurich again, we will choose the same place for sure.

It was easy to find his house and everythink was clear. My towel was damaged but they left me a new towel, He was always responsible the answer us! There is only one missing that there was no shower gel but It is OK!
I had a lovely stay with Giancarlo, who was responsive and accommodating throughout the trip. The location is great, with a nice creek that runs right outside the apartment.

Place is as described, restful and enjoyable. Host communicates clearly, easy to check-in and overall a quiet and peaceful place. Restaurants and main places at least 15 minutes walk but reachable. If you want to use a rented bicycle or scooter they’re mostly everywhere and to come in really handy. In another note I kept looking for the washer area but could not find it so a little trouble there, however had a great experience overall.
A cozy studio apartment with all the basic things you need for a short trip. A quiet neighborhood and only a 15-20 walk to the main railway station. Hosts were easy to communicate with.

The location is great. Modern, spacious penthouse with impressive views of the city and beautiful neighboring buildings. Cozy and comfortable place with stylish, quality furniture. Snow-white bed linen, comfortable pillows, and blankets. The blinds provided a great sleep. Sufficient lighting. Comfortable bathrooms. Exquisite decor. Dimi is a responsive and friendly host. It was a pleasant, amazing experience to stay here.

The place is clean, well located, the kitchen had all that it needed. However, an extra blanket would be needed during the winter times as the heating stops between 11pm and 6 am, and the room gets very cold during the night time.
Really liked the apartment. Great, spacious and tons of restaurants around.

Thr host was very responsive to all my worries in a promptly manner. on arrival i called the host my phone immediately went off, however tge host was very proactive by continuously calling till contact with me was established and helped with my query immediately and in a very friendly manner. I will definitely recommend this place. tram stop was directly outside which made my travel to both the airport and main train station very easy.
The apartment is exactly what it looks like in the pictures. Semion is very communicative and responded quickly. Close subway stations to get to the city. Great deal, perfect for a weekend in Zurich!

Close to major attractions. Everything you need. We overlooked that the listing did not offer air conditioning, but the host made sure to bring us a fan when we asked! Very responsive and helpful. The elevator was down so we did have to take our luggage up 6 flights of stairs. However the host did offer to have someone when assist if needed. Would stay again if in Zurich.

Arye was very communicative but the place is older than I expected. Also with suitcases it is quite difficult to get to on public transport and then its on the 6th floor. Although there is a lift it is very small. I also had trouble with the internet and could not get my phone connected, only my laptop. So overall the stay was fine, but given these factors, I felt it was a bit overpriced.

Loved the room! Attention to detail, modern and super cozy. Host was very friendly and helpful and made us feel very comfortable. Totally recommend, and when back to Zürich will be choosing it again! :)

Considering the price of everything else in Zurich it’s an ok place to stay. Unfortunately the bed was paper thin, the bathroom cubicle had many unwanted stains throughout it, and the shower curtain is much too small leading to a mess while showering. Although multiple large towels was a nice addition to have.

The apartment was located at an impeccable location near the Zurich train station, close to all the big supermarkets and shops. The host Nora was very understanding as we had young kids and she was willing to accommodate some of our requests. The only minor point was that the master bathroom had a bit of a funny smell but Nora provided us a solution and offered to help in no time.
Lovely stay, David was a wonderful host, very respectful and kind. I felt right at home. I travelled alone and felt safe in the neighborhood. Would recommend totally this place.
Really great location and responsive host but The bathroom was not clean, the bedding was not super confortable.

Nico's place is spacious with plenty of natural light and a calm interior. The host was very communicative and easy to reach, and check-in and check-out were very smooth. I will recommend this place and host to all my friends.

When we arrived at the apartment, it hadn’t been cleaned after the previous guest checked out. Prior to our arrival, Nico had declined our request for early check-in, stating that the apartment needed to be cleaned. However, it was clear upon arrival that this had not been done. I messaged Nico, and he responded immediately by sending cleaning staff. While I genuinely appreciate his quick response and action, it would have been more professional if the apartment had been prepared as communicated.

had a fantastic stay! The room was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great, and the host was very responsive and helpful throughout my stay. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting and would love to stay here again in the future!

Check was completely automated which went very smoothly. Room was very small. Noise was average for being in a small building in the middle of a city centre. The only issue we had was the smell of marijuana and cigarette smoke that was potent in the room. Unsure where it came from but it was overpowering until we opened the windows.

We arrived 2 hours earlier than planned due to a bus change and asked the host if we could check in early since we were very tired. The cleaning lady confirmed the room was ready, and the host kindly allowed us to check in. 1. The room was incredibly clean and comfortable. 2. There was a market just downstairs and unlimited tea and coffee. 3. The bus station was only a 10-minute walk away. 4. As Turkish tourists, we loved that there was a Turkish restaurant right next door, but for other travelers there were also McDonald’s and a burger place nearby. The only minor downside was that if we left the window open at night, we could hear some noise from outside — but once the window was closed, it was completely silent. Overall, it was an excellent stay!

This is a really central location, the apartment looks just like in the photos. Communication was easy and so was checking in. However it’s a going out area (the windows isolate a lot of the noise but it’s worth saying it), the kitchen is not well equipped and I was told there was a spot to keep my luggage but when I got there was given an area that was accessible for the store. In general I think it’s great for a short visit!

This is a great place to stay when you are on a budget. The checkin process for super easy and completely automated, same for checkout. The place has all the bare minimum things that you need for a good stay. The bed was very comfortable, everything else was very basic. It was very close to supermarkets so I bought all consumables that I would need under 10 francs. Location wise this place was very close to Zurich HB (main train station) and Zurich Bus station. As a result of which we didn’t waste any time when we were taking the tours as all tours start from nearby locations. Small advice for EasyHotel: Please add some basic wardrobe to the place, the only thing I didn’t like was the fact that I had to keep all my clothes on the bed or on the floor.

Great location that was right beside public transport. Clean room with bonus of balcony. It was around 32°c when we stayed and so the room was very hot overnight. However, Jay from the hotel did help by telling me where to get fans that somewhat helped. I am sure it would have been a perfect stay were it not peak summer!
We loved our stay in Zurich! Amazing location, self check in was amazing we loved the setup was so good for our late check in. Room was great, bed comfy and overall would definitely stay again.

Super location with the tram and train very close by and easy parking outside (in the blue zone once you have the daily parking permit or across the road using Park+Rail). A lovely lake view is enjoyable from the balcony. The apartment itself was clean, comfortable and exactly as described. The wifi was a little weak but the hosts promised to get that solved which was much appreciated. Overall I can easily recommend it as a place to stay.

The walls and floors/ceilings are so thin so you can hear every other guest, even at talking volume. The room also does not have anywhere to sit - could do with a little table and chairs or even a little kettle as the room was just the bed, a toilet and a shower. The balcony was a nice addition but again, no table or chairs out there so we couldn’t really use it. The host however was extremely responsive at 1am to help us when the room next was playing loud music, which was very helpful! Decent location with walking distance (15 mins) to the main train station, and some little cafes around. If you are booking and planning to be out all day and only using it to sleep this is a decent place. Just beware that at night if other guests are loud then it might keep you up.

Very clean and great location, with a tram spot right up the block. However, it was a bit smaller than expected and we did sleep with the balcony door open all night as there is no fan or AC. Overall, convenient and you get what you pay for so good for one night in not-peak summer.
The stay was great! The neighboorhod is really chill and good to walk. There's a plenty of restaurants and cafés nearby. The apartment is great

Really nice place, in a great area, matched the photos. The one thing, we had no clue how to turn on oven, it needed a child code for us, which we didn’t have, but that was the only thing that could’ve been improved. Responsive host, and emphasizing how great of an area it’s in!

Perfectly adequate for a couple of nights, as a base to explore Zürich, less than a 10 minute walk from Zürich HB. Very comfortable bed (we requested a couple extra pillows), large bath towels and the shower pressure was excellent. A couple of hooks for the towels would have been handy, as would a shelf/table to be able to put our belongings on but we managed fine. Very peaceful location (we overlooked the back of the property) except from the nearby church bells which ring every 15 minutes between 7AM & 10PM and are very loud!

The room was much bigger than a usual easy hotel so I was pleasantly surprised with the space. There was a balcony which was lovely to watch the sunset on and the location was great - walkable to the main centre. HOWEVER: thanks to the couple next door to us, we discovered the walls are very VERY thin…. I’m glad they.. ‘enjoyed their night’ shall we say ;) … but would recommend guests to bring some earplugs. Especially if you’re bringing children, was a bit awkward haha.

We stayed one night in Zurich at this lovely hotel, 10 mins from the train station. The room was clean and came with free snacks and drinks. It’s a self check-in, but the steps were very easy to follow. The host also provided an AC which we were so grateful for during the 35°C heat! Be aware there’s no elevator and it’s above a cabaret club, so it can be noisy at night. Overall, a good spot for couples or solo travellers.
We really enjoyed our stay! The location was great, and the room was clean!

Cheap hostel, possibly the most uncomfortable bed I or my partner have ever slept in… listed amenities (shower gel / shampoo) was empty. No table, hangers, drawers, coat hooks for clothing storage. However, it is cheap and well located!
Good staff communication they were quick to help us however our room was unclean and the door didn’t lock so felt unsafe

At the beginning I was a bit unsure that a self service hotel would work, but everything worked perfectly. We arrived early in the morning and we could store our luggage’s for free until the check in. The hotel is cozy, tidy and conveniently near to the Center, so you won’t have to pay for transportation if you plan to visit the city centre. Just walk 20 mins and you are ready. They don’t have a kitchen, but they always provide a microwave and hot water. There is also a supermarket next the entrance. 100% recommend!

The location is convenient and check-in was easy, but the room is very poorly equipped, there’s essentially just a bed, and even a small table is missing. The bathroom is extremely small and uncomfortable. Overall, the space feels incomplete and not well thought out. While the price is lower than other options, the lack of basic amenities significantly affects the stay.

The apartment is 9 minutes walk from the closest tram stop, or 30+ minutes from downtown. For us it was worth it to save some money, as staying downtown is expensive. (I’ll add though that, with three people, it ended up being the same cost to uber as it was to take public transit.) The kitchen is quite small, so much so that I imagine cooking meals would be difficult. However, the rest of the space was very spacious and comfortable. There were plenty of towels, blankets, etc. There was a small amount of mold in the bathroom due to humidity from the shower.

I would not say that I enjoyed the stay, but the room had everything that we needed for one night stay. More nights I would not recommend, didn't sleep well. Main things that influenced mine opinion - it was really hot in the room, there was no air conditioner; the floor was little bit dusty; didn't feel at home. But at the same time it was cheaper than other options, there were lockers if you wanted to store your bags before check in or after check out and it was really easy to check in.
This location is really well located. Close to the train and close to multiple restaurants

Great location and apartment! Walkable to the city, in a quiet area with parking included! The home was very clean and exactly as advertised. Comfortable and clean! Host was extremely responsive and easy to communicate with. Would definitely stay here again!!

We made an early check in for 10 chf, the machine errored while doing that but the stuff helped us immediately. The room was clean and everything. Only downsides are, there are no extra space to hang our clothes to. No hangers in the bathroom for towels. And it was kind of far from the old town but not too bad. The neighborhood was really nice and calm.

The people upstairs made so much noise. Outside was really noisy also. We didn’t sleep the first night at all. The room was clean. The bed was ok. The pillows are absolutely terrible like putting your head on to thin paper. The other issue is lack of space to put underwear and hang anything if you get wet. We came in soaked and with only one place to put all your cloths on one hook, you have to put your wet and dry clothes together. I understand basic. But even basic isn’t as bad as this. It’s just not designed with any practicality. You don’t have to spend loads of money to have somewhere to put more clothes and to put underwear. All easy kept telling me is it’s basic. If you want to live out of your case and just use a mattress it’s perfect for you.

The host was very responsive. I asked quite a few questions before and during check-in, and Jaybee was always available to help and responded quickly. The location is convenient, with the nearest tram stop just a few minutes’ walk away and less than a 10-minute tram ride to Zurich Central Station. The accommodation was also very clean. The only minor issue was that water could easily spill out of the shower area, even when the curtain was fully closed, but it was not a major problem. A nice touch was that they provided a portable fan, which was especially appreciated during the hot weather. If you’re into Korean food, I also highly recommend the Korean restaurant IMONE. It was really good and worth a visit.

Nora and Christian’s apartment was extremely well located, we didn’t rent a car and even with luggage the main train station was <10mins walk. Several grocery stores were also very walkable and kitchen was well stocked (coffee maker, oven, microwave, fridge and freezer). Clean and quick communicators, would stay again.

Nora's home was perfect for a short stay in Zurich. It was well equipped, clean, and very comfortable for our family of 4. The extra crib and baby changing table she provided were very nice touches and made it much easier for handling our infant. It's quite close to the train station (4 min walk) but there are either stairs or a steep hill to navigate in case you have a lot of luggage. Trams to the main train station are close by. I would highly recommend staying here for your next visit to Zurich!

Great location that was a short 5-8 minute walk from Zurich HB main train station. But there are stairs to climb on the way to the apartment from the main train station so it was difficult to get our checked bags (~50lb suitcases) up the stairs. However, the apartment has an elevator so that was very nice!! The apartment is very clean and modern. We loved the amenities and appreciate that the hosts had laundry detergent and nespresso pods for us to use. The hosts were very responsive and provided local recommendations for restaurants and sightseeing when we asked since it was our first time in Switzerland! Easy contactless checkin and checkout. Lovely apartment and hosts! Would definitely stay here again and recommend to others!

My children (9 and 11 years old) spent 2 nights at Manuela’s apartment. The location was perfect, only 10 minutes by car away from the city center with lots of trees and beautiful surroundings. The apartment was exactly as in the pictures and very clean and well equipped. We would definately come back here for our next Zurich trip. We highly recommend it.

The apartment was great for us. We were just two people, but there was plenty of room for two couples, if required. The bathrooms are modern and clean. When I say clean, I mean spotless. We walked extensively throughout the city. We went on a long boat ride and there are many fine restaurants in the area. Manuela the host was super cool and so very accomodating. She thoroughly explained all the functions of the apartment as well as the amenities. I consider this place as a stay anyone would love and it met all our needs. It even has a mountain view from one of the windows in the dining room. We also loved the balcony. I could only recommend she include more pictures, as the listing does not fully show what a wonderful apartment this is. We were pleasantly surprised.

Great location- hear the main train station and in historic area. Nice looking apartment, as seen in photos. Unfortunately, when we arrived, the housekeeper was still there. She was nowhere near done when we arrived, and rushed finishing. The apartment certainly felt like someone else had just been there. As mentioned by other reviews, the Airbnb notifications sent to us all say a 2pm check in, but the owner emails and says 3 pm check in. This needs to be addressed. Could be a lovely stay, if the cleaning is better dealt with. Perhaps we were just unlucky.
Leonardo’s place is great- spacious, clean, and in a convenient location. Just be aware the bar next to the apartment is pretty noisy on the weekends!

Great for an overnight stay. As advertised, this place is a budget friendly option in a great central location near the station. The place looks new and fresh and blocks the noise from the street very well. Don't expect any services or much from the room (i.e. fridge, good pillows).

This place is exactly as billed, no frills or services. And its reasonably priced, especially considering some of the other hotels in the area. Everything is done online or at a self serve kiosk. We had no trouble at all checking in or out. But the location is what was best, 5 or 10 minute walk from Zurich HB.

We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was very clean, beautifully designed, and equipped with everything we needed. We especially appreciated having a washer and dryer, as well as an iron and hair dryer — these details made our stay very comfortable. The only small downside was that on very warm nights, when we needed to keep the windows open, it could get a bit noisy due to the nearby tram and occasional helicopter traffic from the hospital in the area. Other than that, everything was perfect. We truly enjoyed our stay and would happily recommend this place to other guests. Thank you for being a great host! 😊
Close to the station, easy checkin, very good price. A bed and a bathroom. The bed was a bit hard but it’s a great deal for what you pay for. Everything was clean.

We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment was clean and there were nice towels for us to use. The house was equipped with what was needed. The apartment was a little bit outside of the city center, but there is public transportation super close by.

The place was spacious and very clean. We enjoyed our stay here. The apartment was easy to find. The only thing there isn’t a lift which makes a bit difficult for the luggages. Also, the parking is on another location where you need to walk to go

We loved the apartment, it was very clean and comfortable. We really enjoyed our stay. It's close to the city so that you can walk to the centre but also in a quiet street with beautiful trees. Close to the river, too, for nice walks.

We had a fantastic stay at this central apartment in Zurich. The location is unbeatable — everything is within walking distance, from lake to shops, restaurants, and public transport. It made exploring the city effortless. The apartment itself was spotless, modern, and thoughtfully designed. It had all the amenities we needed, and the bed was extremely comfortable. Despite being in such a central area, it was surprisingly quiet at night, which we really appreciated. The host was friendly, responsive, and provided clear instructions for check-in and local tips that made our trip even better. It truly felt like a home away from home. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Zurich.

Superb, spacious place in Zurich’s Old Town, tastefully furnished and very comfortable. The host was great, helpful, responsive, and easy to communicate with. The apartment was spotless, and we were pleasantly surprised by the thoughtful amenities, from fresh flowers and nice bath products to useful kitchen essentials. Fantastic location. Would absolutely stay again.
The location and the luxury qualities of the unit makes this one of my favorite Airbnb properties we have rented. I would recommend and stay here again.

This 5th storey apartment is beautifully decorated and spotlessly clean. The only issue we had was it was very noisy; we could hear every footstep from the apartment above making it difficult to sleep.

Loved this place! Was VERY clean and comfortable bed. Had a little hiccup at check-in due to the fact that my key had not been in the lock but the hosts were very unresponsive and were able to have someone give me the key in 45 minutes. The best location and everything worked! Just remember to bring your own cleaning supplies + coffee + tea + shampoo, etc... as the place only had 1 small bar of soap! Overall loved this place and would come back. Clean and tidy.

We had a great stay! The place was in the most central & convenient location, remarkably clean and well-put. It felt as taken care by truly professional hosts. They have also been so friendly and always responsive. I can’t recommend it enough - we’re definitely staying again there in our next visit. Thank you so much!

Fantastic Zurich Stay at Cher's Apartment We thoroughly enjoyed our time here! Cher is a very helpful host, and the apartment delivers on quality and convenience. The Upsides: Unbeatable Connectivity: Bus, tram, and metro stations are all just 5-7 minutes away on foot. Spacious, High-Quality Kitchen: The kitchen is large, and all the appliances (fridge, induction, dishwasher) look brand new and work perfectly. Thoughtful Amenities: The apartment includes a great Marshall speaker and a much-needed travel adapter. Added Convenience: Cher offers luggage storage in the basement cellar. It's a nice, spacious 2-bedroom apartment. The Only Note: As noted in the listing, the apartment is located on the third floor of the building. We had a great time and would definitely stay again!

A clean and beautiful apartment that we have the pleasure of staying 2 nights in. Do note that there is no lift in the building and the apartment is located on the 3rd floor which may not be that convenient. However, everything else was perfect! Thank you for hosting us.

The apartment was very clean and spacious. The location couldn’t be better to get around Zurich. All the best bars and restaurants are very close. It does mean the street noise is rather loud, so over the weekend you can hear the partying. We loved having the washing machine and dryer. They are brand new and great for longer stays like ours. The TV has Netflix and the internet was very good too. Communication was really good. However, the mattress for the bed is firm and not that comfortable, so we didn’t sleep too good. But there were far more pros than cons.

The apartment was also quite nice and close to Zurich HB main station, as well as the tram stop and Coop supermarket. However, the Wi-Fi always disconnecting, and the equipment was limited. For example, the shower screen should be repaired for improvement.

Perfectly clean and quiet, a well-organized and tidy space with room for two to relax. A very comfortable bed, plenty of air and light. I especially appreciated the fans in the bathroom and laundry closet. Good restaurants, museums, markets and bars are all within easy walking distance. Street life is lively but not noisy. A delightful experience!

Nice location, walking distance to train station and supermarkets. The host answer ed what I questioned, but it took long time for response. The place is neat, however, the handheld shower is a bit weird that another shower will be turned on and released cold water after shutting the small one off by pressing it harder. Because of this, I had bad showering experience.
Me and my family had a nice experience in this stay, it was very centric, useful. The bed was comfortable but the sofa bed not so much ^^ either way, we had a good rest. I recommend it.
unfortunately we didn't get to meet dila whilst in zurich, but andres was the perfect host - he was welcoming and incredibly helpful during our stay, and was always quick to respond to any questions

This is a no frills apartment and you’re constantly reminded of this when there. AI slop art stapled to the wall No hand/small towels provided. Posting advertised a wireless charger but there wasn’t one so we had to go buy a converter. Included travel wifi was nice. Loud sounds all times of day/night. Sad looking room but in a convenient location. I’d say you get what you pay for but it’s not cheap either so 🤷‍♀️

This studio is in a wonderful location, very central in Zurich and easily walkable to restaurants, shops, bars, Lake Zurich. It is also very clean, simple, but has what you need. However, as it is so central and with 2 churches nearby, there is quite a bit of noise, and church bells ring twice an hour. While I was there, there was also construction going on outside, so there were metal slabs covering the pavement, and when cars and vans drive by, it makes a lot of noise. Unfortunately the windows are not double glazed so you hear all the noise. The noise started already at 5am with delivery trucks.
Great location, really close to train station and the airport however the sink was block through out my whole stay. Struggled with the heating other than that it was okay. Very clean
Nice stay overall. The place is a bit small, but the location is excellent — very central and convenient. Comfortable and had everything needed for a short stay.

Jaybee was a great host and very responsive. He was able to accommodate a late checkout for us and since our flight was at 5:45pm we found it really helpful to have somewhere to keep our luggage till we were ready to leave Zurich. Place was extremely clean and had all the listed amenities. The location is best for a couple. We are a small family of 3 and found the space not quite enough but the listing says that it’s suitable for 2 so trust that. Overall we had a wonderful time and felt secure in our location. Thank you Jaybee!
Very nice and friendly person! It is walkable location from the main station :)

Stayed here overnight and was super pleased with how accessible this was to the AltStadt/Downtown area. This is a basement unit so you have to navigate down a small walkway and downstairs but the instructions and accompanying pictures made it super easy. There was also a small dehumidifier/cooling unit in the room which I appreciated. Room was as described. Thank you!

Everything was perfect. We had a last minute change to our plans, and communication went seamlessly with the host. The apartment itself was super cute, and stayed noticeably cool during the day, even with a heat wave washing over Zürich. I would highly recommend this listing.
Great place to stay if you want access to both the central train station and the beautiful old town in Zürich.

The apartment itself is clean and comfortable. It is located close to the train station so has the expected noise level. Check in instructions from host are very clear and information about the state of building was accurate. Not really equipped to cook meals - lacks basic cooking equipment other than pans - e.g a wooden spoon or something similar for cooking. Not even salt or oil are provided as was described - just a half used sachet of sugar. Coffee and milk were provided however which was helpful.

The apartment was very nice, and the location was quite good, close to the train station. Unfortunately, it was on a specific, party street. If you don't like that kind of atmosphere, we don't recommend it. Some of the information in the listing description was inaccurate. There was a lack of salt, pepper, oil, and, most importantly, toilet paper. Half a roll of toilet paper for four people for three days was an absurd amount.

The price for 1 night was to high and the rest is good we left early morning at 5:40 to train station we had the train early morning. But the people in nearby restaurants and bar has too much noise all night long we could not sleep.

We only needed a place for one night before flying out and it was a great location near the train station for easy access to the airport. Any sort of food, drinks, and groceries were extremely close-by. Although the building was under construction we had not issues with conflicting noise or cleanliness. The flat is vey spacious with huge rooms and clean kitchen but there is very limited utensils or serve ware if you are looking to make any of your own food. The location is noisy and would not have been a problem except that there was no air conditioning and all the rooms were very hot at night. Keep that in mind for longer stays.

Simon and his co-host Silke were absolutely wonderful. We arrived later in the evening than we had originally intended, however we were able to check in easily with the instructions provided. We chose their apartment due to the proximity to public transit, and it was in a great location. There are several bus and tram stops within a few blocks, as well as the main train station nearby. It was easy to travel to after a busy day of exploring the city. The hosts were very communicative and accommodating. We had an issue involving the radiators and heating, and they worked with us to find a solution that was acceptable to everybody. If you're looking for a place to relax in between exploring all that Zürich has to offer, I would put Simon and Silke's properties at the top of my list.

A few days before our stay, the host informed us that the original apartment was unavailable due to water damage and offered an alternative on the fifth floor, which included a third bedroom. The replacement apartment was very clean, comfortable, and well-suited for our group of five. Its location was ideal—just a 10 to 15-minute walk to the train station. The only thing to note is that it’s near a bar, so light sleepers may want to use earplugs at night. Although there is ongoing construction in the hallways, it did not impact our stay. The hosts were responsive and attentive throughout the entire process, from booking to checkout. The apartment looked exactly as shown in the photos.

Quiet and clean apartment that I'd happily recommend, however please pay close attention to the "no frills" element in the description. The kitchen equipment and accessories are very basic and cooking for a hungry family is a bit of a challenge. That said it is in a quiet location and well located for trips in and out of Zurich.

Fantastic stay, we highly recommend! The apartment was excellent, very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host’s communication was outstanding throughout, making everything really easy from check-in to check-out. We’d happily stay here again!
A very nice place overall, the place was very new. A bit far away from central, but tram connections are good and fast.

Friedrich's Airbnb property was amazing. I really enjoyed the stay. The beds were very comfortable. There was a big kitchen and big living room with dining space and a balcony. The bathroom was very nice. It had all the amenities one needs. The area was nice with lots of shops and restaurants in the vicinity. All in all I would recommend this place to anyone who wants to stay comfortably in Zurich.
The house was tastefully furnished and extremely functional. I had a couple of simple suggestions regarding minor issues, and I believe the host will take care of them.

Jaybee was a great host, the check-in instructions were clear, and the communication was excellent. The apartment is quiet, in a good location, in a peaceful neighborhood, and it's possible to do activities on foot.

We had an amazing stay! The place is absolutely beautiful and honestly the photos don’t do it justice at all. Everything was spotless, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a perfect stay. The host was wonderful, super responsive, friendly, and made everything really easy from start to finish. You can tell they really care about their guests. We would 100% stay here again. Highly recommended! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

My mother and I had a wonderful stay. The washer and drier were very convenient and the shower/bathroom was clean. It is conveniently located by a bus stop so you won’t have to travel too far with luggage. However, finding the airbnb was a little tricky since we came after sun down. The host did send directions an hour beforehand but It would have been better to send it a day early. Also the mattress wasn’t very comfortable and little small for two people. Otherwise, once you’re inside, it’s a great place to reset and travel to the city. The host is very responsive. Thank you for having us, we really enjoyed our stay! :)

We enjoyed our stay here for the most part! The location was great and place is spacious and clean. The only drawback was that the pullout couch was broken, but we were still able to accommodate our group of 8. Also, the showerhead was broken so water pressure is relatively low. But those were minor issues we were able to deal with, and the place itself was pleasant to stay in. Would recommend overall!

Good accommodation. The building did smell of cannabis but I guess that's just society now and nothing to do with the accommodation itself. Would recommend it to anyone who wants a city centre accommodation. There is parking underground which I won't recommend as there is also parking across the road which is completely free after 20:00 till 9:00 a.m. overall a very good accommodation and the host is very proactive in their communication which is also appreciated.

Brilliant host and a beautiful apartment. We struggled a little with the heat and lack of fan or outdoor space, but there was a very hot heatwave at the time of our visit. The apartment is historic and very beautiful, as is the area it’s in. It was very easy to walk to the lake or into the city centre. A great place for a mini-break in Zurich. Thank you!
Good place to stay. Description and photos matched the place. Location is good. The balcony is nice. Dimi is responsive and helpful.

We had a very comfortable stay at this apartment in Zurich. The location was excellent — centrally located, well connected, and convenient for exploring the city with family. The apartment was spacious, clean, and comfortable overall. The host was very responsive to all our queries and tried his best to help whenever needed. Since it was unusually hot during our stay and the apartment did not have AC, we requested fans and the host arranged them for us, which we really appreciated. The only point to note is that the apartment has only one toilet for three bedrooms, which was a bit of a struggle for our family. Apart from that, we had a great experience and would recommend this place for a family stay in Zurich.

Not a bad place to stay, it’s clean and comfortable and in a good location. But the listing is a bit misleading as listed amenities include washer & dryer, which we assumed were in the unit but when in fact it’s a shared washer/dryer with the entire apartment complex in the basement and you have to pay. Wouldn’t have been a big deal if that was a little more apparent but it’s a bit misleading as currently depicted. We cooked one night and it also would have been nice to have a cutting board and one or two good knives, again we assumed those would be there because it was described as such.
beautiful and spacious apartment in a great neighborhood, close to supermarkets and the tram station, with lots of amenities, Tom is an amazing host, would recommend
The apartment was exactly as described and clean. Also, it is close to Zurich HB. Check-in was smooth and the host was welcoming and responsive. I really enjoyed my stay.
This space is centrally located to multiple tram and bus stops making it very easy to get around the city. Joy was incredibly communicative and helpful in meeting our needs.

They provided beddings for 4 people, although we reserved for 5. They told the fifth person to use the dirty couch with chocolate and other marks everywhere, and the pillows on the couch. They did not provide bed linens, and clean sheets for the 5th although we asked them to do so in the moment we checked in. We checked in at the earliest moment they let us. They said sleep on the dirty couch tonight, and the clean sheets will be provided the following day. As it is a company, they stop working after 4-5 pm, which cuts any type of support if you need something. Yes, you can chat with them online, but they will just tell you to wait until the next day.

Really a beautiful apartment. You can tell that everything in it was carefully selected. Location was great - only a short walk from the train station. Livio was a very responsive host as well. The only issues were that the floor boards are very loud (not ideal if you have a baby), and that sometimes you can smell the food from the restaurant downstairs strongly.

The place was very spacious and clean, staff was easy to communicate with, and the location was conveniently near a bus stop. The only complaint is it could get a bit noisy at night. If you are unlucky to have loud upstairs neighbors, you can hear them.

The stay was very good and the overall experience was pleasant. However, the check-in procedure details were shared quite late, which caused a half-hour to one hour wait at the site before we could check in.

This is a wonderful apartment in a perfect location. Everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The beds were very cozy and we felt right at home. I will definitely stay here again on my next visit to Zurich. Highly recommended!

Really comfortable apartment in a great location. Perfect for our short stay in Zurich arriving and leaving by train. Lots to do in a short walk from the flat. Best of all was the really clear and friendly communication that made everything so stress free (is it possible to give 6 stars out of 5 for this?)

The apartment is great for two people. Small but modern and confortable. Clan and well located, close to the tram and the train station. The surrounding area is very nice as well. The only (minor) issue is that there is only one chair, so for two people is difficult to have breakfast for example after having cooked the meal in the well equiped kitchen. Also a light close to the bed (for reading for example) would be ideal.

Liliane’s place was in the perfect location for a few days in Zurich. The space is small but did have most things we needed to make our stay easy. Few things to note, there was no kettle which meant we boiled water in a pan - this was fine for us but might not be for others. Overall the place was generally clean but there were some marks on one of the towels and the bathroom was a bit grubby. However it’s one of the more affordable places in Zurich so it was suited to the price and was fine for 2 people.
Tamara's place was clean and in an excellent location, very easy to access all parts of Zurich and great food around. The only downside was the main TV not working, but overall we enjoyed our stay!
Nice place and location however worth knowing that the stairs to the main bedroom are steep and not ideal for older folks. Pretty loud location but also great to be close to restaurants.

Julia & her roommates went out of their way to make us feel welcome in their home - even allowing us to drop off our luggage early. We could use their kitchen, however no towels were provided so we could not shower. It worked out okay as we only stayed one night and were flying home the next morning. She told us which public transport to take to get to the airport and 43 minutes later we were there. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend staying at her place.

Our stay was very pleasant, the apartment is right in the center of Zürich and the public transport is just a 3 minute walk. There are many restaurants and supermarkets nearby. The apartment was clean and warm. Please note that the host has some of their belongings in the apartment, but they didn't cause any inconveniences (for me). Overall a great experience, highly recommended!
Great place in the heart of the city. Clean, comfortable, and a convenient location. Great option for the price :)

The location of this apartment is great! Several minutes’ walk away from the central station. The bus stop is also very close so it’s quite easy to hang out around the city, or go to the airport. The apartment is easy to be found and check-in intro is quite clear. It’s hard to find such an apartment with this reasonable price in Zurich. However, the heater is not warm enough and we couldn’t find the remote control to turn on the AC. The landlord didn’t reply to my text the whole night. Luckily we found extra duvet in the cabinet so we didn’t suffer from the coldness a lot. More unfortunately, somehow we were not able to get hot water when we tried to take shower the next morning… Maybe it was a coincidence but it did make us not pleasant.

We really enjoyed our stay here 10-15 minute walk from the front of the station really would recommend staying here if you are looking for an apartment to stay near to the station and easily walkable to the city center which is about 20 minute flat walk
Lovely place, lovely neighborhood, 15 minute walk from the historic center and the lake. Marvellous place would definitely stay there !

We had a great time in Zürich! The apartment was very clean & cosy. It is located in a very nice district, with the train station & Bellevue station close by. The apartment was spacious, nicely styled and it felt like a home, even though it was just for the weekend ;)

I rented this place for a few days during a work-related visit, and it was perfect for my needs. The apartment was furnished in a modern style and felt like just renovated. Despite the small space, it had all the necessary amenities, making it very comfortable. It was also spotless – cleanliness was top-notch. The location was great – very close to the main train station and within walking distance to the city center, which made it easy to get around. The only downside was a bit of noise from the upstairs neighbors and some street activity due to its proximity to a lively area, during Fridey night but it didn’t detract much from the overall experience. I would definitely recommend this place for anyone looking for a cozy and convenient stay!

The home was very clean, and convenient to the tram stop. The beds were also very comfortable. Only downside for us was that the furniture wasn’t the most kid friendly and there was wasn’t cleaning supplies provided. With 3 small kids it’s helpful to have a vacuum cleaner or broom to clean up after meal time. Overall we had a great stay!

The apartment is located very close to orelikon station which makes it convenient but it’s very very loud, you can hear trains passing by. So if you need a quiet place, I highly do not recommend. The apartment is relatively small but it’s modern and clean . The bed is extremely uncomfortable unfortunately.

A bit outside of the main city, about 15 minutes drive into the heart of Zurich. there was several public transport steps close by that could be very helpful. We did not utilize these as we had a vehicle available. The only notable issue was the listing had a TV as an amenity and there was not one there. As they operate many rentals, I'm sure it was an oversight that they corrected with a price reduction as a way to make things right. Good communication and response times. Thank you for assisting us with our travel needs!

Place was in a quiet residential neighborhood with various eateries scattered around. We like that the place was well furnished, has good lighting, clean and had access to laundry (detergent not provided). Dimi was also friendly and helpful over chat. However, basic items like shampoo/soap, cooking oil and facial tissue were not provided so we had to rush to buy. Dimi said he will rectify this, so do check. I would also suggest a non-slip mat for the bathtub as my toddler slipped and fell once. Other than that, a peaceful stay.

The apartment was very clean, spacious, and comfortable. The price was also very reasonable. The only thing to keep in mind is to be respectful of the quiet hours, as the neighbors are sensitive to noise. Overall, we were very satisfied with our stay.
Haoran was a great host. We truly enjoyed exploring the beautiful historic center from this central accommodation. Very comfortable and a great place to relax!

This was the PERFECT place to recover from some jet jag. Once we figured out the city transit, it was very easy to get to & in a quiet private neighborhood. Once inside, Amaya’s space was absolutely beautiful and very clean. And the bed!!! It may have been the sleep deprivation, but the down bedding & linen sheets/duvet, plus the black out curtains, provided some of the best sleep my husband and I have ever had! We woke up with zero aches from our long flight and long day of walking carrying our heavy packs. I would recommend this to any couple wanting a quiet place to stay before backpacking the stunning Alps.
We just stayed a night, but the place was awesome! Super clean and easy to access. It was close the airport and well stocked. Loved staying here!
We had a lovely stay in this property. The location was great and the hosts were very accommodating. Would recommend!

Location is great, easy access to public transport, walkable to lots of restaurants and shops. Cool little space in an old building, lots of character but still very private. The rooftop terrace was lovely to enjoy in the warm evenings. Hosts accommodated my last minute request to separate the king bed into two separate beds for my kids. I very much appreciated that! We had a lovely stay!

Thomas and Cristian were excellent hosts! The apartment was as described and clean. We had an issue when we checked in that a window was broken but they were able to quickly find us a different apartment to stay in. It’s a great location and close to the main train station and tram stops.

The apartment was spacious and had everything we needed for our stay—including the laundry facilities. The location is incredibly convenient, sitting about a 5-minute walk from the Oerlikon train station, which is just a 5-minute train ride from Zurich HB (the main station) and 5 minutes from the Zurich airport. ​However, the only thing missing was fans. It was 93+ degrees with record-breaking heat and humidity during our visit, which made it quite uncomfortable inside the apartment. While fans are not listed in the property description, adding a few would be incredibly helpful for future guests to beat the heat, especially since houses in Switzerland typically do not have central AC.

Very clean, lovely home, suitable for a short stay. Communication with Patrick was also very easy and prompt. We travelled with a 13 month old toddler and Patrick provided a comfortable travel cot and lots of toys that kept the baby busy ! Would love to stay here again.

The property was in an excellent location and walking distance to the tram and close to the city (10 min by tram) the apartment was comfortable and in a quiet area. Some local recommendations for coffee shops, cafes, restaurants and supermarkets would have been helpful. The bed needs to be Queen size and not a Double. otherwise a great city apartment.

It was absolutely beautiful, clean, cozy, and next to a lot of things! The only thing I warn, especially if you brought heavy suitcases like me…. There are so many stairs and even more stairs to the apartment for when you go inside. Made it hard bringing the stuff up.

Pros: Unit very clean nice amenities. Great location easy to find. Quiet. Close to tram routes had luggage storage. Cons: About 90 steps to get to Nest Suite, serious workout with 2 large suitcase. Got very warm inside due to sunny days and being on the top of building. We asked for fans to be there when we checked in and they said they would provide them but they didn’t. No closet. Overall nice place. Make sure in good physical shape if you book on the top floors

Lovely place, in good location. Short walk to train station. We had a quick overnight stay, but having a washer and dryer was such an added plus, as was the elevator! Very nicely decorated flat. Wish the weather had been better so we could’ve used the rooftop patio, maybe next time.

this was an amazing spot, very beautiful view of the surroundings from the apartment, very clean, and was in a very calm and peaceful neighborhood. Although checking in has too many steps, but they do a good job of providing the instructions. They are really responsive and a great host. Very much recommend this place.

i’m very lucky to find Michal listings at the last minute before my europe trip. And somehow i got this amazingly comfortable studio to live in while staying in Switzerland. first of all, i texted Michal saying that my arrival time to Switzerland is going to be earlier than expected, and he let us to check in earlier, so thankful for that. when we got inside the house, everything is squeky clean and the neighborhood is so peaceful even when it’s located near the big road you cant hear any car from inside the house. Michal is so responsive and guide you through anything you need. Thank you so much and definitely recommend everyone to book at his place while in Switzerland !!!

We enjoyed our stay at Michal’s place. The apartment was very nice - clean, spacious and comfortable. The location was within walking distance of the train and markets. Michal was a very communicative host. I would highly recommend staying here!

The location was perfect. However I was very surprised that there were no elevators as this apartment is on the 4th floor. The apartment was clean, however it did come with very creaky outdated floors. Beds were very comfortable, bathroom is large and clean.
Everything was good overall. The only issue was the front door — it was difficult to open and should be fixed. Other than that, the stay was pleasant.
Apartment was really spacious and clean, and the host was responsive to my questions. I had a pleasant stay here!

i had a lovely stay at Teresa's place! the whole apartment has such a cozy atmosphere, the bed is super comfortable - really perfect after a long day of walking around. it's conveniently located next to a bus/tram stop that takes you to the city center and the main train station. the only minor problem i had was that my data roaming didn't work the first day, and since there's no wifi at Teresa's place i could only fix the issue the next morning at a cafe that had free internet. thanks for having me, i had a great time overall!

If you just need a place to sleep and keep your things, this is it. It is very basic. As pictured, the bed is very low to the floor and quite uncomfortable. There is only a little fan that didn't do anything in this heatwave. It is also is very noisy and constantly moves directions on its own. Also, while it states there is a washer/ dryer, what it doesn't say is that it is shared and you have to pay to use it. However, it is conveniently located near Zürich HB (12 minute walk or 10 minute tram ride) and there are teams nearby (3 minute walks). They were flexible in check in time, which i appreciated.
We were the first family to stay here! It was quiet, calm and sunny. The hosts were great, helpful and welcoming. If you’d like to stay near the city of Zurich, you should stay here!

Very very beautiful stay the host is very helpful Just some kitchen utensil’s are missing but he given me the voucher ihave bought it and i left there after my use but the climate was also good not too hot but after night its cold no need fans and ac the water beds rooms everything super clean especially the host is very very very help full its very near to city center and compare to his own website in air bnb the price is high thank q I enjoyed a very lot
